articleTitle: Surface Defect Detection of Hot-Rolled Strip Based on Improved YOLOv7
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In order to increase the detecting precision of surface defects in industrial hot-rolled strip steel, this paper improves the network model for target detection of strip steel surface defects based on the YOLOv7 algorithm. First, to minimize information loss and enhance global dimensional interaction characteristics, the Global Attention Mechanism (GAM) is applied. Second, the YOLOv7 model incorporates the adaptive spatial feature fusion technique to achieve the fusion of top-level features with bottom-level features. Finally, the regression loss function used in the original model is substituted for SIoU Loss to increase the speed and accuracy of the frame regression. The testing outcomes reveal that the method in this paper has an average accuracy improvement of 3.1% compared to the YOLOv7 algorithm before improvements on the industrial hot-rolled strip data set (NEU-DET).

articleTitle: Fine-Grained Sentiment Analysis with a Fine-Tuned BERT and an Improved Pre-Training BERT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: As a subtask of text classification, sentiment classification is a domain of study that advances rapidly with applications in almost any field in our daily life. Although many models have performed well on multiple binary sentiment classification datasets, there is still much space for improvement in the process of fine-grained sentiment analysis, which is essential for understanding people's perceptions of all kinds of topics, services, and products. In this paper, both the pre-training language model BERT whose initial parameters were fine-tuned for this task, and the RoBERTa model that improved the original way of pre-training were applied to the fine-grained sentiment analysis problem on the benchmark of the SST-5 dataset. Over the experiments, it is found that the RoBERTa model achieves higher accuracy compared with the fine-tuned BERT, which indicates that an improved way of pre-training can be more effective than just fine-tuning the initially learned parameters for the BERT model in this sentiment analysis task.

articleTitle: Research on Decentralized Federated Learning System for Vehicle Data Privacy Protection Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper proposes an edge computing vehicle data privacy protection method based on blockchain and federated learning. Using blockchain to give edge computing tamper-proof and anti-single point of failure attacks and other characteristics. Integrate gradient verification and incentive mechanism into consensus protocol. By constructing master-slave chain architecture among vehicles, roadside units and base stations, distributed model security sharing is realized. An asynchronous federated learning algorithm based on incentive mechanism is proposed to motivate vehicles and roadside units to participate in the optimization process. The framework is verified on real locus data sets. LSTM self-coding is used as embedded learning network. The prototype of the proposed architecture is implemented in the experiment, and its feasibility, accuracy and performance are evaluated. The results show that this method maintains the integrity of data and has good prediction accuracy and performance.

articleTitle: Research on Performance Improvement Method of Dynamic Object Detection Based on Spatio-temporal Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper proposes a method based on a spatio-temporal attention mechanism to improve detection performance aiming at the challenges in dynamic object detection. First, definitions, applications, and challenges of existing methods for dynamic object detection are introduced. Second, the concepts and advantages of the spatio-temporal attention mechanism are presented. Next, the main technical and fundamental issues of spatial attention mechanisms in dynamic object detection will be discussed. Then, the dynamic object detection model's modeling, application, and optimization based on the spatio-temporal attention mechanism are described in detail. Finally, the main content of this paper is summarized, and the potential effects of dynamic object detection methods based on spatio-temporal attention mechanisms are highlighted.

articleTitle: Target Localization in ISAC System Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, the problem of Integrated Sensing and Communications (ISAC) system is considered to achieve an overall improvement in positioning accuracy. To achieve this goal, two optimization algorithms are proposed and evaluated. The first involves a direct positioning calculation based on distance, while the second is to use the correlation curve as the input of the Back-Propagation (BP) neural network for localization calculation. The simulation results verify the assistance by increasing perception, which can effectively improve the accuracy of positioning. This conclusion is drawn from the observation of the change in positioning accuracy under varying Signal-to-Noise Ratios (SNR). The results indicate that an increase in SNR results in a corresponding improvement in positioning accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Wireless Data Security Protection System of Campus Students Under Computer Application
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper analyzes and studies the network environment in the university network environment. The whole system is divided into three subsystems: control server, user terminal and user terminal. This paper focuses on the design of several important functions, such as secure identity authentication, agent filtering, file directory security monitoring, network connection monitoring, mobile storage device usage monitoring, program behavior monitoring, etc. A method of packet filtering based on SPI is proposed. The security protection of agent monitoring process is realized by using process anti - attack technology. This paper presents a new type of information protection system. By using “intercept” and “HOOK” technology, the access of illegal terminals and the blocking of extranet are realized. The software also provides some key applications, such as: mobile device usage record, process black and white list, and gives experimental results and evaluation results. The experimental results show that this scheme can not only improve the transmission rate of the network, but also improve the security of the network.

articleTitle: Research and Application on Anomaly Detection of Dynamic Baseline Performance Time Series Data Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Anomaly detection of dynamic baseline performance time series data is an important problem in data center and cloud computing. In order to solve this problem, an anomaly detection method based on machine learning for the time series data of dynamic baseline performance was proposed. Firstly, sliding window is used to extract data features, and a variety of machine learning algorithms are used for anomaly detection. At the same time, a method based on dynamic baseline is proposed, which can adjust the baseline adaptively and detect anomalies. Experimental results show that the proposed method can achieve good anomaly detection results in data center and cloud computing.

articleTitle: Research and Application of SMOTE-Based Method with XGBoost Regression Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper focuses on SB Dataset using a data mining approach, first using a crawler tool to collect as much detailed information as possible. Due to the small amount of data with limited features, this paper uses the method of synthetic minority oversampling technique to oversample the data, and then PCA is performed on the features. Then, we used extreme gradient augmentation (XGBoost) as a regression model for training and prediction, MAPE reached 3.402 % and R2 was close to 1 indicating a good model fit, based on XGBoost model construction to study the influencing factors in depth and by calculating the importance of the features, then, we used the Kendall's consistency test method to check the consistency of all variants. Finally, we obtained a positive answer with a Kendall coefficient of 0.975, with a view to providing some implications for prediction in other fields.

articleTitle: Path Planning Algorithm of Indoor Mobile Robot Based on ROS System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of global science and technology, robots have been widely used in industry, agriculture, service industry and other fields, among which the demand for mobile robots is rising. This paper takes indoor mobile robot as the research object, starts from the perspective of global and local planning respectively, and optimizes the design principle and design theory of the path planning algorithm in the robot navigation system, and proposes the global path planning algorithm based on the improved A* algorithm and the local path planning algorithm based on the improved artificial potential field algorithm. On this basis, in the case that any single planning algorithm cannot meet the requirements of operation in complex indoor environment, a hybrid path planning algorithm based on static global optimization and dynamic real-time local optimization is proposed, and the two improved algorithms are configured on the actual robot platform to achieve accurate obstacle avoidance and fast path finding theoretical verification of indoor mobile robots. The hybrid planning algorithm was verified by simulation experiment with MATLAB tool, and the effectiveness of the improved algorithm was verified. The indoor mobile robot ROS experiment platform was built to verify the hybrid optimization of the two improved algorithms, which has certain effectiveness and advantages for the dynamic real-time path planning of the actual robot indoor complex environment.

articleTitle: Research on Target Detection Algorithm Based on NAO Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of humanoid robots in recent years, people are paying more and more attention to robot competitions. NAO robot, as a competition robot designated by the RoboCup standard platform group of the Robot World Cup, is deeply loved by scholars. NAO robots need to accurately detect and identify objects before they can track and grasp. Due to the limitations of related hardware, the detection results of NAO robots are greatly affected by the color difference between the object color and the background color, especially the light intensity of the environment. We study and compare the object detection algorithms based on NAO robots, and design a set of object detection algorithms based on NAO robots according to their hardware conditions. By designing a pre-processing scheme for images, the recognition of objects in images was improved, and the detection ability of NAO robots was improved.

articleTitle: Data Security Model Construction of Network Coding of Wireless Communication Based on Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: On the way of information processing and transmission, the network coding technology has brought great innovation, which is a major breakthrough in the field of information theory research. Although network coding technology has greatly improved its effectiveness and security, and is widely used in various fields of communication services, the security issues of the network cannot be ignored. In order to address the issues of low accuracy and recall in detecting abnormal attacks in wireless communication networks, this paper proposes a method for constructing a data security model for wireless communication network coding based on deep convolutional neural networks. This article elaborates on the specific methods of establishing a data processing module, completing network data encoding, designing intrusion training strategies, and generating data security models. The experimental results show that the average accuracy and recall of this method are 99.642% and 98.897%, while the average error rate is only 0.013%, which has high application and promotion value.

articleTitle: Enhancing YOLOv7-Based Fatigue Driving Detection through the Integration of Coordinate Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Driver fatigue is a significant cause of traffic accidents, necessitating the development of effective methods for detecting and preventing drowsy driving. This paper presents a novel and enhanced fatigue driving recognition network, referred to as CA-YOLOv7, which inserts the Coordinate Attention mechanism between neck and head in the original YOLOv7 network structure. Additionally, it is combined with the PERCLOS algorithm to determine the level of fatigue. Comparative experiments were conducted on a self-collected fatigue driving detection dataset in VOC format to assess the effectiveness of the CA-YOLOv7 model in comparison to YOLOv7, SE-YOLOv7, and ECA-YOLOv7 models. The results demonstrate that CA-YOLOv7 has the best performance in experiments, increasing the YOLOv7 mAP value from 99.10% to 99.30% and the detection speed from 53.33 FPS to 69.44 FPS. This experimental results indicate that CA-YOLOv7 exhibits outstanding performance concerning both accuracy and speed for recognition. Overall, the proposed method can effectively guarantee driving security by detecting and preventing driver fatigue.

articleTitle: An Optimized Nasnet-Mobile Network Based on the BOA Algorithm for Bearing Health Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In the situation that the poor adaptive ability of traditional feature extraction methods and the weak generalization ability of a shallow neural network, a Nasnet-Mobile network framework method rely on the butterfly optimization algorithm (BOA) is proposed to optimize the internal parameters. Firstly, to process the bearing data, the bearing data is shifted by two-dimensional time-frequency transformation to obtain some normalized time-frequency spectrum. And the uppermost accuracy of the test set in the neural network is regraded as a fitness function, where BOA is used to search for the best parameter combination of Nasnet-Mobile. Then, the learning rate and the amount of batch learning that play the vital roles in the BOA will be selected appropriately, and at the same time, the Nasnet-Mobile will be given by comparison Finally, combined with the powerful adaptive feature extraction deep learning, the obtained samples were input into Nasnet Mobile to train, and a bearing fault diagnosis model using Nasnet-Mobile is established. After several tests on the test samples, the diagnostic rate of the model can be more than 99%, which is much better than the traditional fault diagnosis methods. Experimental results show that the proposed method can extract effective features better and has higher classification and detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Short-term Photovoltaic Power Generation Forecasting Based on LSTM and BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The solar photovoltaic (PV) generation is environmentally friendly but is not stable enough to be put into mass use. An accurate forecasting method is vital to improve the stability of PV power generation. This paper proposed a comparative study about the better method used to forecast PV power generation between LSTM and BP. For comparative study, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) was compared with Back Propagation (BP). The dataset used for forecasting was optimized by Pearson Correlation Coefficient method, so it consists of wind speed, humidity, temperature and global horizontal radiation at end. The dataset was divided into three parts: training set 70%, validating set 20%, and testing set 10%. The results show that LSTM is more accurate than BP in the whole view. However, BP is closer to the shape when the PV power generation become lower. To analysis the whole study, difference of principles of two methods affects forecasting accuracy.

articleTitle: AMB:Automatically Matches Boxes Module for One-Stage Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In computer vision, object detection is an important task. Whether it is a single-stage or two-stage method, it has been based on anchor-based detectors for several years. In recent years, due to multi-scale feature fusion and Focal Loss, anchor-free detectors have become popular. However, both anchor-based and anchor-free detectors have the problems of large computation, poor stability, many hyperparameters, and imbalance between positive and negative samples. This paper proposes a one-stage target detection network (AMBNet) that automatically matches ground truth boxes, avoid manual selection of anchors, which is difficult to match multi-scale targets. The size of the grid can be adjusted according to the size of the detection target. It is still regressing the target from rectangles that are closer to the ground-truth boxes, so the training is more stable. By calculation, when the number of grids is 64, no concentric rectangles are set, and the average IOU is 0.7753. When setting 4 concentric rectangles, the average value of IOU is 0.8211.

articleTitle: Intelligent Video Monitoring for Real-Time Detection and Recognition of Elderly Falls on the Embedded Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the ageing of the social population, in order to avoid elderly people living alone at home because of accidental falls and not timely treatment, this article put forward a computer vision based on the elderly fall detection and recognition system. Using the YOLOv3-tiny algorithm and DeepSORT algorithm as the elderly detection and tracking stage, the system uses the FastPose algorithm and Spatio-Temporal Graph Convolution (ST-GCN) network to load the key points of the identified elderly human body and classify the elderly's actions. Then, Ascend MindX SDK is used to reason the model and deployed on the Atlas 200DK hardware platform so as to realize the purpose of real-time human motion detection. The comparison of the test results to those of other detection algorithms and the YOLOv3-tiny network model demonstrates that the detection algorithm has a good recognition effect.

articleTitle: Effects of Different Generative Adversarial Networks on the Face Generation Task
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The human face may be the bodily part with the greatest degree of individuality, and it may provide a lot of information. On account of its importance in a wide range of applications, human face has become a popular study topic in the domain of computer vision. Besides the well-known face detection and face recognition task, human face generation technology is also widely concerned because of its various potential applications, including privacy protection, scientific use, entertainment purposes and so on. Generative adversarial network has been a powerful tool to generate human face since its first proposition in 2014 and numerous variants based on GAN were proposed in recent years to improve its stability and capability. With the advancements in generative methods, face generation technology has seen rapid development. In this paper, the author use three representative GAN variants, DCGAN, WGAN-GP and PGGAN to generate human face on the dataset of CelebA-HQ 128x128 and analyze their actual performance. The generated image resembles real human being, however, doesn't reach the level of which the original paper demonstrated because of insufficient computing power and limited running time. In the end, the author pointed out the potential ethical problems of face generation technology and made a prospect for the future of human face generation.

articleTitle: Employing Recursive Neural Networks in Voice Question-Answering Systems: A Novel Approach for Sequence Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this study, we propose and validate a novel Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) model designed for handling sequential data in voice question-answering systems. In our system, the RNN effectively processes speech sequences of various lengths and captures valuable dependencies within. Our model undergoes rigorous performance evaluation on standard TIMIT and LibriSpeech datasets, including Word Error Rate (WER), Answer Correct Rate (ARA), and Speech Synthesis Quality (SSQ). The results demonstrate the excellent performance of our model in dealing with speech sequences of varying lengths and practical applications. Through future research, our model will be further improved and can play its value in a broader scenario.

articleTitle: Electric Load Forecasting Based on SSA-GRU
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: To increase the reliability of electric load forecasts, This paper proposes a two-stage electric load forecasting model based on Singular Spectral Analysis pattern decomposition (SSA) and Gate Recursive Unit network (GRU). First, By using SSA, the electric load sequence is broken down, and then the GRU model is built to predict the subseries separately, and the forecast results of the subseries are superimposed to achieve highly accurate electric load forecasting. Compared with the traditional model, The SSA-GRU model suggested in this study has extremely broad application and is not dependent on either the smoothness requirement or the assumption of a parametric model. The experimental results show that the MAE of this hybrid model is 2774.5293, RMSE is 4111.5517, R2 is 0.9017 and MAPE is 0.0126 on the test set. It is proved that the errors of the prediction results of the designed method for wind power are all within the optimal error range and the predicted values have higher values. Compared with the comparison models, This paper's SSA-GRU model has a stronger predictive impact.

articleTitle: Human Vital Signs Detection Based on Millimeter Wave Radar and Digital Filtering
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Millimeter Wave(mmWave) radar is now widely used for vital sign monitoring, and the measurement of physical signs such as heart rate and respiratory rate is achieved by radio signals with non-contact and privacy protection features. To reduce the influence of breathing and its harmonics on heart rate estimation, this paper investigates heart rate monitoring based on frequency modulated continuous wave (FMCW) radar. First, a radar IF signal preprocessing process is established to extract the phase signal for the noise interference problem caused by the surrounding environmental clutter. Then, respiration and heart rate are extracted using a vital sign extraction algorithm based on FMCW phase change and digital filters. Finally, a new heart rate estimation method is implemented by intercepting the time period with a lower rate of respiration-induced thoracic volume change according to the different rates of thoracic undulation change during respiration, and the feasibility of the method is verified by further experiments.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Models for Lung Cancer Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Because of the COVID-19 pandemic in recent years, conventional lung diseases have been gradually neglected, especially lung cancer, which used to have a high mortality rate. This paper focuses on the prediction of lung cancer to help provide some suggestions for lung cancer prevention. In this paper, we will compare different types of machine learning prediction models and algorithms to select a class of algorithmic models that are most suitable for lung cancer prediction to achieve the purpose of the study. After the experimental comparison, after combining the results of the secondary and tertiary indicators and ROC curves generated by the confusion matrix, it is concluded that the ensemble learning algorithm model represented by the random forest algorithm model is the optimal class of prediction algorithm models for lung cancer prediction.

articleTitle: Study on Constructing Breast Cancer Prediction Model with Different Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Nowadays breast cancer had become one of the most serious cancers for women in the world. Therefore, constructing a risk prediction model for breast cancer is of great importance. This paper focuses on the goal to construct a best breast cancer prediction model based on SVM, KNN, and Naïve Bayes algorithms, which is constructed based on dataset from Wisconsin Breast Tumor dataset that has 569 samples with 30 calculated traits derived from digital photographs of the cell nuclei. For methods used in the paper, data-preprocessing, EDA, PCA are used to process the dataset. After that, prediction models are constructed and optimized based on three algorithms. Results show that SVM are the best option for the dataset in this study, according to the experiment, however KNN is better suited for datasets with more samples or samples that will be separated such that the class fields are heavily crossed or overlapped. For samples with fewer features, the Nave Bayes method is more suited.

articleTitle: Lung Cancer Prediction Based on Learning Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of big data, cloud computing and other technologies, artificial intelligence (AI) is moving from special intelligence to general intelligence and entering a new stage of development. As the core of artificial intelligence, machine algorithms have gradually penetrated various fields of artificial intelligence, making people's production and life greatly improved. After the new crown pneumonia epidemic swept the world in 2019, lung cancer prediction became a focus topic. In this paper, three classical algorithms (logistic regression, random forest and KNN) are used to predict the level and probability of lung cancer in patients in China based on the dataset of Chinese lung cancer patients in the journal Nature Medicine, and the performance of the cancer prediction model is comparatively analyzed, and several indicators of the model (score, accuracy, F1_Score, R2 Score, etc.) are analyzed. A large number of experiments have shown that these three methods will work well for lung cancer prediction, but the random forest model outperforms the other two models.

articleTitle: Research on an Innovative Feature Importance Recognition Algorithm Based on GINI-OOB Index
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Based on the decision tree algorithm (CART), this paper constructs an integrated model and trains the random forest algorithm (RF). On this basis, the GINI coefficient and the OOB coefficient are derived respectively and the coupling of the two is studied. Based on 10 importance indicators for training and learning, a more efficient, accurate and robust importance recognition algorithm is proposed. The results show that: (1) There are significant differences in the results of coupling Gini index and OOB index in different aspects, and the improved algorithm has stronger importance recognition accuracy. (2) The recognition algorithm proposed in this paper can identify the importance of financial risks. The research in this paper expands the identification methodology of importance.

articleTitle: Research on Image Edge Analysis and Application Based on Canny Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper proposes edge contour extraction. Edge detection technology directly affects the contour extraction process. At the same time, the edge contour extraction scheme to eliminate the interference effects such as edge burrs and shadows is studied, and the number and length of edge contours are calculated. This paper analyzes from three problems perspectives: Problem l: Contains three cases. Picl_l: Read the original image through the Soble operator, apply the attenuation factor to the spline interpolation, and use the maximum between-class variance method. Picl_2: The filter performs a “frame filtering” operation on the image to obtain the highlighted map of “various features, ” and then uses the Sobel operator to analyze the image. Picl_3: Binarize the control threshold followed by box filtering, then use the Sobel operator for image edge recognition to get a preliminary image. Finally, the Canny operator is used to obtain the edge contour data. Problem 2: Because the camera imaging process is actually converted from the “world coordinate system” to the “camera coordinate system”, then projected onto the imaging plane and finally converted into the image pixel coordinate system. The original image is distorted due to various factors. Problem 3: First, process the subject data to form an image and generate corner points through MATLAB software. Then, the Canny algorithm is used to circle the sub-pixel edge of the image. Finally, the lengths of contour1 and contour2 are calculated.

articleTitle: A Pedestrian Detection Method Based on Small Sample Data Set
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The current popular pedestrian detection methods are mainly based on deep learning algorithms, including Faster R-CNN, YOLO, SSD and other algorithms. In this paper, the INRIA data set is used to improve the accuracy of model recognition without increasing the speed of model recognition.

articleTitle: Wordle Game Data Analysis Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: It is important to study decentralized learning strategies, train regression decisions, and use computer logic to estimate game difficulty. This paper compares the spread scenario of Wordle games on Twitter to the spread of infectious diseases in human society, and simulates the number of players by establishing the SIRS model. Based on the player data collected by Twitter over a period of time, a mathematical model was established and the data results were analyzed in depth. It is necessary to solve the prediction of the number of daily reported results. The number of reported results has characteristics similar to the epidemic of infectious diseases. Based on the optimized SIRS model, the idea of infectious disease model and the SIR model was established. Combined with the physical model parameters and the traversal algorithm, the parameters were adjusted to achieve a better tracking. It is found that the model accuracy is ±2 %, which achieves a good degree of compliance. Aiming at the distribution of the percentage of prediction times per guess per day, a 14-word attribute scattered learning strategy was proposed, and the attributes were combined with each guess number. The training dataset was established, the regression decision tree model was trained, and the number of the reported results under each number of attempts was output. Using the model word EERIE for prediction, the distribution of percentages calculated using the output information is: (1 %,6 %, 16 %,36 %,21 %, 13%, 7 %). Finally, for the sensitivity analysis of the SIRS model, the value increased by 0.1 %, and the predicted number of participants would increase by 12.5% overall. The model is highly sensitive to parameters.

articleTitle: Research on Multilingual Speech Recognition Based on Streaming End-to-End Speech-Language Integrated Modeling Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: End-to-end Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) is a technology that directly converts speech into text and has received extensive attention and research in recent years. From an industrial perspective, this paper provides an overview of recent advances in end-to-end models in the current ASR space and techniques to address challenges in real-world applications. First, three common end-to-end models, CTC, AED, and RNN-T are presented, then their strengths, weaknesses, and applicable scenarios are analyzed. Two learning strategies are then presented: multitask learning and self-supervised learning, which shows how the performance and generalization of the end-to-end model improve. Then, cross-language modeling and adaptive technology are introduced, and how they solve the problem of multilingual speech and personalized recognition is explained. Finally, some new models such as Transformer, Conformer, and UniSpeech are introduced. It shows how they use attention mechanisms and self-supervised learning to improve recognition accuracy and efficiency. This paper is intended to provide a comprehensive and useful reference for ASR researchers and engineers.

articleTitle: Robust Flame Detection Based on YOLOv5 and Bidirectional Feature Pyramid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Fire is a great threat to people's lives and property, and its casualties are in a high position in all kinds of disasters. So it is of great significance to find and prevent fires. With the rapid popularization of hardware equipment and the progress of AI technology, the fire detection technology based on deep learning is worth exploring and studying in dealing with various fire scenarios. This paper proposes a fire detection algorithm based on YoloV5 and feature pyramid. In order to solve the problem that the network layer is too deep and the gradient disappears, we first introduce the residual structure Resnet network. Secondly, in order to further improve the semantic expression ability and positioning, the neck adopts the FPN+FAN structure, which can complement multi-scale fusion along the top-down and bottom-up paths. Select 5682 and 2338 images to train and test the model. Through practice, it can be concluded that this method can solve this problem and has good robustness to different lighting conditions and different fire conditions.

articleTitle: Application Research of “Vehicle+UAV” Mode Based on Floyd and Genetic Algorithm in 5G Era
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: UAVs are more widely used in the context of 5G. To explore the feasibility of the application of joint transport of UAVs and vehicles, the paper comb through the mathematical model research of domestic and foreign scholars for the application of UAV transport planning and propose a mathematical model for joint transport planning of UAVs and vehicles based on Floyd and genetic algorithm. In the mathematical model, the multiple constraints of single UAV-vehicle joint transport are considered, which increases the UAV path constraints, time constraints, and load constraints compared with traditional vehicle transport, and the path node constraints and time constraints for the two to carry out collaboration need to be considered, which greatly increases the complexity of the model. The Floyd algorithm and genetic algorithm are used to calculate the joint transport model of traditional vehicle transport and UAV-vehicle joint transport, and the results show that joint UAV-vehicle transport can significantly reduce delivery time. By analyzing the limitations of existing research, new directions are provided for joint UAV-vehicle transport research, including UAV constraints and transport target diversification.

articleTitle: A Regional Transmission Congestion Management Method Based on Cross-Region DC Sensitivity
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Regional transmission congestion management is one of the key issues to be solved in the construction of China's electricity spot market. A reasonable congestion management mechanism is beneficial to power system. To better deal with congestion in the regional power grid, this paper proposes a congestion management method based on sensitivity coefficient to assess the impact of intra-regional AC grid congestion on inter-regional DC power transmission and trading. A case study based on a provincial power grid of China shows that, compared to the current applied section limit method, the congestion management method based on sensitivity coefficient proposed in this paper can effectively improve the calculation accuracy and trading volume of available transmission capacity, and improve the channel utilization rate.

articleTitle: Single Cell Morphology and Dynamic Signal Analysis Based on U-Net and DeepCell
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Single-cell morphology and dynamic signal analysis are essential to reveal cell biological mechanisms and discover new phenotypes. However, there are challenges in cell segmentation and tracking, morphological feature extraction, and quantification. This paper proposes a single-cell morphology and dynamic signal analysis algorithm based on U-Net and DeepCell. First, according to the network structure and loss function of U-Net, a single cell morphology segmentation model is established, and morphological information such as cell contour, location, size, and shape is obtained. Second, to eliminate the signal interference between cells, we propose a single-cell signal-tracking model based on DeepCell. The accurate identification and quantitative analysis of cell signals are obtained by analyzing the morphological similarity and motion continuity of cells. Then, considering the morphological and signal characteristics of single cells, we construct a single-cell morphology and dynamic signal analysis model that comprehensively considers morphological changes and signal dynamics, making it more accurate in describing cells' function, state, and biological behavior. Finally, we built a single-cell morphology and dynamic signal analysis system based on U-Net and DeepCell algorithms. Simulation and experiments prove the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Tai Chi APP Simulation System Based on Computer Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, combined with motion capture, three-dimensional modeling, touch control, somatosensory interaction, mobile phone interaction, emotional interaction, stereoscopic projection and other related skills, design and implementation of shadowboxing learning system based on WebGL and natural interaction technology. The system is free of installation and maintenance on the client side. It allows users to interact with the system easily and quickly by using a variety of interaction modes through the browser. A motion space comparison module is designed Based on three - dimensional coordinate translation transform and orientation rotation transform,. It solves the problem of kinematic position comparison. The system can detect whether the overall movements and movements of each body segment are standard and give feedback. Students can practice and improve non-standard movements according to the feedback results to achieve the purpose of improving the learning effect.

articleTitle: Design of a Novel Micro Nano Aeration Automotive Exhaust Purification Device Based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This article designs a new type of micro nano aeration vehicle exhaust purification device to improve the purification efficiency of vehicle exhaust. Micro nano aeration technology is a technical method that utilizes micro nano bubbles to increase the dissolved oxygen content in water or mixed gas liquid, enhance the oxidation of water, and provide assistance in improving environmental pollution. By designing a new micro nano aeration device, the piston, water, and gas pressure in the purification device are regulated. Using the designed STM32 automatic control device and hardware circuit, the piston movement is controlled to generate negative pressure and receive real-time information transmitted by the sensor. The exhaust gas and ozone are sucked in and mixed, and water enters the reaction vessel through the water inlet. At the same time, the piston continuously pressurizes, pressing the mixture of exhaust gas and ozone gas and water towards the micro nano aeration reaction device, and finally passing through the holes on the reaction device, The micro nano diffusion of mixed gas into water generates micro nano bubbles. The rupture of micro nano bubbles generates a large number of hydroxyl radicals, combined with the strong oxidizing ability of ozone, to quickly purify car exhaust into clean gas, and continuously circulate until the exhaust is completely purified. This device can reuse the water in the container without causing waste. At the same time, it can automatically regulate the air inlet and the switch solenoid valve of the water inlet in the device through the pressure sensor installed in the reaction container, continuously circulating, and improving the quality and efficiency of tail gas purification.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis and Analysis of Automobile Low Beam System Based on Control of Electronic Control Unit
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper analyzed the composition, principle and fault diagnosis process of automobile low beam system based on control of electronic control unit. Firstly, the control form of low beam system, the composition and working principle of the low beam system controlled by electronic control unit were introduced; then the fault types, causes and diagnosis ideas of the low beam system were analyzed in detail and at last the fault diagnosis method of low beam system was described in detail by using the “fault tree analysis” diagnosis process.

articleTitle: Predictive Analysis Based on GBDT Deep Learning Regression Model in Wordle Games
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Wordle is a popular puzzle currently offered daily by the New York Times. At present, there are daily game result files of users who have participated in this game for nearly one year. The document includes the date; Competition number; Words of the day; Number of people reporting scores on that day; Number of players entering difficult mode; The percentage of words that can't be solved after 1~6 attempts. Based on this file, this paper mainly studies the influence of word attributes on report score, and creates a model to predict the distribution of report results. The attributes of words are divided into six influencing factors (Fre, Count, Sum, Repeat, Vowel, Root), and a polynomial fitting model is established to get the specific relationship. Then an ARIMA time series model is established to verify the accuracy of the model and analyze the errors. Then, according to the six influencing factors (inputs) and the relevant percentages (outputs) of future dates (1,2,3,4,5,6,X) in the question, the GBDT deep learning regression model of gradient lifting tree is established. So as to study the influence of word attributes on the percentage of relevance, and finally determine the result.

articleTitle: Research on Office Automation System Based on Computer Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, three open-source frameworks Struts, Spring and Hibernate are reasonably integrated together to build a general J2EE office automation system with the advantages of short development cycle, low development cost, loose coupling, easy to expand and migrate. This paper gives the corresponding solutions and ideas to the technical problems such as how to control the document flow, document modification and trace retention, data exchange with relational database, and guarantee the system security. The research shows that the lightweight J2EE architecture improves the system code reuse, development efficiency, and system extension and maintenance.

articleTitle: Spatial and Temporal Based Pedestrian Trajectory Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Pedestrian trajectory prediction is a critical task that aims at predicting the future movement trajectory of pedestrians over the next several seconds. Recent pedestrian trajectory prediction methods assume that the number of pedestrians and the relationship between pedestrians is constant or based on the distance, and heavily rely on contextual information and homography matrix. We propose a dynamic graph structure to describe the pedestrians, using self-attention along both the spatial and temporal dimensions. During each time step, spatial self-attention captures how pedestrians interact. The temporal self-attention predicts how pedestrians will move in the future by giving weight to the representation of prior data. Thus, we can accurately predict the pedestrian's future movements by considering their past behavior and interactions. Experiment results show that our model achieves great performance on ETH/UCY datasets.

articleTitle: Branch Load Data Anomaly Detection Based on State Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: To address the quality of branch load data within electricity customers, we propose a state estimation-based method for anomaly detection of branch load data. We perform steady state estimation of the system based on Newton-Raphson Analysis and WLS State Estimation, and then use cardinality tests for grid anomaly data. We use the IEEE14 bus system to simulate the branch load within the customer. The results show that the algorithm can effectively detect anomaly data.

articleTitle: A Real-time Reconfiguration Approach for Wireless Energy Networks Using Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In recent years, drones have found widespread applications in communications, disaster relief, and other fields. However, due to battery capacity constraints, the limited flight endurance of drones hinders their full potential. With the development of wireless charging technology, it can effectively expand the operational range and duration of drones in various scenarios. This paper investigates wireless energy networks based on wireless charging, optimizing the wireless energy network comprising power generators, relays, and energy consumption endpoints to ensure reliable power supply for drones. To enhance system response times in disaster relief and other scenarios, we propose a real-time reconfiguration approach for wireless energy networks using heterogeneous graph neural networks. By modeling the wireless energy network through a heterogeneous graph neural network and utilizing reinforcement learning methods for model training, the trained model can achieve real-time construction of wireless energy networks. Comparative experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed algorithm, which can facilitate real-time construction of wireless energy networks.

articleTitle: Research on Network Application of Intelligent Campus Based on SDN Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: There are some problems in traditional network architecture, such as traffic can not be real-time scheduling, business information can not be visualized, operation and maintenance is complex, and fault location efficiency is low. In order to meet the needs of “Digital Petroleum” network infrastructure construction, a company introduced SDN technology into the campus office network, and carried out network optimization management and innovation practice, this paper puts forward a network transformation scheme based on SDN “The network follows the people”, through deploying SDN control server and adjusting the network equipment configuration, the office network can be expanded flexibly and maintained efficiently, to meet the needs of different types of application traffic classification management and intelligent precision scheduling, effectively improve the level of intelligent network management.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Optical Character Intelligent Recognition System for Power Grid Equipment Operation Inspection Under the Background of Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper designs an intelligent calibration technology of relay protection device in substation based on intelligent recognition of optical characters. Firstly, the system uses the optical character intelligent recognition method to obtain the fixed value online check graphics. Then the obtained configuration map is matched with the fault information system data and the weak regions of fixed values are identified. In this paper, the power nameplate image recognition, adapt to its scene to do the corresponding improvement and specialization. Illumination variation, mismatching, misalignment and occlusion are preprocessed accordingly. The research shows that the fixed value intelligent checking technology of substation relay protection device based on optical character intelligent recognition can effectively improve the efficiency of fixed value intelligent checking. The system realizes the integration of high precision power equipment sign detection and text recognition. The experimental results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method for real-time detection and recognition of power equipment landmarks.

articleTitle: ESD in CMOS Integrated Circuit
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The electronic industry has developed rapidly in decades. In the process, transistors play an important role. Among them, Complementary Metal Oxide Semiconductor (CMOS) has a good performance. However, the smaller size makes the oxide layer easy to be broken. This paper mainly introduces the working principle of CMOS. Then the problems of ESD are derived. Methods of solving the Electrostatic Discharge (ESD) problem are divided into three parts, on-chip, off-chip, and SCR. In each category, several specific examples are provided. Some methods are analyzed in detail. The three methods have their own advantages and disadvantages. They should be chosen depending on the situation. Different methods can be combined to increase the performance. To decrease the damage, ESD can also be avoided by using ways such as antistatic wrist strap. The results can help the industry decrease the production of ESD and injury to CMOS IC. Electronic devices can work stably and have a longer life span if the problem of ESD can be solved properly.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Recommendation Algorithm Based on Data Mining in Credit Bank
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This article investigates the intelligent recommendation problem in credit banks and designs experiments to validate three algorithms based on association rules, clustering, and classification. In terms of data preprocessing, methods such as data cleaning and feature selection are used. In terms of algorithm implementation, the principles, implementation processes, and pseudocode of the association rule algorithm, clustering algorithm, and classification algorithm are introduced respectively. The results show that all three algorithms can effectively recommend courses suitable for users' learning needs. The research in this article provides new ideas and methods for intelligent recommendation problems in credit banks, and provides some reference for subsequent research.

articleTitle: Research on Data Multi-Scene Searchable Encryption System Based on Computer Smart Grid Security Data Fusion Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Smart grid under cloud architecture has entered a new environment of open integration. Power data is typically stored in encrypted form on cloud servers. This paper presents an encryption system based on fully homomorphic encryption for data exchange schemes. The system architecture consists of four micro-service modules. The system hardware consists of two modules. The encryption chip model used by the encryption module is LCS2110. The acquisition module is composed of carrier meter, concentrator and collector. The data supervision module uses the weak centralized management mode to supervise the electricity data transaction. On the basis of building the architecture, the system functions are realized through the combination of hardware and software. The system uses the hash SHA256 algorithm to generate a set of code word groups as the index of records. When searching, users enter multiple keywords and generate corresponding trap doors. The trap door accurately matches the index and feeds back all the matching results to the user. Experimental results show that the proposed scheme can resist known ciphertext attack, known background attack and collusion attack.

articleTitle: Unsupervised Low-Light Enhancement Method Based on Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Enhancing low-light images has been a research topic in the field of image processing. Significant advancements have been made recently using deep learning based approaches in this filed. However, obtaining the paired low/normal-light images in the same scene used for training is difficult, and the datasets lacks real-time, making its application value difficult to be verified. Meanwhile, low-light enhancement methods often ignore the local characteristics of images, which may result in local over or under exposure. To address the problems, the paper proposes a unsupervised generative adversarial network-based approach for image enhancement, incorporating attention in channel and spatial of images to improve the model generalization. Specially, our method does not require paired images as for datasets. At the generator component, we first apply channel attention into each feature map during the downsampling stage to focus on the channel information, and following the upsampling stage, the spatial attention feature map of the input image is multiplied with the generated results.we also perform a weighted summation of the input and the generated results to produce more realistic images. In discriminator component, we adopt a global-local discriminator that can enhance local regions while improving global lighting. We validate our method through extensive experiments on various benchmarks, and the results outperform the current cutting-edge methods.

articleTitle: Resource Allocation Model Based on Optimized Lagrange Relaxation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper mainly focuses on the construction of resource allocation model, which is mainly achieved by using the improved Lagrange relaxation algorithm. By using sub-gradient optimization algorithm to improve the limit value of Lagrange relaxation algorithm, the optimal coverage problem is solved and the optimized Lagrange relaxation algorithm is established. The effective and optimal coverage solutions for medical resources and daily necessities are realized respectively, and the convergence speed is accelerated under the consideration of various constraints and uncertainties. By applying this model and algorithm, decision makers can achieve efficient and fair distribution, optimize allocation efficiency and reduce the impact of large-scale epidemic on society.

articleTitle: Power Load Forecasting Model Based Long Short-Term Memory Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In order to fully exploit the correlations of time-series features in power load data and improve the accuracy of power grid load forecasting, this paper proposes a neural network load forecasting method based on long short-term memory (LSTM) network. A feature set is constructed with climate factor, date factor, and characteristic daily load factor as input. First, the data are normalized to eliminate the effect of dimensionality; then the LSTM network is used to extract the connection between the electric load and the feature values in high-dimensional space and construct the high-dimensional feature vector of the time series; finally, the parameters of the LSTM network model are trained and the load prediction values are output. Using this method to predict the electric load data of a plant area in Jiangsu Province, the results show that the proposed prediction method has significant advantages in prediction accuracy compared with BP network model, ANN network model and RF network model.

articleTitle: Training a Neural Network to Predict House Rents Using Artifical Intelligence and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: We are training neural networks to predict house rents using artificial intelligence and deep learning, which is being used in the real estate and financial industries. Real estate agents, financial institutions, and real estate developers can benefit from rent forecasting, which is an important application scenario. Many real estate websites now use machine learning models to predict rents to help tenants and landlords find the right rental price. Machine learning models are also being used by some real estate companies and financial institutions to determine rents more accurately. Training neural networks to predict rent is still a relatively new field that needs more research and experimentation to improve its performance and accuracy.

articleTitle: Application of MCU in Engineering of Intelligent Building Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In the network engineering of the intelligent buildings, the horizontal subsystem brings about a problem of cables positioning on distribution frame due to a large number of network cables. In view of the emerging generic cabling engineering of the intelligent buildings in the implementation process of each link, this article discusses engineering quality management issues. Based on MCU, a visualized network cable positioning tester has been designed, which can realize the integration of network cable source positioning and communication test, improve the working efficiency, and avoid the shortcomings of traditional double-intercom line test because of its single operability. The working condition is promoted by the visualization of test results. The corresponding treatment methods and suggestions are given. In the acceptance of network generic cabling engineering of a building in the institute, the expected result has been achieved. The application of the visualized network cable positioning tester has a reference significance both in the large network engineering and the small floor local area network. Therefore, based on the requirements of similar national and industry standards and accumulated experience in computer information network engineering, this article has mainly discussed the key points of quality monitoring for peer communication.

articleTitle: A Tampering Detection Method for Power Monitoring Data Based on Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Electric energy is an important resource related to the national economy and people's livelihood and ensuring the reliable supply of electricity plays a significant role in the healthy and stable development of the national economy. The integration of network information technology into the power industry brings intelligence and convenience, which also increases the potential security management risks in the power cyber-physical system (CPS). False data injection attack (FDIA), as one of the forms of network attacks, it can evade the detection of bad data in the state estimation of power CPS, thereby tampering with state values and seriously affecting the energy management system of power system dispatch centers. This article studies how to effectively detect false data injected into the power CPS. The main content is as follows: Firstly, this article uses the principle of FDIA to establish an attack model and obtain an attack vector to launch an attack on the power CPS. It researches a false data injection attack detection method based on dynamic estimation results combined with consistency testing and determines its detection process. Then, this article adopts a detection method based on unscented Kalman filtering (UKF) to detect FDIA, and it compares the detection effect with that based on cubature Kalman filter (CKF). The results show that the method can effectively detect false data, and its performance is superior to the CKF detection method.

articleTitle: Wind-Storage Combined Independent Pumping Power System Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In the wind-storage combined stand-alone pumping power supply system, the energy flow relationship between the four parts of the wind turbine, herder load, battery pack, and pump motor in the stand-alone wind-storage power supply and water lifting system is studied. According to different external conditions, battery charge state and energy flow in the system, a total of six operating modes are classified. The power coordination strategy and mode switching principle are designed in the wind-storage combined independent pumping power supply system, and the designed coordination control strategy is validated in the simulation platform to ensure a stable and effective operation of the system.

articleTitle: Apple Picking Grade Recognition Technology Based on Faster-RCNN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of target detection and grade recognition of automatic apple picking, this paper proposes an apple picking grade recognition technology based on Faster-RCNN deep learning network. In the early stage, the training set and test set of three categories of edible mature apples, immature apples and inedible apples were formed by collecting apple pictures under natural light and on the Internet. To adapt to the data input of the Faster-RCNN deep learning network, this paper adjusts the collected apple pictures to 227X 227 pixels and uses the Image Labeler APP provided by the MATLAB (R2021b) platform to label the data set to form labels corresponding to three categories. The Faster-RCNN deep learning network is built based on the MATLAB (R2021b) platform. Through the extraction and recognition of the characteristics of three kinds of apples, a more effective classification model is trained. The results of batch tests show that the average accuracy of recognizing GoodMatureApple, GoodImmatureApple and BadApple. is 97.24%, 96.63% and 99.45% respectively.

articleTitle: Mathematical Mechanism Analysis of Enhanced MMC
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The traditional half-bridge MMC equipped with hybrid DC circuit breaker scheme has the disadvantages of high cost and large floor space. How to realize DC fault clearing at low cost is very important. Based on the enhanced MMC scheme with fast isolation effect, this paper studies the mathematical mechanism expressions of the enhanced MMC scheme in time domain and frequency domain in each stage of fault clearance, and verifies the correctness of the mathematical mechanism expressions through MATLAB simulation experiments. The results show that the fault clearing action begins 1ms after the fault occurs, and the current through the ultral-fast disconnector (UFD) drops to 0 after about 0.5ms. This paper provides a theoretical basis for further engineering application of enhanced converter station.

articleTitle: A New Effective Kernel-Based k-Nearest Neighbor Classification Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The Z-KNN model is upgraded to the proposed model based on a Gaussian kernel. In essence, the Gaussian kernel provides a way to gauge how similar samples are, which allows for better clustering of similar samples in a space that portrays “similarity” and is thus linearly separable. Based on the Euclidean distance, the Z distance can be seen as an enhancement of the Euclidean distance. In contrast to Euclidean distance, Z distance makes the distance between data belonging to distinct classes larger than between those belonging to the same class. The input data are transferred to a high-dimensional feature space by a Gaussian kernel method, and nonlinear mapping and Z-KNN are performed in this space. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed model produces superior classification results on nonlinear data sets.

articleTitle: Research on English Translation System Based on Computer Intelligent AI Assisted Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper proposes an AI machine translation multitask system for artificial intelligence. In the hardware design of the system, STM32 microcontroller is used as the main control module. It realizes synchronous information conversion between English and sign language automatic translation system. In the aspect of system software design, CNN is used for model training and recognition of feature images. Then, the ontology fusion method of semantic unit is used to automatically extract the semantic context of English and sign language input in the system. Structured two-way translation in the order generated by decoding. JSP technology is used to design the system page to realize the timely jump of each function module page. The test results show that the functions of the session module and the dialogue module meet the requirements of interactive design. It can effectively improve the quality of English machine translation.

articleTitle: Research and Application Based on Markov and Genetic Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, a Markov model and genetic algorithm were used to make predictions based on the Kenyan data set, and the predictions were good. In addition, the correlation analysis allows to obtain results determined by a model that is well above the test threshold and the confidence interval of the parameter estimates does not contain zero, so the model is valid. We can conclude that the two indicators interact with each other and have a moderate correlation with the temporal evaluation, proving that the Markov model and the genetic algorithm have a good predictive effect for the Kenyan dataset, with a view to providing some implications for the prediction of other data.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Dingo Optimization Algorithm and Other Biological Heuristic Algorithms in Power System Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Aiming at the power system optimization problem, this paper compares the dingo optimization algorithm with biological heuristic algorithms. First, the definition and importance of power system optimization and the application and limitations of biological heuristic algorithms in the domain are introduced. Second, this paper expounds on the characteristics and advantages of the dingo optimization algorithm. In the research foundation and critical technology, the principle, steps, parameter setting, and performance evaluation of the dingo optimization algorithm are explained and made in comparison with other biological heuristic algorithms. Then, for the power system optimization problem, we propose the power system economic dispatch model, reactive power optimization model, fault diagnosis model, and planning and design model. Finally, the main contents of the research are summarized, and the potential practice of the dingo optimization algorithm in power system optimization is emphasized. Experiments and simulations demonstrate the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Vision and Image Processing Technology in Bridge Condition Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Cloud monitoring system for bridge health based on computer vision, including visual terminal and cloud server; The vision terminal sends the pre processed image data to the ECS through WAN and 5G; The ECS carries out 3D reconstruction according to image data to obtain the 3D reconstruction model, and compares it with the 3D design drawing of the bridge to obtain the 3D comparison result; According to the three-dimensional comparison results, the current bridge health status is diagnosed. In this paper, the image data of the bridge is collected through computer vision technology. The installation and maintenance are much more convenient than the traditional collection terminals based on mechanical and electronic sensors, acoustic vibration sensors and photoelectric sensors; Each visual terminal can cover an area, while the sensor can only be placed at a fixed point, so the installation workload is much less than the latter; The deformation of the bridge can be displayed in the form of three-dimensional images. Compared with the data collected by sensors, the health diagnosis of the bridge is more convenient and accurate.

articleTitle: Analysis of Wordle Response Results Based on Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Wordle is a word-guessing game; the answer is usually a word consisting of five letters. Players get feedback after each word guess, and thus get the correct answer based on one or more feedbacks. In this paper, we built a machine learning model for the number of players and their responses in 2022. The results show that: (1) The change pattern of the number of players shows a roughly decreasing trend. (2) There is no significant correlation between Hard percent and word attributes. (3) It is possible to predict the results of their responses when the specific words are known. Finally, we analyzed the available response data and found some other interesting features.

articleTitle: Restoration of Damaged Mural Images Based on Recurrent Feature Inference and Global-Local Attention
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In the process of repairing damaged mural images, it is often overlooked that these images have unique painting techniques. To address this issue, we propose a method based on recurrent feature inference and global-local attention for restoring damaged mural images. In order to enhance the ability of the network model to capture the structural and textural features specific to mural images, we designed a coherent semantic attention inference module at the feature inference stage of the network model. Additionally, we replaced the original attention module with a global-local attention module in the feature inference stage to strengthen the connection between missing and background regions and generate high-quality feature maps based on the morphological characteristics of the mural. Experimental results show that our method can significantly improve the semantic disorder and pseudo-shadow phenomenon in mural images repaired by other algorithms, and generate more detailed information for damaged mural images, thus making the results of mural image restoration more natural and accurate.

articleTitle: Research on Scheduling Method of Liftable Shuttle Based on VNS-ACO Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Using the liftable shuttle car to complete the three-dimensional storage and transport is a new form of application. This new form can greatly reduce the waiting time of the shuttle car caused by the cooperation of the elevator and the shuttle car. By analyzing the workflow of multi shuttle three-dimensional storage system, a scheduling model aims at minimizing delivery time as the optimization objective is established. In the process of solving, the traditional ant colony algorithm(ACO)is easy to fall into local optimization, the variable neighborhood search strategy(VNS)is introduced to expand the search range of the solution and enhance the ability of the algorithm to jump out of local optimization. Experiments show that the scheduling method of the multi shuttle three-dimensional storage system designed in this paper can effectively reduce the system delivery time and improve the delivery scheduling efficiency by 25%..

articleTitle: A Study and Application of Planning Model Based on Principal Component Analysis and Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Reinforcement learning has been widely implemented in different domains due to its ability to interact in order to obtain improved strategies, showing the generality of the algorithm. The adaptability of reinforcement learning to different strategies allows it to be well applied to dynamic planning problems. In this paper, a two-stage, two-level evaluation metric system is designed for evaluation, with the first stage chosen to use principal component analysis and the second stage to use reinforcement learning for assignment. A case study is presented to evaluate the reliable performance of the method. Via the sensitivity analysis of indicators and comparison with the order allocation using dynamic programming approach, the two-stage model is verified to have a higher allocation accuracy and shorter calculation time.

articleTitle: An Application Comparison of GAN-based Image Translation Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Image translation is an important and challenging area of computer vision. It aims to design models that translate source-domain images to target-domain images with applications such as data enhancement, style migration and super-resolution. Until 2016, researchers have successfully implemented generative adversarial networks to image translation using the findings of deep learning techniques for visual generation tasks. In this paper, we first review and analyze the literature in the field of GAN-based image translation and summarize common normalization techniques and model judging metrics. In accordance with the mapping connection between the model inputs and outputs, self-supervised and unsupervised methods to image translation models are then split into categories. The strengths and weaknesses of these models are then analyzed, and a short explanation of how each model performed on various evaluation indicators. Finally, several potential future research issues in this field are discussed.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Remote Control System for Photovoltaic Cleaning Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Studies have shown that surface particles and accumulated dust from human activities are important factors that affect the power generation of photovoltaic power plants. Therefore, regular cleaning of solar panels is necessary. However, traditional manual or engineering vehicle cleaning methods require on-site supervision and cannot be operated remotely, while being limited by time. In order to effectively improve the efficiency of cleaning the dust on the surface of photovoltaic panels, this paper proposes a scheme based on WebSocket protocol for remote control of photovoltaic cleaning robots through HTML5 and WeChat mini-programs. The scheme uses the WebSocket protocol to transmit data through the WorkerMan server, thus enabling communication between the client and the photovoltaic robot. The practical results show that the system achieves information management and intelligent control of photovoltaic cleaning robots, achieves fully automated cleaning without on-site manual operation, reduces operating costs, improves work efficiency and economic benefits, and provides scientific basis for the operation and management of photovoltaic power plants.
