articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Computing Fuzzy Information Signal Processing System Based on Computer Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper presents the concepts of comparative likelihood and multiplication of intuitionistic fuzzy information. Then a design scheme of all - light fuzzy intelligent information processing system is proposed. Finally, this paper integrates computer big data technology and establishes corresponding optimization model based on intuitionistic fuzzy entropy weight theory and relative entropy principle to discuss the solution of the model. The effectiveness of the algorithm and the advantage of better time are demonstrated by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Application of Factor Analysis Optimization Error Back Propagation Algorithm FA-BP Neural Network Equipment Fault Diagnosis Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: To enhance the precision of equipment fault diagnosis, a novel device fault diagnosis method based on factor analysis (FA) and an improved error back propagation (BP) algorithm has been proposed. An FA-BP neural network diagnosis model has been developed to enable intelligent diagnosis of equipment faults. Firstly, three common factors influencing motor faults were extracted using FA, which served as effective input data for the BP neural network. Subsequently, the data that was optimized by factor analysis was utilized as the input layer of the BP neural network, and the data were trained and tested by employing Matlab software. Eventually, the results of fault diagnosis prediction obtained from the FA-BP neural network model were compared with those attained using the traditional BP neural network. The experimental findings affirm that the improved model achieves significantly elevated accuracy of equipment fault prediction and swifter training speed compared to the traditional error back propagation algorithm.

articleTitle: A Sequential Recommendation Model Combining Contrastive Learning and Self-Attention
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Sequential recommendation dynamically model user interests for item recommendations based on the user's historical interaction behavior with the item. Existing sequential recommendation algorithms usually consider only the order of user actions and ignore the information of time interval between user actions; And the data sparsity problem when training the model leads to limited recommendation performance. For this purpose this work proposes a sequential recommendation model that combines contrastive learning and self-attention(CLSSRec). First, the recommendation performance is improved by capturing the relationship patterns between items and interaction sequential time intervals through the embedded self-attention module; Second, the contrastive learning view is constructed based on node representations using a neuron masking model augmentation method to alleviate the data sparsity issue; Finally, our model experiments on both Home and Sports datasets, outperforming the baseline model on the recommendation performance metrics of Recall@k and NDCG@k, demonstrating the effectiveness of the CLSSRec model.

articleTitle: Wordle Game Result Prediction Based on XGBoost Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Wordle is a popular puzzle currently offered daily in the New York Times. The purpose of this paper is to develop a predictive model that predicts the percentage of different attempts made to solve the game. First, we calculated the five Spearman correlation coefficients representing the word attribute and the percentage of hard mode separately and found no significant relationship between the word attribute and the percentage of hard mode scores. To predict the percentage of different attempts in the results, we built a multimodal model. The Informer algorithm was used to analyze the time series, and the XGBoost algorithm was used to analyze the word attribute data, and then the model was improved using the attention mechanism and the sliding window mechanism. The final prediction of the percentage of attempts was made for the word “EERIE” on March 1, 2023.

articleTitle: A Prediction Model for Wind Power Reserve Capacity Based on PSO-BP Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This study presents a model for estimating wind power reserve capacity using a neural network method, with a focus on the effects of wind power volatility and randomness on power grid dispatching. The proposed model employs the particle swarm algorithm to optimize the weights between the connection layers in the backpropagation neural network. This optimization aims to enhance the accuracy of predicting future power values in wind power systems. Additionally, the model utilizes the Pearson correlation coefficient to identify the influencing factors that exhibit a positive relationship with the prediction error. Subsequently, a multivariate regression method is employed to establish the correlation between the extracted influencing factors and the calculation of wind power reserve capacity. This study presents an analysis of a computation example utilizing the real operational data obtained from a wind farm located in Belgium. The simulation results indicate that 80% of the prediction errors fall within the estimation interval of the model, providing more evidence to support the efficacy of the approach.

articleTitle: Design of H-Bridge Circuit for CMOS Stimulator and its Application Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The relationship between nerve signals and electrical signals promotes the develop of neural stimulators. The Complementary Metal Oxide Semiconductor (CMOS) technology brings benefits to the development of implantable nerve stimulators. This paper reviews the theoretical basis of neural stimulator as well as its common structure. In part 3, an experiment based on software simulation is conducted to study the behavior of ‘H’ bridge. Some optimization of digital to analog converter is discussed in part 4. Experiment shows that the ‘H’ bridge has stale control to produce biphasic current. Studies show that current mirrors widely used in the design of neural stimulator which is included in DAC and also used in the output driver to increase output resistance. Blocking capacitors and optimized DAC are equipped in the stimulators to address the safety issues. CMOS technology, with its excellent characteristics such as low power consumption, provides the possibility of optimal design scheme for neurostimulators and neurostimulators have great potential for development.

articleTitle: Research on a Technology of Mail Anti-virus Gateway for Industrial Internet
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the rapid rise of the Industrial Internet, emails that convey a large amount of information require a strong network security environment. Aiming at the increasingly complex mail virus prevention and control work under the background of the industrial Internet, this paper designs and implements a mail anti-virus gateway system. First, design the overall process and structure of the mail virus processing system; then, design an extended mail receiving and sending protocol on the basis of the public framework, thereby ensuring the convenience of the system for use in different roles and environments. In the detection and filtering part of mail virus, an anti-virus engine containing multiple sub-function modules is designed to detect and filter viruses in mail text and attachments. Through the function test of 1000 kinds of virus mails, it is found that the mail anti-virus gateway system designed in this article can detect and filter most types of mail viruses. Compared with the virus detection on the client and server, the anti-virus gateway system has better performance And efficiency.

articleTitle: Optimal Deployment of Heterogeneous Wireless Sensor Networks Based on Improved Flower Pollination Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, an improved flower pollination algorithm (IFPA) is proposed to address the problem of ineffective signal coverage across the entire area in heterogeneous wireless sensor node deployment. The algorithm presented builds upon the foundational flower pollination algorithm (FPA) and effectively tackles challenges related to sluggish convergence and susceptibility to local optima. This is achieved through the incorporation of nonlinear convergence factors and Cubic mapping techniques, which collectively contribute to its enhanced efficiency and reduced likelihood of getting trapped in local optima. Specifically, the IFPA replaces the global pollination scaling factor with a nonlinear convergence factor to improve convergence speed and better control the global search range. Additionally, the algorithm utilizes Cubic mapping technology to maintain diversity in the population during the later iterations, preventing the algorithm from falling into local optima. The experimental outcomes illustrate the superior performance of the Improved Flower Pollination Algorithm (IFPA) in optimizing the deployment of wireless sensor networks (WSNs). Notably, IFPA achieves higher coverage rates while significantly reducing network deployment costs. Therefore, the proposed algorithm has the potential for wide-ranging applications, contributing to improving wireless sensor network performance and cost reduction.

articleTitle: Research on Jacket Digital Twin Prediction Technology Based on LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper a prediction technique for deep-water jacket digital twin model based on long short term memory network (LSTM) is proposed. By studying the long and short memory network technology, the random effect of environmental parameters was studied. Combined with the environmental parameters of the area where the jacket is located and operating time database of the jacket, the digital twin model of the jacket structure is predicted. Realize the synchronization and real-time update of the digital twin physical model of the jacket. It obtain more accurate jacket structure prediction results. Compared with the simulation model database, the jacket digital twin prediction model base on LSTM technology has higher accuracy and saves training time of the model.

articleTitle: Research on Data Science Processing System Under Computer Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper designs a digital signal processor based on computer virtual reality technology. The system uses multi-core cooperative work to complete data processing and storage. The system consists of four layers: hardware abstraction layer, system core layer, distributed message communication mechanism and system service layer. Its multi-task kernel implements preemptive scheduling based on priority, synchronization and communication primitives between tasks, real-time interrupt processing and application-oriented cache management mechanism. The system also designed LCD module and keyboard module as man-machine interaction interface. The hardware interface diagram is given. The realization of software programming is also discussed. The experimental results show that multi-core collaborative processing is used to complete data processing and storage functions. The single-core resource utilization rate is effectively reduced by 26%.

articleTitle: FPGA Theoretical Analysis and Its Advantage Comparison in Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the continuous development of The Times and technology, artificial intelligence algorithm and AI technology based on Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) technology have been widely used in people's life. This paper introduces the extensive application of artificial intelligence technology in production and life in recent years and its challenges. In view of the complexity of AI algorithm operation, real-time requirements and fast update and iteration characteristics, this paper proposes that FPGA chip can better solve these problems. This paper introduces the working principle of FPGA chip to realize digital processing and other hardware resources in detail, and analyzes the application advantages of FPGA in AI industry, life, and engineering. Compared with other chips, FPGA has the characteristics of low cost and flexible implementation of new algorithms, to achieve the balance between performance and cost. Finally, this paper summarizes the advantages of FPGA compared with other chips, and puts forward the possible development way and development platform in the future.

articleTitle: Residual Learning with Bi-LSTM and Multi-Head Attention for Multi-Modal Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Multimodal emotion recognition has a wide range of applications in the fields of intelligent recommendation and human-computer interaction. In recent research on emotion recognition, the model using recurrent neural network could observe the context semantic information and infer the emotion label jointly according to the context information, but it lacked the capture of key information and did not solve the problem of network degradation. Therefore, this paper designs a model based on Bi-LSTM, multi-head attention mechanism and residual connection fusion (Att-BiLSTM). The Bi-LSTM structure realizes the context semantic inference function, the multi-head attention mechanism realizes the emphasis on key information, and the residual connection alleviates the network degradation caused by the overfitting problem. Att-BiLSTM achieves 62.1% precision and 61.8% recall on the IEMOCAP dataset, which is better than the existing comparison algorithms.

articleTitle: Flexible Load Scheduling of Intelligent Buildings Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Intelligent buildings include scattered and large amount of flexible load, facing a large number of air conditioning equipment, the model mechanism is complex, and the traditional optimizer takes a long time to solve. In order to solve the above problems, this paper proposes the deep reinforcement learning method to optimize the running state of load. Firstly, the framework of the building load control system in the current popular stage is proposed, and the optimization process is introduced. Secondly, a reinforcement learning model applicable to the building is built, and the equipment status and real-time electricity price information are obtained in real time. The efficient processing capacity of the reinforcement learning algorithm is used to optimize the equipment status in the next period. Finally, a building is simulated and compared with the traditional optimizer to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Culture Digital Display System Based on Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This system uses SSH framework, MySQL design database, Java language as the core to write culture digital display system background business logic. The front page using JSP dynamic web page technology can fully display a variety of ethnic cultural resources. At the same time the system is convenient for users to browse and query efficiently through the Web at any time. This paper constructs and analyzes the integrated system of digital protection and management of minority culture from three aspects: database design, function design, key issues and technical strategies. The system can mix audio stream and video stream with real-time 3D graphics, which is very suitable for virtual display in interactive access and realistic performance.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Network-Based Novel Framework for Ship Recognition in Poor Visibility Maritime Surveillance Videos
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Ship recognition is a central component of the information perception for smart ships. Traditionally, the ship recognition mission is completed by remote sensing or synthetic aperture radar (SAR) or manual calibration via maritime surveillance video. However, the difficulty arises in implementing the mission when it suffers the weather with a poor visibility. The recognition accuracy may deteriorate dramatically in such a hostile environment, especially in the heavy fog environment at sea when using conventional methods. In this case, we develop a novel framework for ship recognition based on a smart recognition system that relies on the dark channel defogging and the neural networks. First, a dark-channel defogging algorithm is utilized to remove the adverse impact of poor visibility on recognition. After that, three different neural networks are used to train the defogged images (Specifically: Faster-RCNN, SSD, YOLOv3). Finally, we present qualitative and quantitative analyses of three different neural network models. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in a hostile environment, especially in fog weather with poor visibility at sea.

articleTitle: Analysis and Prediction of Wordle Dataset Based on ARIMA and Grey Verhulst Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper counts the scores of 359 days based on Wordle dataset, and then builds a time series model and a gray Verhulst prediction model, using the two predicted values as the score interval on March 1, 2023, where the time series model prediction is rounded to 20602 and the gray Verhulst prediction model prediction is rounded to 21105. According to the model, we conclude that the Number of reported results show a variation of increasing, then decreasing, and finally stabilizing. Combining the two models above, the number interval for the results reported on March 1, 2023 approximaely should be[20602,21105]. The model has strong stability, and I hope this paper can provide some reference for the prediction of other data sets.

articleTitle: A Detection Algorithm Based on SegFormer for Unmanned Driving
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Semantic segmentation matters in unmanned driving. The accuracy of semantic segmentation determines whether the vehicle can accurately identify the object on the road during driving. At present, the most popular semantic segmentation algorithm is deep learning network model with convolutional neural network as the main body, while SegFormer based on encoder and decoder proposed in recent years has not been introduced into the field of unmanned semantic segmentation. Aiming at this problem, this paper firstly divides the city road images into several small blocks. Secondly, the obtained block is sent to the encoder as input to get the multilayer feature maps. Finally, the feature maps are sent to the decoder predictive segmentation mask. On the Cityscape dataset, using SegFormer improved mIoU accuracy by an average of 6.564% compared to algorithms such as DeepLabV3+ and FPN, and SegFormer mIoU(ms+flip) similarly improved accuracy by an average of 6.072% in the case of data enhancement. It can be seen that SegFormer has unique advantages in the field of semantic segmentation, and will play an infinite potential in unmanned driving technology.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Computer Information Service Terminal System Under Deep Learning Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper proposes a deep learning-based anomaly detection method for cloud computing service terminal system. The system applies Shannon information theory to the measurement of information loss in dimension reduction to calculate the amount of information loss in the process of deep learning dimension reduction. Through the embedded information terminal hardware function design and extension. This paper describes the implementation process of Linux operating system transplantation, SQLite database protocol extension and information interaction service on the embedded terminal device. The experimental results show that the Web system log has higher accuracy in detecting complex anomalies than the existing methods.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Furniture System Based on Computer Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper designs a smart home system based on ZigBee wireless sensor network. The smart home system is mainly composed of four parts: environment perception, data network transmission, cloud database and user application. The system collects all kinds of environmental factors related to security, such as temperature, gas, smoke and so on, and detects illegal intrusion through infrared detection technology. A complete hardware data acquisition platform is constructed. The system can intuitively grasp the working state of various sensors on all nodes through the smart home gateway. The system can centrally control all kinds of electrical appliances and realize remote control through mobile phone terminals. The experimental simulation shows that ZigBee technology has the characteristics of low power consumption, scalability and high practicability when applied to low-speed domain network.

articleTitle: A Fine-Grained Reliability Evaluation Method Considering Dual-Chain-Loop Mode
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This study focuses on the unique dual-chain-loop wiring method in the power distribution network, and investigates the N-l faults of the main transformer in the substation, N-l and N-2 faults of the busbar in the substation, N-l and N-2 faults of the feeder, and the busbar fault in the switch station. A fine-grained reliability assessment method considering the dual-chain-loop wiring mode is proposed. This assessment method takes the advanced distribution network in modern cities as the research object, and uses the load outage time as the switch action time to calculate the system reliability assessment indicators, including the system average interruption frequency index (SAIFI), the system average interruption duration index (SAIDI), the customer average interruption frequency index (CAIDI), and the average supply availability index (ASAI). Feasibility is verified by constructing a standard case with the dual-chain-loop distribution network.

Author Keywords: power distribution network reliability assessment method

articleTitle: A Continuous Road Network Planning Model Based on Robustness Objectives
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The continuous network design problem refers to optimizing the performance of the whole system by increasing the capacity of existing links. In this study, a continuous road network planning model is established considering robustness. This model is a bi-level programming model. The upper level model is a multi-objective model within limited fund. When the system is disturbed, the goals of the upper level model are to minimize the generalized cost changes for all users and maximize the whole efficiency of the road network. The lower level model is an improved Beckmann user equilibrium assignment model, which takes into account the variation of the actual link capacity caused by emergencies. A simple road network is selected to verify the valid of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Information-Based Word Extraction Modeling
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In Wordle, the words used in the game are used to train and evaluate the model used for recognizing the solution word and identifying the attributes associated with each category of the given words associated with each category of the given words. Meanwhile, the words are used to create training and testing datasets, which are used to train and evaluate the model. The training data consists of a set of words that are labeled with their solution words and the categories associated with the given words. The model is then trained on this data to learn how to recognize the solution word and identify the associated categories. During the training process, the model is exposed to a wide range of words and categories, allowing it to learn patterns and associations between words and categories. The model is trained using various machine learning algorithms, including deep learning techniques, which can learn complex The model is trained using various machine learning algorithms, including deep learning techniques, which can learn complex relationships between words and categories. Once the model is trained, it is tested using a separate set of data that was not used in the training process. The testing data consists of words that the model has not seen before, and the model's accuracy in recognizing the solution word and identifying the categories associated with the given words is evaluated. The testing data consists of words that the model has not seen before, and the model's accuracy in recognizing the solution word and identifying the categories associated with the given words is evaluated.

articleTitle: Research on Power Prediction Model of Solar Photovoltaic System Based on ARIMA Time Series
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This article establishes a distributed photovoltaic system output power prediction model based on ARIMA time series and neural network, as well as a distributed photovoltaic system output power prediction model based on ARIMA time series and support vector machine, and compares the prediction errors of three prediction models. The analysis results show that compared with the other two prediction models, the prediction error based on ARIMA time series and support vector machine prediction model is smaller. Under sunny, hazy, cloudy, and rainy conditions, the prediction errors of the model are 7.02%, 9.13%, 9.35%, and 9.48%, respectively. The annual prediction error of the model is 13.65%.

articleTitle: Research of Image Storage Technology Based on Memristor 2T2M Array
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper proposes two memristor array memory structures for binary and grey-scale images. The memristor memory array is simulated, and the memory cross-array based on 2T2M has been designed for reading and writing operations. This effectively reduces the number of memory cells required for storage, allowing for a decrease in space utilized and an increase in storage density per single memory cell. Through this, the efficiency of storage can be improved, providing an enriched theoretical basis for utilizing memristors in image processing.

articleTitle: Data Analysis of Wordle Crossword Game Based on Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Wordle is a popular puzzle game that is currently offered daily on The New York Times. Users upload game data on Twitter, and based on this data file, we conducted some research. First, we chose to build a BP neural network by starting with pre-processing the data, digitally transforming the words, and determining the input and output sets. Through the structural steps of input layer, hidden layer and output layer, the machine learning was adjusted several times to finally get the most reasonable parameters, and finally the data was processed and predicted after error analysis to get the percentage of attempts for the future game results. For word difficulty classification, we choose optimization algorithms and use more innovative ideas, such as SSE; “elbow” method - K-value determination; CH coefficient, etc. To investigate the relationship between multiple indicators, first, machine learning methods are used to assign importance scores to each indicator to construct a factor analysis clustering model, and then exploratory factor analysis is completed to reduce the dimensionality and visualization of multiple variables, thus revealing the differences of each indicator more intuitively. For the quirky attributes of words, a discriminant function is built to analyze the classification accuracy and complete the proof.

articleTitle: Real-Time Pulse Monitoring and Analysis Realized by Organic Near-Infrared Photodetector with Detection Region Up to 1550nm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Near-infrared organic photodetectors (NIR-OPDs) nowadays have become a hot research filed because of their advantages such as flexibility, solution-processed preparation and low cost. However, in the region of NIR window II (900–1700 nm), as an important and key role in biological detection and imaging due to its better penetration in tissues, the relevant research results are still insufficient. Here, we construct a binary bulk heterojunction by utilizing non-fullerene narrow band gap materials, that is employing PPHTQ:IEICO-4Cl hybrid film as photosensitive layer. The dark current of the NIR-OPD we prepared is low to 3.66×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−11</sup>A when no bias is applied. Meanwhile, a good responsivity of approaching 100 mA/W is achieved. Therefore, a nice detectivity which is over 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sup> Jones at 940 nm in near-infrared window II is realized. In the view of the high-performance characteristics of the device and the well penetration characteristics at 940 nm in NIR window II, we carry out real-time monitoring of human being pulse behaviors. From the obtained arterial signals, we can get the heart rate, cardiac cycle, diastolic period, the systolic period and dicrotic notch as the key physiological parameters. Our NIR-OPD provides a new strategy for building high-performance near-infrared window II organic photodetectors and its significant applications of signal detection in biological or human body.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning-Based Data Scheduling for MPTCP in Streaming Media Delivery
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, an MPTCP scheduling method based on DQN is proposed, which aims to solve the dynamic adaptive problem in the process of video streaming media transmission by introducing the chunk manager. To address the problem of performance degradation caused by targeting only a single performance metric in the DASH environment, a reward function is proposed that uses two metrics, throughput and chunk download time, and aims to help the intelligence to better learn the video chunk delivery policy. The proposed use of a chunk manager helps the DQN to understand the chunk information, which is used to accurately detect the transmission status of video chunks and pass the chunk information to the scheduler. Finally the use of online training and offline decision making can make the DQN more efficient and flexible, enabling it to better adapt to complex environments and tasks. It is experimentally verified that the DQN-based data scheduling algorithm proposed in this paper has some performance improvement over the classical MPTCP data scheduling algorithm, and the DQN-based scheduling algorithm keeps the download time distribution of chunks at a low and stable level.

articleTitle: Research on Power Supply of Electric Isolation Valve in the Containment of CPR1000 Unit
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The rationality of power supply mode of electric isolation valve in the containment of CPR1000 unit is analyzed, and the improved mode of power supply is put forward. In this study, a domestic CPR1000 unit was designed, and according to the requirements of SOP, the electric isolation valve in each containment was analyzed in the case of large LOCA, to judge whether it can perform its design function in such superposed working condition. The research results show that some of the electric isolation valves can not normally fulfill the requirements of the guidance operation and response under this condition. Therefore, this paper proposes an improved power supply mode to ensure the integrity of the containment and control the unit status.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Cooperative Control Strategy of String Photovoltaic Inverter Cluster
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: String photovoltaic inverter is the core device of photovoltaic cluster grid-connected system. When multiple PV inverters operate in parallel, due to the interaction between the LCL filter and the system circuit, there is a large resonance risk in the grid-connected current. To solve this problem, a hierarchical cooperative control strategy for PV inverter cluster is proposed. In the first layer, the LCL filter capacitor is connected with virtual resistance + capacitor in parallel, which increases the main body damping of the inverter and suppresses the parallel resonance of the inverter. In the second layer, PCC voltage feed-forward is introduced to introduce equivalent virtual inductance to suppress the resonance between the photovoltaic cluster and the power grid. The simulation and experimental results show that the total harmonic distortion rate of the grid-connected current decreases from 9.43% to 0.17% and the degree of reduction reaches 98.2% after the parallel system of two series photovoltaic inverters is adopted, which verifies the correctness and feasibility of the strategy.

articleTitle: Research on Quality Management Efficiency Based on AHP Fuzzy Algorithm and Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This article is based on the AHP fuzzy algorithm, combined with the Analytic Hierarchy Process to compare models and study the effectiveness and robustness of the algorithm. Through a comparative study of 8 different algorithm cases, the effectiveness of the AHP algorithm was verified. The evaluation results showed that this paper is more reliable, and the use of fuzzy set algorithm results in stronger system consistency and better robustness.

articleTitle: Power Allocation Optimization Strategy of Gravity Energy Storage Based on Load Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In view of the limited capacity of peak regulation and frequency modulation (PRFM for short) in power system, an optimization strategy of PRFM power distribution in gravity energy storage system (GESS for short) based on load forecasting is proposed in this paper. Firstly, a load forecasting model based on GAN network is established to accurately predict the load in the power system, so as to provide planning and dispatching reference for the GESS to participate in PRFM. On this basis, considering the benefits, costs and constraints of the GESS to participate in PRFM auxiliary services, the GESS economic model participating in PRFM power distribution is established, and the particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to optimize the solution and determine the optimal power distribution result of the GESS. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed power allocation optimization strategy is verified by using the simulation platform.

articleTitle: Inverse Synthetic Aperture Radar Image Target Recognition Based on Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Since the main observation objects of Inverse Synthetic Aperture Radar (ISAR) are non-cooperative targets and the number of ISAR images is limited due to the observation conditions, it is difficult to meet the requirements of training data on automatic target recognition methods based on depth learning. Existing ISAR image target recognition methods based on deep neural network achieve poor performance because of the insufficient training samples, this paper proposes a deep neural network based on transfer learning to alleviate this problem. The transfer network unit can learn relevant knowledge from the optical image field and transfer to the ISAR image recognition field to alleviate the problem of data sparsity, so as to improve the recognition accuracy. We conducts several experiments to verify the proposed method. The experimental results show that our proposed method performs better compared with the traditional CNN based method.

articleTitle: Research on Real-Time Speech Transcription Optimization Based on Recurrent Neural Network Transducer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Real-time speech transcription has problems such as low recognition accuracy, poor generalization, and poor audio and video fusion in complex environments. We propose a real-time speech transcription optimization method based on the Recurrent neural network Transducer model to solve these problems. First, according to the principle and advantages of the Recurrent neural network Transducer model, the application scenarios and challenges in real-time speech transcription are analyzed. Second, to improve the encoder performance of the model, a model encoder optimization based on the Conformer network is proposed, which uses its convolution and self-attention layers to model local and global speech context information. Then, to improve the model's generalization ability, a model training strategy based on a sparse self-attention mechanism is proposed. By introducing sparse constraints, the self-attention layer's computational complexity and memory consumption are reduced, and the model's adaptability to speeches in various fields is enhanced. Finally, the researchers proposed an improved model predictor based on Transformer network to realize multimodal information fusion of audio and video speech transcription. The video stream is used as an additional input source to learn the interaction between audio and video features through the Transformer network, thereby improving the robustness of speech transcription. In addition, a real-time speech transcription system based on Recurrent neural network Transducer model is built. Simulation and experimental verification prove the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Systematic Study of Oral English Practice in Computer Multimedia Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper designs an oral English training system based on human-computer interaction. The hardware structure of the system is composed of C8051F021 microcontroller, LM317 chip, LM337 chip, A/D chip and IN5822 diode. The system software is developed under Windows7 operating platform. C+ language is used to develop the system's business logic components and training strategies. After collecting the test signal, the signal is denoised to suppress the interference of noise. Then the feature vector is extracted from the signal and the hidden Markov model is introduced to build a signal classifier to get the test results. Software and hardware are combined to complete the design of oral English training system based on human-computer interaction. Finally, the system selects 50 training items from 400 training questions to test you. The experimental results show that the training strategy based on human-computer interactive oral English training system has met the design requirements.

articleTitle: Prediction Demonstration of Elman Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The Elman neural network is used on predicting time series information in this paper, and compared with the prediction outcomes of the BP neural network and the ARIMA model. The conclusion is that the Elman neural network model is better performance on predicting time series data.

articleTitle: Research on Anomaly Test Data Processing Method Based on Wavelet Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: A large amount of test data and test data will be generated in the stages of equipment development, design, setting and use. Meanwhile, due to the easy impact of external environment in the process of data collection, the quality of collected data will be reduced. If the processing of abnormal data is not accurate enough, the analysis and evaluation of test results will be affected. Study the corresponding data processing methods to ensure the accuracy of test data and support the analysis and evaluation of test results. Aiming at the problems existing in traditional abnormal data processing methods, this paper optimizes the existing wavelet analysis based on theoretical research and mathematical calculation, and summarizes an effective method for processing signal abnormal data, which provides effective support for the analysis and interpretation of test results.

articleTitle: Research on Network Attack Vulnerability Prediction Based on Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The identification and prediction of simulated network attacks using artificial neural networks have achieved the prediction of simulated network attacks and transformed them into clear information for security management personnel, striving for defense time and preparation for counterattacks. This article is based on Python and utilizes artificial neural network models and ANN algorithms to preprocess data, adjust model parameters, perform fitting and recognition, present text, and complete feature extraction, data cleaning, and model training of simulated network attack data. The aim is to train ANN artificial neural network models to identify and predict simulated network attack data.

articleTitle: 5G Base Station Siting Scheme Based on Improved Immune Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The fifth generation mobile communication technology (5G) improves network performance in terms of delay and throughput, and can meet the explosive growth of future user mobile data traffic. Behind it is the need for more base stations and higher construction costs to maintain uniform coverage of network signals. Aiming at the problem of site planning in weak coverage area, this paper proposes a design scheme based on improved immune genetic algorithm. This scheme is suitable for how to plan the site reasonably to control the construction cost under the premise of satisfying the full coverage of weak coverage points, and completes the expected goal of high coverage and low cost. On the basis of combining the global search characteristics of genetic algorithm, the multipeak search characteristics of immune algorithm and the twoway implementation of elite retention strategy and roulette game strategy in the immune selection process to select highquality offspring antibodies, this paper introduces the concept of average cost. In the iterative process, the average cost within the coverage of the base station is used as the threshold, which can quickly select the appropriate base station type, reduce the time cost of iteration, and obtain a better feasible solution.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Material Data for Digital Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The organization mode of “headquarters and multi-factories” has been widely developed in manufacturing enterprises. Although the multi-production base model meets the needs of rapid business expansion, it puts forward higher requirements for enterprise management. The differences in cost accounting methods, planning methods, and operation modes of the factories under the headquarters lead to different production management organizations, purchasing organizations, and sales organizations. Because the basic materials are managed by the headquarters, each factory can only select the required materials from the headquarters material warehouse. Therefore, there is a phenomenon that the same item corresponds to multiple business views. In this paper, the full attribute management mode of material data is taken as the research object, and a full attribute management solution with material code and factory code as the unique identification is proposed. It provides the theoretical basis and practical guidance for the application and promotion of material data life cycle management in multi-factory mode.

articleTitle: Food Recognition and Classification Based on Image Recognition: A Study Utilizing PyTorch and PReNet
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this study, we address the prevailing gap in food-specific image recognition models by developing an innovative solution using the PyTorch framework and the Predictive REcurrent Neural Network (PReNet). We introduce a tailored food recognition model, constructed upon the robust architecture of convolutional neural networks (CNNs), specifically optimized to enhance accuracy in food classification tasks. Harnessing the power of a comprehensive food dataset, our model significantly surpasses the performance benchmarks set by traditional image recognition models. This study not only advances the academic dialogue in this domain but also facilitates practical applications across health, nutrition, and lifestyle sectors. By demonstrating the formidable potential of the PyTorch framework and PReNet in this unique use-case, we underscore the promising avenues for future exploration and development.

articleTitle: Study on Optimizing BP Neural Network Based on Genetic Algorithm to Predict Wordle Report Results
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: To predict the distribution of reported results for a given word in Wordle difficulty mode, i.e., to predict the correlation percentage of (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, X), this paper uses the number of repeated letters, the ranking of word usage, and the number of commonly used letters as the correlation attributes of words, and uses a data regression forecasting model of genetic algorithm optimized BP neural network to predict the distribution of reported results with root mean square error and mean absolute error as the evaluation criteria. Meanwhile, the model was used to compare with the BP neural network data regression prediction model without genetic algorithm optimization, and it was found that the optimization model has smaller root mean square error and mean absolute error, i.e., the optimized model has better accuracy. Finally, the word attributes associated with the word EERIE were brought into the genetic algorithm optimized BP neural network data prediction model, and the distribution of the reported results was (0%, 2%, 11%, 24%, 29%, 26%, and 8%).

Author Keywords: Genetic algorithm optimization of BP neural network

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Vegetable Warming Board Based on 52 Microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Intelligent warming boards are playing an increasingly important role in daily life, facilitating many details in daily life. This design is mainly based on the STC89C52 microcontroller and temperature sensor DS18B20 as the core design of an intelligent vegetable warming board. The design can achieve manual and automatic control modes through buttons and Bluetooth modules, and can be applied to various occasions to achieve various functions such as hot vegetable warming, drying clothes, thawing, insulation of food, warm milk and warm wine. At the same time, the HC-05 Bluetooth module can also be used to constantly query, detect, and display the working status of the warming board on the mobile phone, and has voice reporting function.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technology of Automatic Sample Retention for Calibration Application in Electricity Meter Laboratory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the goal of automatization and precision in the process of taking photos and keeping samples, precision and simplification of manual operation, and safety of the operating environment, and combining with automatic control technology, video dynamic inspection technology, and image recognition technology, we design an automatic integrated photographic and sample keeping equipment. Automatic control of the process is realized through relevant technologies, reducing manual operation steps, improving sampling accuracy, and reducing work intensity. The system closes all strong current parts, and automatically controls strong current on-off through sensing technology, thus improving work safety.

articleTitle: Optimal Recursive Reature Selection Method Based on Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: To reduce the complexity of the model in feature selection and improve the classification accuracy to make feature selection more effective. In this paper, an optimal recursive feature selection method based on random forest is proposed. Multiple decision trees are constructed from random forest on the primed dataset, but the problem of overfitting occurs in the process of constructing decision trees, so search cross-validation is used to enhance the accuracy and credibility of the evaluation model. Meanwhile, the optimal recursive feature selection is obtained by the fuzzy information entropy method to eliminate noise. Cross-validation comparison is performed by dividing the training set 75% used for training and constructing the model to select the optimal parameters; the test set 25% used for testing the model to validate the assessment model. Finally, the validity of the model is verified by applying the example data of an undergraduate education index, and the feature indexes with importance greater than 0.01 are obtained by the importance calculation.

articleTitle: Research on Data Privacy Security Comprehensive Protection Program Based on Computer Data Protection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This algorithm adopts the form of byte stream data processing. This algorithm can effectively complete the processing of all kinds of file data. The idea of dynamic fragmentation based on data disturbance is introduced to carry out data disturbance to nodes. Homomorphic Hash function is used to protect data integrity and cluster group keys are introduced to reduce the probability of node data being deciphered and strengthen the protection of private data. The analysis and experimental results show that the proposed algorithm is secure enough. This algorithm is much better than the existing encryption methods in terms of running time and energy consumption.

articleTitle: Pricing Method for Deviations in the Electricity Market Taking Into Account Load Factor Levels
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Since there are specific errors between the forecasted and actual electricity consumption of electricity-using enterprises and generation-side and grid failures and power dispatch, these deviations will directly affect the deviated electricity assessment. To ensure smooth electricity market transactions and reduce deviations, we propose a deviation pricing method for the electricity market that considers load factor levels. Firstly, we offer a linear regression-based electricity sales forecasting method based on the time series of electricity sales and use the gradient descent method to calculate the linear regression parameters; then, we propose a pricing method for deviated electricity in the electricity market based on the load rate level of customers and determine the corresponding electricity price based on the change of load rate, and at the same time, set up a specific penalty mechanism for electricity enterprises according to the deviation rate of electricity, to ensure that the deviation of electricity is within the required range. The proposed method is based on the variation of the load factor to determine the corresponding tariff. At the same time, a penalty mechanism is set up for the electricity consumers according to the deviation rate to ensure that the deviation is within the required range. The case analysis shows that the method can balance the interests of customers and power sales enterprises to a certain extent and reduce the impact of deviated power assessment.

articleTitle: A Retrieval Method in Heterogeneous Domains Based on Orthogonal Softmax
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Most of the existing retrieval methods are based on homogeneity domains, however, a retrieval method in heterogeneous domains was proposed in this paper. The similarity of different classes was discussed, that was, a pair of classes was similar in one domain, but it may be different in another domain. To solve this problem, orthogonal softmax was introduced, which made the decision axis of softmax have consistent similarity. Thus, it was a simple linear transformation from one feature space into another space through cross-domain to share the same feature space structure. The results of three data sets in heterogeneous domains showed the validity of this method.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis of Rolling Bearings Based on Progressive Grid Optimization ResNet
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The traditional rolling bearing fault diagnosis method requires a series of complex signal processing and relies heavily on the manual method of constructing algorithms and the empirical knowledge of experts, which leads to the introduction of some artificial random factors. Based on this situation, we searched the parameter settings of ResNet by the progressive grid method, to achieve the effect that no more artificial parameter settings are needed, eliminating the artificial random factors and making it more capable of feature extraction. The specific steps are as follows: first, a two-dimensional time-frequency variation of the bearing vibration data is used to construct the data set, followed by a network noise immunity test, then the data is input into the network framework, and a progressive grid method is used to search the parameters to obtain a better parameter setting; finally, an image is made by the variation of t-SNE and the feature coefficients of the sparse measure to show the feature extraction results of the network before and after optimization. The visualization comparison graph and it is found that the classification accuracy is higher in the case of good parameters by testing. By comparing different network architectures and adding the progressive grid method, we verify that: the framework obtained after optimizing the parameters has better noise immunity and adaptive feature extraction capability, and the bearing diagnosis accuracy is higher than that of the method before parameter optimization.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Spectral Soil Detection System Based on Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Combining near infrared spectrum analysis and wireless communication technology, a design scheme of near infrared intelligent spectrum soil detection system based on 2.4GHz radio frequency technology and GPRS communication technology was proposed. Using low power CC2530 chip as the core, the hardware circuit and software flow of coordinator node and sensor node are designed and developed. Power amplifier CC2591 is added to the sensor node to realize longdistance transmission of soil information in farmland wireless network. Farmland soil temperature and humidity parameters are periodically collected by STH11 temperature and humidity sensors and sent to the coordinator via wireless transmission. BPNN was used to train the soil organic carbon detection model after pretreatment, and GA was used to extract the spectral feature band. Finally, experiments show that the detection system has the characteristics of simple structure, easy expansion, high reliability and high sensitivity., the optimal detection model R2 was 0.984.

articleTitle: Design of Interactive Virtual System of Architectural Space Based on Multi-Objective Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Interactive design is the behavior of artifacts, environments and systems, and the design and definition of the appearance elements that convey this behavior. The main design challenge that architects will face in the future will be how to construct the consistency of the combination of digital technology, new life function and formal aesthetics in the form of virtual co-construction design according to different design conditions. Therefore, this paper designs a new interactive virtual system of architectural space, and proposes a MOO (Multi-Objective Optimization) algorithm combined with heuristic algorithm. This algorithm improves the simulated annealing algorithm to achieve load balancing among hardware resources. The combined temperature attenuation function not only speeds up the search speed of the global optimal solution neighborhood in the early stage of the algorithm, but also ensures the search quality of the local optimal solution in the later stage. It improves the authenticity and interactivity of 3D virtual building space experience and enhances the user experience performance. The results show that the average scores of architectural space user experience of this system are above 90 points, while those of traditional systems are around 84 points, which fully demonstrates that this system is superior to the other two traditional systems in user experience, and verifies that this system has the advantages of strong sense of reality and interaction. Have good user experience performance.

articleTitle: A Spacecraft Orbit Optimization Model Based on Computer Wireless Transmission Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In order to solve this problem, we will conduct dimensionless modeling for the optimal control of this problem, so as to make the optimal control method of this problem more accurate. Using the idea of pseudo-spectral analysis, the optimal state of the system is decomposed into a nonlinear optimal state, the optimal state of the system is decomposed into a stable state. SNOPT program is developed by MATLAB to deal with large-scale problems effectively. The proposed algorithm has low sensitivity and fast convergence for estimating initial commodes. There is no singularity under zero inclination and zero eccentricity conditions.

articleTitle: Research on Sports Simulation Training System Based on Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper designs a sports training simulation system based on computer artificial intelligence technology. This method uses motion capture method to obtain the original motion information and build the corresponding motion database. A human skeleton model based on DH expression is proposed and its 3D modeling is carried out. A good human-machine interface is established to realize the visualization of data in learning. Complete the software overall structure, module function, database and video format design. The simulation results show that the simulated training movements have high similarity with the real movements of athletes and the output results are stable. The experimental results show that the method is effective.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Simulation of Electronic Circuit
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper takes the adjustable DC power supply circuit as an example to discusse a method for fault simulation of electronic circuits based on Multisim. By using the fault setting function of Multisim 14.0, and setting the circuit to different types of faults, simulates the real fault phenomenon and display the results with virtual instruments. The fault simulation is useful for understanding the working principle of electronic circuit, predicting the fault cause and selecting device parameters in circuit design.

articleTitle: Simulation of Software Engineering Knowledge Classification Model Based on Worker Bee Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The strict review and test emphasized by traditional software engineering cannot guarantee the correct operation of the system, just as the best programmer cannot guarantee that the program is defect-free, the best system built with the latest technology cannot guarantee that it can handle all problems in the actual operation process. There are many ways to improve the security of software projects, such as cultivating developers' good programming skills, adopting a sound development model, and so on. In practical practice, it has also achieved quite good results. However, according to its theory, in the case of large amount of data, the traditional algorithm needs to scan and calculate the loss of all features to determine the optimal segmentation point, which is extremely time-consuming in practice. Before the classification model analyzes the software change log, a large number of change logs need to be preprocessed, including sentence segmentation, word segmentation, removal of stop words, extraction of part of speech, extraction of stem, and other steps. The effect of pretreatment will directly affect the development of subsequent experiments. Making full use of these rules and static testing tools of ABC(Artificial bee colony algorithm) software engineering knowledge classification model and conducting static testing in time can greatly improve the correctness, security and reliability of software products.

articleTitle: Research on Short-Term Power Load Forecasting Based on PSO-BPNN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The structure of power network is getting larger and larger, and it is increasingly difficult to operate power safely, which requires accurate prediction of power load and accurate power generation plan. The particle swarm method is presented to optimize the BP neural network design in order to overcome the drawbacks of the BP neural network algorithm, such as high iteration times and an easy tendency to slip into local extremes. The comparative analysis of different forecasting models shows that the particle swarm optimization neural network model has better nonlinear mapping capability in short-term load forecasting of power systems, and the prediction results are more accurate with the relative error within 3%, clearly demonstrating the model's superiority. The model can meet the prediction needs of the dispatching department of power enterprises and provide powerful support for real-time regulation of power systems.

articleTitle: Analysis of Motion Characteristics of Pedal Mechanism of Sewing Machine Based on Computer Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Sewing machines and flat sewing machines have similar structures, and they have made great contributions to improving the efficiency of manufacturing and industrial production, and the mechanism motion characteristics of sewing machines and flat sewing machines have a decisive role in the performance of the machine. In this paper, CATIA is used to conduct dynamic simulation of the sewing machine power mechanism, and the simulation data and curves represent the motion law of the mechanism. The dead center characteristics obtained through analysis are consistent with the objective law of the hinged four-bar mechanism, which verifies that it is reasonable to use CATIA to study the core mechanism of sewing machines and related machines, and lays a foundation for the optimal design of these machines. It has great significance for improving the efficiency of design production.

articleTitle: The Design of Light Intensity Measurement System Based on Programmable Controller
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of social science and technology, science and technology play an increasingly important role in people's daily life. People's demand for products that are conducive to their convenience is increasing. The traditional light intensity measurement has a single function, low accuracy, and can not adapt well to the development and progress of society. Today, it is not enough to meet people's diverse needs for light measurement. The illumination intensity measurement system controlled by programmable controller can collect data. It has the advantages of flexible programming, accurate measurement, timely message communication and convenient detection. The system design can automatically detect the size of the light intensity under the measured environment and display it in a long-range to let people know the intensity of the light. When the light intensity is greater or less than the range of illumination it should be, alarm and switch curtains and lights. The system design uses BH1750FVI sensor to measure the light intensity, STC89C52RC chip to process data and control the system, ESP8266 module to transmit data wirelessly and display it on the mobile phone, and step motor and relay to switch curtains and lights. The whole system uses MQTT's Internet of Things communication protocol, which makes it very convenient to expand the system on the original basis. The introduction of ESP8266 module also makes full preparations for the adaption of smart home devices such as millet house and HomeKIT, bringing unlimited possibilities to the system.

articleTitle: Research on Safety Analysis and Response Methods of Autonomous Driving Technology Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the increasing attention paid to automated driving technology, the commercialization of automated driving has gradually become a reality, playing a vital role in transportation. However, the constant occurrence of autonomous vehicle accidents still makes the public doubt the possibility of large-scale commercial use of unmanned driving. How to improve safety and reliability is the core proposition of automated driving technology, Its research and development will seriously affect the commercialization of autonomous vehicle. This article focuses on the safety challenges that exist when key technologies of artificial intelligence are applied in the field of autonomous driving, analyzes the key factors that constrain the commercialization of autonomous driving, and proposes research ideas and suggestions to help the vigorous development of autonomous driving.

articleTitle: EEG-Based on Emotion Recognition Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Emotion is of great significance in human's daily interaction. Contemporarily, emotion recognition systems are beneficial in various areas, ranging from human-computer interaction (HCI) system to healthcare safety. So far, the Electroencephalogram (EEG) has received much attention because of its sensitivity to mood changes. However, the relationship hasn't been fully researched. To investigate the relationship among emotions, bands, channels and find a better classifier, this experiment organize the framework based on the DEAP dataset. After the data preprocessing, EEG data is reduced by principal component analysis (PCA). Then to create the emotion feature vectors, the discrete wavelet transform (DWT) is chosen as the parameter. Lastly, to categorize the EEG signal, support vector machine (SVM), random forest (RF), k-nearest neighbor (KNN), XGboost model is created. According to the experiment, this paper obtained the following relevant conclusions: 1) RF, SVM, KNN and XGboost classifier, performed with the accuracy of 77.01%, 80.44%, 66.75% and 77.75%, respectively; 2) In temperal and whole brain regions, gamma has the highest recognition ability, reaching 76.77% and 77.02%. The beta performs best in occipital, parietal, and central regions with 78.00%, 77.26%, and 78.00%, respectively; 3) The higher the frequency, the greater the oscillatory dynamics of brain activity on positive / negative emotions; 4) The AF3, AF4 area has a greater effect in reflecting emotions because of less irrelevant influences.

articleTitle: Analysis of Wordle Game Mechanism Based on LightGBM Algorithm and Word Feature Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The popularity of Wordle has attracted a large number of players to report their scores on Twitter. Today, Wordle has been acquired by the New York Times. This paper makes some data analysis on how to maintain the enthusiasm of players and play the positive role of the game more effectively. The frequency of the letters in each position of the word, the number of repeated letters and the number of repeated letters in the word are extracted, and the common use rate of each word is calculated based on the data of Google Ngram Viewer. Qualitative analysis is made on the percentage distribution of the reported score played in difficult mode through attributes such as thermal diagram and skewness, and the conclusion is drawn that the number of repeated letters in the word and the number of repeated letters have a negative correlation with the score played, while the common use rate of words and the frequency of letters in each position of the word have a positive correlation with the score played. On the basis of fully considering the influence of the word attribute, we select the date, the common use rate of the word and the frequency of the letters in the five positions of the word as the characteristic indicators that affect the distribution of the results, and establish the LightGBM model for the percentage of (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, X). Finally, the trained seven models are used to analyze and predict the distribution of the percentage of the times used to guess the words in the future. The R2 coefficient of the model in the training set is 0.85, and the R2 coefficient in the test set is 0.68, indicating that the model has good fitting and prediction ability. We use the LightGBM model to predict the percentage of times the word ERRIE will be guessed on March 1, 2023, and the distribution is [0.129, 2.152, 13.861, 36.167, 28.278, 14.002, 5.411].

articleTitle: Simulation of Computer Communication Network Flow Distribution Model Based on Improved Ant Colony Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: How to distribute and balance the flow in computer networks has always been a difficult problem to give an answer. In the design of computer communication network, the average delay of the network is an important factor to be considered. In this paper, the simulation research of computer communication network flow distribution model based on improved ACO(ant colony optimization) algorithm is carried out. ACO breaks the limitation of traditional network, and controls the path of data flow in the network according to the state information of the network, thus achieving the purpose of controlling network flow. In this paper, ACO is used in computer communication network flow distribution, and GA(genetic algorithm) is used to update pheromones through path crossover and mutation operations, which can optimize the global situation and avoid stagnation, so as to improve the convergence speed and global search ability of the algorithm. The research results show that with the increase of the unit packet delay cost, the fixed cost of the link is reduced from 70% to about 60%, while the variable cost has no obvious fluctuation, which fully reflects the superiority of the improved ACO in the flow distribution of computer communication networks.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Generation Algorithm of Phoneme Conversion Learning Corpus Based on KNN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: As for phoneme conversion, there is no good method all the time, so most of the current researches on speaker voice conversion only convert the phonetic spectrum. From the linguistic point of view, phonemes are the smallest unit of speech, and syllables and sentences are all composed of phonemes in a fixed way. In this paper, the research on automatic generation algorithm of phoneme conversion learning corpus based on KNN(K nearest neighbor) algorithm is carried out. In order to solve the problem that it is difficult to collect a large amount of speech data of the target user, this paper uses KNN algorithm to construct an average phoneme model, mixes the data in the previously established phoneme database, and obtains GMM (Gaussian Mixture Model) of phonemes through sufficient training. In 10 cases, the spectral distance ratio based on KNN is lower than that based on GMM, with an average reduction of 9.261%, which indicates that independent conversion of each phoneme by phoneme classification can effectively avoid GMM smoothing and obtain more information of the target speaker.

articleTitle: UAV Path Planning Based on Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel approach for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) flight path planning using ant colony optimization (ACO). The method compares the target location to a food source pursued by ants, dividing the enemy defense zone into equidistant grids. Ants traverse different grid points to reach the target location. The path selection of ants is determined using the visibility function of the ACO algorithm, considering enemy threats and distance to the target node. Additionally, a scoring function is introduced, considering flight path length, threat cost, and maximum deviation angle constraints. Pheromone concentration on the path is updated based on the scoring function. The optimal UAV flight path is represented as a set of node numbers received by the ants during the search. The ACO-based UAV flight path planning method is simple, easy to implement, and exhibits significant optimization effects. Through simulation experiments, we demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of the method.

articleTitle: Region Detection Based TRA-Net for SAR Target Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, an attention-mechanism based target region adaptation net (TRA-Net) is designed for synthetic aperture radar (SAR) target recognition and classification. With the fact that SAR image data-acquirement has many obstacles, including poor imaging process and large scale, most of the current deep-learning methods, motivated by convolution neural network or attention mechanism, typically perform unsatisfactory on account of the problems on target area detection. The proposed TRA-Net is designed to identify the target area to the maximum extent possible, achieved by a well-trained Region Detection (RD) module. Therefore, it can provide better target characteristics for the subsequent combined target classification network. A meta-learning-based optimization algrithm is applied to the method aims to solve the limitation of the data. Through extending the data set by transformation, we achieve the same or even better classification effect in the case of limited data. Comparison tests on MSTAR and MSAR data sets have confirmed that the proposed model shows better adaptability to target region locking and target feature extraction, which obtained better target classification results.

articleTitle: Research on Attack Simulation Training System of Basketball Players Under Computer Artificial Intelligence Assisted Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, combining virtual reality technology and computer technology, a basketball technology simulation system based on virtual reality is established.
