Firstly, the exact solution of the best shot Angle and speed is obtained by derivation of the basketball trajectory equation. Then gray contour marks are used to implement 3D fusion of the collected image information to obtain a visual imaging model. Judging the effectiveness of basketball training posture according to visual imaging results and pixel difference feature quantity. The intelligent monitoring output optimization model is constructed to realize the software development and design of basketball training posture intelligent monitoring system in intelligent embedded environment. The simulation results show that athletes can use this visual environment to calculate the best shot Angle and speed.

articleTitle: Post-Equalization Technique to Mitigate LED Nonlinearity in VLC Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: A LMS-based adaptive post-equalizer O-OFDM system and an adaptive decision feedback post-equalizer (ADFE) O-OFDM system are proposed for mitigating LED nonlinear distortion in the VLC system. Compared with the traditional pre-equalization scheme, this scheme does not require additional physical circuits at the transmitter and only needs some computing resources at the receiver, which improves the cost efficiency of the system. Bit error rate (BER) is used as the performance evaluation index to analyze the improvement effect of the above equalizers on LED nonlinearity, and the influence of the number of taps of the equalizer on the equalization effect is also studied. The simulation results show that both post-equalizers can suppress LED nonlinearity, and the ADFE equalizer performs better than the LMS-based adaptive post-equalizer.

articleTitle: Biomedical Image Processing and Applications Based on Multi Object Detection Algorithm of Computational Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Medical image analysis based on deep learning has important research significance for accurately locating and identifying lesion targets. This article aims to address the issues of improving the detection efficiency and performance of existing object detection methods, and introduces the SE Net module to the Yolo v4 algorithm. The new algorithm improves the positioning accuracy of the data used in this article, achieving the goal of using object detection algorithms for rough target localization before classification. We selected Faster RCNN, Yolo v4, and improved Yolo v4 algorithms for experiments on the BraTS2018 dataset. The experimental results show that, on the whole, the improved Yolo v4 algorithm has better classification effect, and the improved Yolo v4 algorithm provides a good method for assisting doctors to diagnose brain tumor diseases.

articleTitle: Statistical Deep Learning-based Spatio-temporal Long-term Forecasting Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Sea surface temperature (SST) is an important parameter of ocean hydrography, and accurate forecasting of SST is of great significance for ocean economic development, extreme weather prevention and marine vessel navigation. Therefore, the rapid development of SST forecasting is necessary. To address the characteristics of SST time series data with nonlinearity and multiple noise, this paper use EOF decomposition method to reduce the influence of data dimensionality and noise on prediction results. By constructing the Conv-BiLSTM prediction model, the convolutional neural network (CNN), bidirectional long-and short-term memory network (BILSTM) and deep neural network (DNN) are effectively combined. The SST spatio-temporal sequence evolution features are also extracted, thus effectively improving the SST long-term prediction accuracy. The model is statistically compared with the baseline model and the conventional machine learning model in a forecast experiment at four independent stations in the Pacific Northwest. The results show that the model not only has a significant improvement in SST forecast accuracy, but also has better robustness.

articleTitle: $L_{p}$ Norm-Based Local Means k-Nearest Neighbor Classification with Feature Reduction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: KNN is an important part of classification algorithms in machine learning, which has been extensively employed in various fields. In this research, we proposed a Lp Norm-Based Local Means k-Nearest Neighbor Classification with Feature Reduction. We extend the original Euclidean distance formula, and obtain the distance calculation formula based on P-value. Then classify and predict the data set after dimension reduction. In the experiment, we verified the effectiveness and superiority of our method by setting different k values in KNN, LMKNN and the classification accuracy obtained by our methodology (PLMKNN).

articleTitle: Underwater Target Tracking Technology Based on YOLO v4 and Deepsort
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Underwater target tracking is a technology that tracks the motion of objects in underwater environment and provides accurate position information. With the progress of online real-time tracking technology, the accuracy of underwater target tracking has also been improved, and the time consumed in the calculation process has also been reduced. However, the poor underwater imaging conditions lead to the temporary disappearance of objects and serious position occlusion. At the same time, underwater imaging will make the object change in shape and size to a certain extent. Poor imaging conditions will make the result of target tracking unsatisfactory. Therefore, this paper uses the combination of YOLO v4 and SORT WITH DEEP ASSOCIATION METRIC (Deepsort) to complete the underwater target tracking task. YOLO v4 algorithm uses CSP Marknet 53 as the backbone network, which improves the parameter fitting ability of CNN and maintains the lightweight structure of CNN. The Spatial Pyramid Pooling (SPP) structure adopted by YOLO v4 can improve the receptive field of CNN and improve the recognition accuracy of small objects. Deepsort uses Mahalanobis distance to measure the distance between object detection Bbox and tracking Bbox, which can more accurately measure the relevance of object position information. At the same time, the feature corresponding to the Bbox calculated by CNN is used to measure the correlation of objects, reduce the occurrence of re-recognition phenomenon, and achieve better tracking effect. Finally, the test results in the underwater data set are MOTA 61.1 and Runtime 60Hz.

articleTitle: A Study of an Innovative Weighted Independent Principal Component Analysis Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In order to optimize the original independent principal component method, this paper demonstrates a innovative method of weighted independent principal component analysis. It is applied to the SSE 50 index where the returns of 50-index portfolios are decomposed into statistically independent components. These independent principal components are weighted to obtain the original price series, which is used to analyze and predict the price trend.

articleTitle: Research on the Classification of Glass Products Based on Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Ancient glass objects in China are highly susceptible to weathering by the burial environment, which changes the composition ratio of glass objects and thus affects the correct judgment of glass object types. In this paper, we establish various machine learning models based on statistical analysis methods, which are important for the analysis and identification of the composition of ancient glass products. In this paper, the classification data are firstly processed by unique thermal coding, and the logistic regression model, decision tree model and random forest model are used to identify the unknown type of glass artifacts, and the grid search is performed by machine learning method on the basis of 5-fold cross-validation method for the model setting parameter space, and the optimal parameter values obtained from the grid search are brought into the evaluator for prediction, and the training set of the three models The scores on the training and test sets of the three models were both 1, and the same prediction results were obtained. In order to analyze the correlations among different glass chemical components, we calculated the Spearman correlation coefficients among each chemical component within each glass category and plotted the correlation coefficient heat map analysis, and then compared the change patterns of scatter plots of the two types of chemical components with higher correlations among different categories of artifacts, so as to analyze the differences of chemical component correlations among different categories of artifacts.

articleTitle: Research on demand response characteristics of electric vehicles based on Monte Carlo method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper first briefly introduces the basic measures of demand-side response, and then details the analysis of EV demand response characteristics by using Monte Carlo simulation algorithm to optimize the charging behavior of EVs to achieve “peak shaving and valley filling”. Finally, in the example, EVs are divided into commercial and residential areas, and the ratio of user peak shaving scale to maximum summer load is quantitatively evaluated based on sample data. The study shows that the electric vehicles in the commercial area have a smoother load and can participate in the demand response by adjusting the charging time, and the response ratio can reach 80%.

articleTitle: Using Physical Models and Image Processing Techniques Efficient Dehazing Algorithm Prior
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: To improve this human production and living environment and Currently, there are various dehazing techniques available, but they are limited in their effectiveness. But these methods have certain limitations in the dehazing effect. In this paper, we provide an excellent image dehazing method, by introducing a weighting function to optimize and minimize the scattering coefficient, obtain a more accurate scattering map, and complete the dehazing of the image. The distortion in the image is caused by a combination of clear images and environmental factors, so a technology is developed that can remove the color veil of hazy images. Specific comparisons have shown that these studies have improved dehazing performance in several ways, making the recovered images more realistic.

articleTitle: Research on Material Allocation Method Based on SEIR and Multi-Objective Programming
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, a resource allocation model under the background of COVID-19 is constructed. First, predict the change curve of infected people under different resource allocation conditions by adhering SEIR model, completes the solution through genetic algorithm, then the necessity of resource allocation is analyzed. Then, by setting up multi-objective programming, the allocation of materials and the number of delivery points are optimized, and the optimal results are obtained by using Gurobi. This optimal result improves the fairness goal between different urban areas by 99.8%, which has certain practical significance and theoretical basis.

articleTitle: Real-Time SLAM System for Edges Based on Bilateral Filtering and Adaptive Thresholding
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper presents an edge vision SLAM system based on bilateral filtering and adaptive thresholding. This paper is a complete vision SLAM system including visual odometry, sliding window optimization, and cyclic closure that can be built out of semi-dense maps. At the heart of the approach is the use of bilateral filtering and adaptive thresholding to retain as much edge information as possible and to combine edge images with depth mapping for joint camera pose estimation, with depth mapping further increasing stability in poorly textured environments. The front-end visual odometry module estimates the relative motion between the current frame and the keyframe, using a sliding window to continuously optimise the keyframe, and in the loop-closing and repositioning module, a Fern library of keyframes is built, using a random bag-of-words method to obtain closed-loop candidate frames, closing the loop when a matching candidate frame is found, and adding it to the database otherwise. The method in the paper is experimented on the TUM public dataset, covering a variety of scenes and camera movements, and the experiments show that the system in this paper can effectively construct a semi-dense map of the scene. In addition, the method in this paper performs better in terms of trajectory accuracy for most sequences, indicating that the combination of edge and depth terms selected in the cost function is applicable to a wide range of scenes and that the edge feature-based method has higher accuracy and robustness.

articleTitle: Cable Fault Detection and Diagnosis Method Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, a method based on convolutional neural network is proposed for the accurate identification of early faults in cables. The method can accurately classify and identify faults from overcurrent signals including constant impedance faults, inrush currents, and capacitive switching disturbances. First, the features of the overcurrent signal are extracted by wavelet transform. Then, construct a convolutional neural network, adjust network parameters through training, and establish a mapping relationship between input features and category codes. In order to solve the problems of training overfitting and learning efficiency, this paper modifies the loss function and uses the method of adaptive learning rate to optimize the convolutional neural network. Through simulation experiments, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified, indicating that the method can effectively classify overcurrent signals, accurately identify early cable faults, and has high engineering application value. The research results of this method are of great significance for eliminating hidden dangers of cable faults in time.

articleTitle: Cooling Characteristic Analysis and Structure Optimization of Electric Vehicle Power Battery Pack
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The high temperature of the power battery will affect its performance. Therefore, based on CFD simulation analysis method, the influence of cooling medium flow rate, cooling medium temperature and cooling plate material on the cooling effect of liquid cooling system of lithium ion battery is studied, and a cooling medium flow channel structure that can significantly improve its cooling performance. The simulation results show that improving the cooling medium inlet flow velocity and decreasing the cooling medium inlet temperature can lower the maximum temperature of the battery module, but it is disadvantageous to sustained cooling and temperature difference control; The overall impact of the cooling medium material on the maximum temperature of the battery is all within 0.4°C; After optimizing the battery module, the maximum temperature is reduced by 1.2%, the maximum temperature difference is reduced by 2.1%, and the cooling performance is effectively improved.

articleTitle: Research of Blockchain Technology on the Application of Data Sharing Mechanism to the Energy Measurement of Power Demand Side
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This article studies the application of data sharing mechanism of blockchain technology in the direction of energy measurement in the demand side of electric power. With the rapid consumption of energy and the increasing awareness of environmental protection, demand-side management has attracted more and more attention. In order to meet the sustainability and security requirements of energy consumption, demand-side management needs to measure energy consumption. However, traditional measurement methods have many problems, such as data opacity, insecurity, and susceptibility to tampering. Therefore, this article proposes a blockchain-based energy measurement scheme for the demand side of electric power. This scheme uses the decentralization, immutability, security, and transparency of blockchain technology to achieve reliability and efficiency in energy metering on the demand side of electric power. At the same time, this article also proposes a data sharing mechanism to solve the related problem, and introduces the advantages and application examples of the mechanism. Finally, this article looks forward to the application prospects and future research directions of the proposal.

articleTitle: Research on Control Technology of Lighting Safety Protection System in Electrical Construction of Building Engineering
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper proposes a system scheme based on RL78/I1A main control chip, which can realize real-time monitoring, precise control and intelligent lighting. The system includes awareness layer, control layer, network layer and comprehensive application layer. The field controller of the control layer can be used independently or networked. The system uses short time energy and short time average zero crossing rate to judge the voice control signal. The universal background model based on Gaussian mixture model is used to determine the identity of voice controller. The hardware subsystem consists of coordinator node module, controller node module and sensor node module. After debugging, it is found that the dimming curve of the system is stable, and the harmonic distortion and power consumption index are excellent. The expansion of lighting system is strong. The system has good extensibility.

articleTitle: Research on Text Generation Model of Natural Language Processing Based on Computer Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper proposes a text generation system model for natural language processing based on artificial intelligence technology. In this model, pre-trained dynamic word vector ALBERT was used instead of the traditional BERT reference model for feature extraction to obtain word vectors. Through ontology, the factors that affect the semantic similarity of concepts, such as node density, node depth and node hierarchy order, are improved. The semantic distance, the relationship between concepts, the attribute of concepts and the level of concepts are considered comprehensively. The experiment on the public data set proves that the BLEU value and manual evaluation index of the algorithm on the test set are significantly improved compared with the baseline model. The effectiveness of the algorithm is proved by the system.

articleTitle: Analyze and Compare the State Management Patterns of VUE
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper analyses the state management patterns in the front-end framework VUE. Two state management patterns commonly used in VUE, VUEX and Pinia, are analyzed and compared. Through comparison of application examples, the advantages and disadvantages of the two managers are analyzed, as well as their applicable scenarios, so that we can choose different managers according to the needs.

articleTitle: Translation Processing Model of Complex Long Sentences Based on Feature Extraction Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the development of information technology, patents or long sentences of science and technology with huge vocabulary and complex structure have widely appeared in people's daily work. This kind of long sentence often contains several clauses and non-predicate verb phrases, and these clauses and phrases often restrict and depend on each other, thus forming a complex language phenomenon in which there are phrases in clauses and clauses in phrases. This kind of long sentence plays a great role in the logic and rigor of English itself, but it brings considerable difficulties to machine translation. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes a multilingual and general algorithm for complex long sentence translation based on multi-strategy analysis. The algorithm uses a combination of case-based pattern matching and rule analysis to comprehensively utilize a variety of relevant language features in the source language sentences, including grammatical semantic features, sentence length, punctuation marks Functional words and contextual conditions are used to simplify the segmentation of complex long sentences and compound the translation.

articleTitle: Game Theory Based WSN Clustering Topology Control Algorithm for High-Speed Railway Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The wireless sensor networks are widely utilized in high-speed railway monitoring with many advantages. In order to extend the effective working time of the monitoring network, this paper presents a game theory based clustering topology control algorithm for the cluster header election. During the stage of cluster header election, a mixed strategy game is adopted to improve the problem of unbalanced income of participants in the pure strategy game. The candidate cluster headers are selected by using the mixed strategy Nash equilibrium probability as the threshold, and the real cluster headers are selected by using the secondary competition mechanism. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively slow down the decline of the total residual energy of the network and extend the death time of the node.

articleTitle: Application of Neural Network Methods for Crossword Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the widespread application of the machine learning, this paper is aimed to analyze a game named ‘Wordle puzzles’ launched by [New York Times], using the machine learning big data analysis and neural network models to get better puzzle design and promotion. These models will analysis the relationship between word attributes and result distribution and then predict the results. Firstly,this paper constructed a time series model and used quadratic exponential smoothing method to predict the total number of player reports. Then it quantifies the difficulty attributes of each words after classifying them by word repetition and commonness as indicators.And it uses correlation analysis to explore the effect of word attributes on the percentage of people reporting using the difficulty mode. After that, a BP neural network model is constructed, learned, trained and it can predict the results of a given word on a certain date, as well as predicting the difficulty level and score of that word. Combined with machine learning, neural network and some research, It is recommended that the game companies adjust word difficulty attributes such as commonness and repetition according to the number of players, generally keep word difficulty smooth, and then adjust word difficulty attributes according to the average number of correct submissions of reported results.

articleTitle: Research on Biological Image Time Series Change Prediction Analysis Based on DeepAR Forecasting Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In light of the importance and challenges of biological image time series change prediction analysis in the fields of medicine and biology, this paper proposes a biological image time series change prediction analysis method based on the DeepAR Forecasting algorithm. First, according to the features of biological images, the time series data is acquired and preprocessed to obtain information such as target values, dynamic features, and static features. Secondly, to improve the prediction accuracy and stability, a deep learning model based on a recurrent neural network, the DeepAR Forecasting algorithm, is used to fit and predict the changing trend of the time series. Thirdly, an evaluation index and optimization strategy that comprehensively consider the influence of time series periodicity, seasonality, outliers, etc., are constructed based on different application scenarios to evaluate the quality of the forecast results more accurately. Finally, a biological image time series change prediction analysis system based on the DeepAR Forecasting algorithm was built. Then, simulation and experimental verification proved the effectiveness of the proposed method in this paper.

articleTitle: Research and Application of LPRL Model Based on TOPSIS and K-Means Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, LPRL evaluation model is established based on hierarchical analysis, entropy weight method and coefficient of variation method. First, according to the relevant criteria proposed by CIE, 15 sets of data were collected from 40 regions and integrated into 13 secondary indicators. We divided them into three dimensions, and in order to ensure the objectivity and accuracy of the weights, we used a combination of weighting method, combining hierarchical analysis, entropy weighting method and coefficient of variation method, to obtain the three-dimensional weights of these indicators. Then, the LPRL scores were calculated using the TOPSIS comprehensive evaluation method, and finally the classification was performed by cluster analysis. by calculating the LPRL scores, this paper uses the McKinsey matrix to measure the level. the classification range of LPRL and RDI is determined by the K-means clustering algorithm, and the McKinsey matrix is divided into nine quadrants, and the scores are reflected by the coordinates (LPRL, RDI) and the distance d. A new evaluation system model: LPRL2.0 was developed to provide some reference and meaning for other fields.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-class Road Obstacle Recognition and Decision Based on YOLOP Combined YOLOV5 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The paper proposes a visual real-time sensing system. It carries YOLOv5 and YOLOP models and can be carried on the vehicle embedded device. The system simultaneously performs vehicle, pedestrian, traffic light, traffic sign detection, driveable area segmentation and lane detection. The paper not only considers the high accuracy, but also considers the computational cost of running on the vehicle when selecting the model to get the sensing information. The paper chooses YOLOP, which enables FPS to reach 23 (after TRT acceleration) on embedded devices. YOLOv5 also has extremely fast execution speed and accuracy on embedded devices. The combination of the two well meets the speed and accuracy required by the automatic driving decision control. And upload all sensing information to the embedded device. At the same time, a priority decision system for automatic driving is also proposed: pedestrian and vehicle distance information (divided into high, medium and low risk) <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$>$</tex> information of signal lights and traffic signs <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$>$</tex> distance information of lane line <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$>$</tex> information of driving area. Finally, this paper combines perception information with decision control and carries out visual output. Through experiments, it can be seen that the decision has achieved good results and the automatic driving function can be realized in most Chinese real street scenes.

articleTitle: Research on Robotic Fish Swarm Network Technology Based on Underwater Acoustic Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Ocean area accounts for more than 70% of the total area of the earth, and underwater space is complex. The ocean study, in aquaculture, resource exploration, and military aspect is of great significance. According to the length to width ratio of crucian carp, this paper designs a robotic fish that integrated control system and underwater acoustic communication machine. Then the essay constructs a multi-level marine Internet of Things based on the robotic fish. Besides, the marine Internet of Things includes three-dimensional network topology, and compose of bionic robotic fish with positioning and underwater communication functions. The study of robotic fish and marine Internet of Things are to better observe marine life and seabed space, reduce the cost of manual detection, and improve the ocean observation efficiency.

articleTitle: Design of bipolar pulsed neurostimulator based on MOS transistors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: As diseases of the nervous system become more and more frequent, the research on instruments such as nerve stimulation is becoming more and more important. In this paper, the design of a neural stimulator based on MOS transistors is investigated. The basic principles of MOS transistor and neural stimulator are described in this paper. The structure, type, and application of different neurostimulator are described. The circuit of bipolar pulse neural stimulator based on MOS transistors is designed and analyzed. There is no doubt that through the research and explanation of this paper, more people will understand the neural stimulator, which is of great significance to the popularization and research of neural stimulator.

articleTitle: Research on the Basic Principle of Neural Signal Recording System and Noise Cancellation Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the development of integrated circuit technology and the advancement of neuroscience research, the demand for neural recording systems is gradually increasing. The use of brain-machine interfaces to acquire neural signals has been found to be an effective method for diagnosing and treating neurological disorders as well as helping patients to regain sensory and motor functions. The main challenge in designing neural recording systems is to eliminate the noise in the neural recording system to obtain accurate neural signals. This paper first introduces the basic working principles of neural recording systems, followed by the components of neural recording systems, such as neural electrodes, neural amplifiers, and noise cancellation methods, and focuses on the types of noise in neural recording systems and noise reduction techniques.

articleTitle: Masked Face Recognition with Qaudruplet Loss
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Since the outbreak of COVID-19 pandemic, people wear masks to guide against virus, which occlude important facial features that many face recognition models rely on to extract features, making it difficult for these models to accurately recognize masked faces. We propose a Quadruplet Loss model to address this problem, which makes model to generates closed embedding vectors for both masked and non-masked face images. This model is based on triplet loss and incorporates synthesized masked face images to create a quadruplet. Our quadruplet loss function combines triplet loss with the similarity between the anchor image and its masked counterpart. Our experiment results demonstrate that our Quadruplet Loss model outperforms the Triplet Loss model in recognizing masked faces while also preserving performance on non-masked face recognition.

articleTitle: Motion Recognition Model of Sports Video Based on Feature Extraction Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer technology, network technology and multimedia technology, multimedia data is increasing exponentially. As an important part of video multimedia data, its structure is complex and its data volume is huge. Especially from a monocular camera, it is a very meaningful work to realize the correct recognition of human movements in any visual angle. Video action recognition usually refers to the process of identifying human action categories from a video sequence. This technology is widely used in multimedia content analysis, human-computer interaction, intelligent real-time monitoring and other fields. It can be realized by feature extraction of video to generate feature vectors, and classification of feature vectors by classifier. To solve the above problems, this paper starts from the spatio-temporal correlation of video data, according to the mixed model structure of convolutional neural network (CNN) and long short term memory (LSTM), introduces the attention mechanism in semantic analysis, proposes a recursive machine network based on the attention mechanism, assigns different weights to each video frame, and improves the recognition effect in the captured video clips.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Light Pollution Risk Degree Based on Spectral Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of global economic level, the increasingly serious light pollution has gradually become the focus of discussion. This paper focuses on the influence of various factors from different aspects on the risk level of light pollution, and establishes a complete and systematic comprehensive evaluation model to provide a basis for rating and preventing the risk of light pollution in a certain area. This paper uses hierarchical analysis to calculate the weights of relevant factors affecting light pollution, and the main influencing factors of light pollution can be obtained by comparing the magnitude of the weights. A comprehensive evaluation model of light pollution severity can be calculated by using principal component analysis, and its reliability can be verified by conducting sensitivity analysis on the model. The spectral clustering algorithm can be used to calculate the grading evaluation criteria for areas with different light pollution risk levels. This paper determines the correlation between each influencing factor by calculating the Spearman correlation coefficient, divides them into three groups, and proposes three intervention measures. Finally, a gray prediction model is used to predict the values of the relevant influencing factors of light pollution in the next five years, and a comprehensive evaluation model is used to calculate the light pollution risk grade evaluation values without and with three interventions, respectively, to obtain the changes of the evaluation values in five years.

articleTitle: Modal Analysis of Photovoltaic Power Supply Circuit for Boost-Type Three-Port Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Aiming at the optimization and application characteristics of converter topology in photovoltaic power supply circuits, this paper analyzes and compares different converters, and proposes the application of boost type three-port converter topology in photovoltaic power supply circuits. Through the mode analysis and research of the photovoltaic circuit of the boost type three port converter, SVPWM modulation mode is selected for the upper circuit, and BTHPWM modulation mode is selected for the lower circuit, and the parameters are designed. Finally, a simulation model is built in Matlab/simulink to verify the reasonable feasibility of the converter topology. The simulation results prove that the converter topology has the characteristics of boosting voltage and outputting two independent AC circuits, achieving the goal of photovoltaic power supply integration.

articleTitle: Research on 5G Signal Optimization Analysis Method Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper starts with the architecture of 5G communication network based on big data technology, and analyzes the commonly used big data technology in 5G communication network. Then a new method of network load prediction and 4G / 5G bandwidth adaptive in dense scenarios is proposed. Thirdly, this paper proposes an optimal transmission algorithm of 5G signal bandwidth based on cross-layer coding additive multiplexing mechanism. In the process of symbol transmission, the error sweep detection technology is adopted to construct the channel interactive multiplexing mechanism. This algorithm improves the frequency drift of the symbol and enhances the data transmission capability of the channel. The verification results show that the load of 4G / 5G network is relieved. And the user key quality index (KQI) has been improved.

articleTitle: Full Permutation Based Binary Search (FP-BS) Anti-collision Algorithm for RFID
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In the RFID system, the tag is used to transmit information, in the effective range of the reader, multiple tags respond at the same time so that the situation of collision is inevitable, and the tag collision will reduce the recognition efficiency of the system. In order to improve the tag recognition efficiency of the system, this paper proposes a full permutation based binary search (FP-BS) anti-collision algorithm for RFID on the basis of the existing anti-collision algorithm. The algorithm mainly uses the principle of full permutation in mathematics and performs full permutation polling operation on collision bits. The improved algorithm only needs to detect the collision bit of the tag once, without repeatedly detecting the collision bit, thus greatly reducing the time of anti-collision detection. Theoretical analysis and experimental results show that: this algorithm can be used for both continuous and discontinuous tag collision bits, and is more practical; moreover, it can effectively reduce the number of algorithm time slots and improve the tag recognition efficiency of the system.

articleTitle: Intelligent Detection of Remote Sensing Image Objects with Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This work aims to overcome the limitations of existing remote sensing images with a wide variety of target objects, which makes it difficult to directly apply salient target detection methods for natural scene images. First, a complete salient target detection scheme for remote sensing images is proposed, which can achieve efficient and accurate detection and provide technical support for the practical application of salient target detection for remote sensing images. In order to address the challenge of diverse target object types in remote sensing images, an Attention Pyramid Decoder Network (APDNet) model is proposed. This model embeds a global attention mechanism to capture feature correlations among different target object types, effectively alleviating the interference of target object type variations on detection performance. Next, the model adopts a pyramid decoder structure to integrate multi-level encoding information at different scales, achieving multi-level feature information aggregation and better feature decoding. Experimental results show that the APDNet model can effectively detect salient objects with diverse types, verifying the stability of the proposed method. The relevant research on intelligent detection of remote sensing image targets can promote the development of computer vision technology in the field of remote sensing and further promote the application of remote sensing data in various scenes. This work has crucial research significance and practical value.

articleTitle: A Neural Network-based Digital Calibration Improvement Method for ADC
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The article proposes a neural network-based digital calibration improvement method for ADC, targeting the problems of large network size and computation complexity in neural network-based ADC digital calibration. The proposed method involves three aspects: changing the neural network output value to be fitted, optimizing gradient descent with a simulated annealing algorithm, and using half-precision parameters. Improvements 1 and 2 slightly increase the algorithm complexity, while improvement 3 reduces the multiplier area and power consumption. Experimental results show that Improvement 1 significantly reduces the required number of training iterations for convergence, Improvement 2 improves the stability of neural network training, and Improvement 3 does not significantly degrade algorithm performance. The proposed method has low implementation complexity and can provide guidance for optimizing neural network digital calibration circuits on chips or FPGAs.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Inspection Technology for Gas Leakage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Due to the large number and vast spatial distribution of such equipments, manual inspection of gas leakage defects has poor efficiency. An automated inspection system is developed to quench this conflict. First, a Fourier transform spectrometer is integrated to patrol robot, so infrared spec-tra which contains gas leakage signal could be captured remotely while the robot cruise in inspection area. Second, a spectra processing method was established, which uses brightness temperature spectra to eliminate background interfer-ence, then extract gas spectral feature and finish recognition. Such data processing method give this system capability to operate in complex outdoor environments to give alarm signal when gas leakage is detected. Validation experiments sug-gests that the sensitivity of this system is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.5\mu(\mathrm{L}/\mathrm{s})$</tex> (rate of leakage) at a distance of 25m. The spatial distribution of gas leakage could be mapped to give exact leakage point by using wide field visualization and data assimilation techniques. This patrol system for gas leakage inspection was developed for the first time in electrical industry, and has successfully given early warning to a gas insulated electrical instrument leakage defect.

articleTitle: Simulation of Pb2+ Adsorption in Porous Media Based on Different BP Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In order to study the adsorption process model of Pb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> containing wastewater by porous media, based on genetic algorithm, particle swarm optimization and BP neural network algorithm, 17 groups of real experimental data were used as training samples, and three adsorption models were established with adsorbent dosage, adsorption time and the value of pH as input variables and initial concentration of Pb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> as output variable. Compared with the GA-BP neural network model and the PSO-BP neural network model, the prediction results of the BP neural network model output are in good agreement with the experimental data. The Pearson correlation coefficient between the BP prediction value and the original data is 0.991, which shows that the model is feasible and effective for the simulation of the adsorption process of Pb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> in porous media. The construction of three BP neural network models will greatly enrich the simulation of various chemical adsorption experiments and has broad development prospects.

articleTitle: A Method for Locating Insulation Faults in Distribution Networks Based on Segmental Propagation Matching
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Single phase to ground fault is one of the most common faults in distribution networks. This work proposes a distribution network insulation fault location method based on segmented propagation matching to address the issue of reduced positioning accuracy in intermittent grounding faults using existing distribution network insulation fault location methods. This method collects the transient zero sequence current waveform of each line when a fault occurs, and performs segmented processing to generate a segmentation matrix. Secondly, based on the segmentation matrix, a propagation matching algorithm is used to generate matching vectors. Finally, the fault localization results are output through matching calculation. This work conducted simulation experiments using a real-time digital simulation device, and the results showed that the algorithm in this paper can still ensure a positioning accuracy of 97.8% in handling intermittent ground faults, which is significantly superior to existing algorithms and has high robustness.

articleTitle: Improved AlexNet-Based Network for Face Expression Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the development of technology and equipment, biometric recognition technology has been widely used in surveillance and law enforcement systems. Face recognition, the most widely used biometric technology, has had a positive impact on the development of artificial intelligence. As the most intuitive way to map the inner world of human emotions, expressions are an important way to analyse emotions in human communication and exchange. Face expression recognition has also become a hot research topic in recent years. Traditional expression recognition methods rely on manual extraction of features, which are too complex and have low recognition accuracy, and are no longer suitable for the development needs of current applications. In this paper, we study and improve the face expression recognition method based on convolutional neural network, and design a face expression recognition system based on the improved algorithm.

articleTitle: A Knowledge Graph Quality Evaluation Method for Multilevel Power Grid Dispatching Cloud
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Knowledge graph is an emerging technology used to demonstrate knowledge relationships and has broad application prospects. This paper delves into the theory, methodology, and practical application of knowledge management and quality assessment in multilevel dispatching centers, utilizing the knowledge graph as a foundation. In order to comprehensively evaluate the reliability and practicality of knowledge graphs, a knowledge graph quality evaluation method was proposed, including three dimensions: data intrinsic, service response, and downstream application, the method can provide a theoretical basis for the quality evaluation of knowledge graphs.

articleTitle: Research on Applications of Image Processing Technologies in Interior Design Information System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Due to the limitations of software technology and weak image processing technology, traditional interior design has limited scene reproduction ability and supports a small range of scenes. Therefore, this article proposes an interior design system based on image processing and virtual reality technology. The system hardware consists of an image processing module, a virtual simulation module, and a database support module, mainly responsible for processing image information. The system software mainly consists of program loading module, data storage and reading/writing module, bus transmission module, etc. After testing, the system's denoised image is smooth and clear, with obvious edge segmentation. After image rendering, the reflection and light effects are good, and the image processing time is short, which has a good indoor design effect.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal AGV Path of Intelligent Manufacturing Workshop Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Automatic guide car is one of the key equipment to realize automatic production in intelligent manufacturing workshop, and it is an important logistics carrier. In order to improve the automatic production efficiency of intelligent manufacturing workshop, the path length of automatic guided vehicle can be optimized. In this paper, an optimization model with the lowest logistics transportation cost and the shortest path of automatic guided vehicle was designed for intelligent manufacturing workshop. The improved genetic algorithm was used to optimize the initial population, and the fitness analysis was carried out. The code was converted into a matrix for crossover operation, and finally the mutation operation was carried out. The results show that the improved genetic algorithm can be used to optimize the path of automatic guided vehicles.

articleTitle: Embedded-Based Touch Screen Driver Design and Implementation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the development of the Internet, embedded systems have become one of the hottest industries at present, and the embedded market still shows a huge demand. People have put forward higher requirements for embedded products, such as stable, intuitive, convenient and easy to operate. Touch screen undoubtedly provides people with great convenience, so in embedded systems, touch screen design with good performance, stable operation and high precision has positive and extensive significance. At the same time, in the embedded field, the Linux operating system's open source code licensing model, easy to customize, easy to cut and port features, making Linux the most popular and most popular operating system in the embedded development platform and application platform. Embedded systems are superior in terms of high specialisation and real-time, with a wide range of application-centric and computer technology-based applications. As today's electronic devices continue to be intelligent, the traditional keyboard, mouse and other human-computer interaction has been unable to meet the needs of people, people want more convenient human-computer interaction tools. The touch screen through the finger touch can achieve the operation of positioning, greatly simplifies the input method of electronic equipment, truly zero distance operation, so the touch screen has been more and more widely used. This paper is based on the Samsung S3C2410 embedded, design and implementation of the touch screen program, to achieve the control and operation of the touch screen, with touch screen sensitivity, positioning touch screen position and other characteristics, to improve the use of touch screen efficiency and user experience. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the design program is verified through experiments.

articleTitle: Generalized Minkowski Distance-Based Local Mean k-Nearest Neighbor Classifier
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This research focuses on comparing the classification performance of Local Mean-based K Nearest Neighbors (LMKNN) using different distance metrics. Specifically, we examine different value of close neighbors and 10 distance metrics within the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$L_{p}$</tex> Norm ranging from 1 to 10, such as Euclidean distance, Minkowski distance and Manhattan distance. The KNN algorithm is a powerful tool for classification and regression tasks. Unlike many other algorithms, KNN is non-parametric, meaning it can adapt to complex models without making any assumptions about the data distribution. This makes it a popular choice for researchers who prefer simple classification model rather than complex one. However, calculating the distance between each test data point and all training data points can be computationally expensive, particularly when working with a large data set. To address this issue, we have consulted an improved KNN algorithm based on the local mean, which significantly reduces the calculation complexity without sacrificing accuracy. We have applied our algorithm to several commonly used data sets on UCI and observed promising classification performance. Furthermore, we have extended the Euclidean distance measurement in the original algorithm to the level of vector norm. This expands the classification index of KNN beyond just Euclidean distance and provides more accurate and robust results.

articleTitle: A Parallel Transmission of Power and Data for EV Dynamic Wireless Charging Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: For the dynamic wireless charging system, this paper proposes a parallel transmission method of power and data for dynamic wireless charging. Power is transmitted through a magnetic field, while data is transmitted through an electric field composed of parasitic parameters of a coupling mechanism. In addition, due to the lack of direct wire connections between power and data transmission channels, the mutual interference between power and data transmission is relatively small, and the existence of data transmission channels hardly affects power transfer. In this article, the power transmission channel and data transmission channel were analyzed, and the crosstalk of power on data was analyzed. Finally, the effectiveness of this method was verified through simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Research on Design of Relay Protection Structure in Smart Microgrid-Zero Sequence Current Protection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The development of smart microgrid is an important supplementary part of China's power grid construction, and relay protection design is an important guarantee for the stable and safe operation of smart microgrid. In the relay protection structure, zero-sequence current protection has the advantages of high sensitivity, good quick action, no influence of overload and system vibration, and is widely used in power grids with voltage levels of 110kV and above. In this paper, according to the operation situation and line parameters of typical 110kV multi-power supply network, the action current value is set and calculated, and its protection range is analyzed. The zero-sequence current protection structure is designed, and the acceleration mode when it works with automatic reclosing is discussed. The zero-sequence current protection studied in this paper is simple and economical. When zero-sequence current protection and automatic reclosing work together, it has unique advantages in improving the reliability of power supply in power system and has high practical application value.

articleTitle: Extended Enhanced Spatial Modulation System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, we propose and investigate a new scheme, which is referred to as extended enhanced spatial modulation (EESM). In the EESM system, the spatial constellation vectors are exploited by utilizing both active antennas and multiple signal constellations. The advantage is that it can enhance the spectral efficiency as well as the reliability of transmission with the aid of the signal and space domains. Furthermore, the average bit error probability (BEP) are analyzed. Simulation results demonstrate that the lower BEP can be achieved by the EESM than existing spatial modulation schemes.

articleTitle: Application of Artificial Intelligence-Based Nonlinear Filtering Techniques in Chaotic Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Chaotic communication, due to its good interference immunity and privacy, is widely used in confidential communication. However, the existence of real-life nonlinear channels interferes strongly with the actual communication. Conventional adaptive filters have good handling effect on nonlinear channels. However, the traditional LMS adaptive filter cannot satisfy both the adaptive filter convergence speed and steady-state error. The NLSM can better handle nonlinear data and capture the noise in the data, but the accuracy of the algorithm needs to be improved for pseudo-random sequences. Therefore, a nonlinear filtering algorithm based on LSTM neural network is proposed in this paper based on common algorithms of artificial intelligence in order to get better recovery of signals passing through nonlinear channels. The algorithm combines the ability of LSTM with strong generalization and can handle complex nonlinear relationships. Simulation results show that the algorithm proposed in this paper recovers the signal with less error and more accurate results, and can make the signal through the nonlinear channel get better recovery. The results verify the superiority of the algorithm in this paper and show that the LSTM neural network nonlinear filtering algorithm has a broader application prospect in the field of chaotic communication.

articleTitle: Research on Early Warning of Social Stability Based on Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Once some social conflicts arising in the process of the country's development exceed people's psychological tolerance, they will affect the stability of the society, which in turn will affect the overall situation of reform and development. Therefore, it is of great practical significance to explore the establishment of an early warning model for social stability in China to improve the government's correct decision-making and rapid response. First of all, we need to establish a system of indicators affecting social stability, from the qualitative point of view, the data of social development, environmental protection and economic development. In the quantitative aspect, we selected GDP per capita, price index and prosperity index, and data index. Collaborative filtering algorithm and LOF of anomalous data detection algorithm were used to pre-process the data, and box plots were used to visualize the raw data. The correlation and causality of each index in the index system were analyzed and visualized by using Spearman's correlation coefficient method and one-way ANOVA. In order to establish SVM model and XGboost model for data in-depth study, Stackinng stacking method was used to combine SVM model and XGboost model. The random forest algorithm is used to calculate the importance index, while the impact factor index is added to establish the early warning model of disturbance on social stability. Meanwhile, the accuracy of the early warning index system model is explored.

articleTitle: Research on Construction and Contribution Analysis of Demand Forecasting Model Based on GBDT-LightGBM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: To construct a reasonable demand forecasting model and reduce the shortcomings of existing algorithms in this type of forecasting. In this paper, we construct a short-term demand forecasting model based on Gradient Boosting Decision Tree (GBDT) - The Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM) using an integration algorithm based on GBDT as the base learner, to solve the demand for short-term data forecasting. The optimal model is obtained through iteration by varying the amount of integration of GBDT and setting MAE, RMSE, and R2 test parameters. In this paper, the daily bike-sharing data of Washington, D.C. from 2011 to 2012 is used as the research object. The results show that the model achieves good results in experimental prediction, where MAE is 90.7788, RMSE is 125.5685, and R2 is 0.6680. It proves the robustness and generality of the model and provides some basis and methodology for solving short-term predictions.

Author Keywords: optimization of the number of regression trees

articleTitle: Intelligent Vehicle System Design for Forest Area Inspection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The current traditional forest inspection method is constrained by time and space factors, and there are problems such as high labor intensity and low efficiency. Therefore, an intelligent stm32 microcontroller-based intelligent cart control system for forest patrol is proposed in this paper, and the design mainly contains functions such as image recognition, path planning and wireless transmission. Lightweight convolutional neural network is used to achieve real-time image recognition on the microcontroller, and data enhancement is performed on the training set to simulate the forest environment and improve the robustness of the model; A* algorithm is used to achieve intelligent path planning of the cart; classical wireless string communication is used to achieve the map transmission function and remote call function. In this way, the all-weather monitoring of the forest area is realized. Finally, the effectiveness of the above functions is verified by simulation, which has good practical application value.

articleTitle: Short-time Traffic Flow Prediction with Integrated Passenger Information Using Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Traffic flow prediction is a very important and classic problem in intelligent transportation that has received considerable attention from scholars. Previous studies on traffic flow prediction have primarily relied on taxi data. However, while such studies have focused on taxi traffic flow information, they have often overlooked the importance of passenger data. Incorporating taxi passenger information can help uncover key traffic flow characteristics, such as road traffic conditions and local road resource demand. To this end, this paper proposes a CNN-BIGRU model that leverages both taxi passenger and taxi flow information to achieve more accurate traffic flow predictions. The proposed model transforms the taxi flow and passenger data into a feature matrix, which is then fed into the model. Specifically, a convolutional neural network (CNN) is utilized to mine the spatial information of traffic flow. The extracted spatial information is then input into a bidirectional gated recurrent unit network (BiGRU) to capture the data's time sequence relationships. Furthermore, the extracted time and space features are integrated to achieve the goal of accurately predicting short-term traffic flow. Experimental results reveal that our proposed model outperforms competing models on real-world datasets, demonstrating the efficacy and superiority of combining passenger data into traffic flow forecast analyses.

articleTitle: Automatic Detection of Surface Defects of Submersible Pump Impellers by Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Currently, the defect detection of submersible pump impellers in the industry mainly relies on physical methods, which suffer from high cost and inaccurate results. In this paper, a surface defect detection algorithm of submersible pump impeller based on machine learning is designed, presented image pre-processing techniques for the top-view images of defective and non-defective impellers of the submersible pump. The Histogram of Oriented Gradient (HOG) was then used to extract image features. Classification prediction models were built using eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), Adaptive Boosting (Adaboost), Random Forest (RF), K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), and Support Vector Machine (SVM) algorithms, and the prediction accuracy and time of each algorithm were compared. The results showed that the prediction accuracy of XGBoost was 92.23%, while the prediction accuracies of Adaboost, RF, KNN, and SVM were 81.38%, 89.31 %, 84.69%, and 79.69%, respectively. This indicates that XGBoost had the best classification prediction performance, followed by RF and KNN. In terms of time, KNN had the fastest running speed, while XGBoost was relatively slow. Finally, this paper considers that the XGBoost classification prediction model can meet the accuracy requirements of surface defect detection in submersible pump impellers and has practical value, but its running time needs improvement.

articleTitle: Skeleton-Based Adaptive Graph Convolutional Networks for Cockpit Sign Language Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: To solve the problem of barrier-free communication for deaf-mute people in traffic travel, the problem of cockpit sign language classification is proposed. On this issue, this paper proposes an adaptive graph convolutional network based on skeleton features (NA-AGCN), which is a way to improve the ST-GCN model. First of all, a lightweight normalized attention module NAM is added, which allows the network to suppress those insignificant weights, thereby improving network efficiency; then, an adaptive graph convolution module is proposed, which breaks the original graph The constraints of the convolutional adjacency matrix divide the matrix into three subgraphs, realize the extraction of global features, and increase the flexibility of the model construction graph. The model has achieved a good classification effect on the self-made cockpit sign language data set, and can accurately obtain the sign language expression results of the people in the video. This model has very good practical significance and can enable deaf-mute people to better enter society. Integrate into society and realize the effect of barrier-free communication between deaf and mute people in transportation and travel.

articleTitle: Research on the Auxiliary Training System of Tai Chi Fitness Qigong Based on Computer 3D Image Vision Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Based on Kinect motion capture technology, this paper developed a set of auxiliary teaching software suitable for Tai Chi practice in view of the movement requirements of beginners. This teaching system can show students the standard moves of Tai Chi. A Kinect software system based on motion capture technology is established to realize the standardized measurement of motion capture. The collected data are filtered and de-nosed and stored to form a standard motion database. By collecting the data of the subjects' tai chi movement process, the subjects' movement process is presented in the form of color images in the interface window. The bone data is corresponding to the color image, and the key nodes in the image are identified. After the two sets of data are collected, the Dynamic Time Wide (DTW) method is used to deal with the corresponding frame matching problem. By assigning the rotation information of the connection points to the corresponding Unity3D human body model. Experiments show that the method adopts motion capture technology, DTW and other methods, and has been effectively coordinated with Unity3 3D simulation software for practice and scoring.

articleTitle: Design of Hardware-in-the-Loop Simulation Test Platform for All-Condition Wind Turbine Control System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper proposes to develop an all-condition test platform based on the Beckhoff TWINCAT control software package, GH Bladed simulation software, and the physical back-to-back test system for the development of the master control software for the corresponding wind turbine generator system (WTGS). The application of the test platform can effectively overcome the testing difficulties of physical systems and the real-time failure of complete simulation systems, providing a solid and reliable test basis for the development of master control systems for new models.

Author Keywords: all-condition simulation of WTGS master control system

articleTitle: Bus Load Forecasting Based on Maximum Information Coefficient and CNN-LSTM Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of the scale of power system, the randomness, uncertainty and volatility of load become increasingly prominent, which brings huge challenges to the refined management of dispatching. Therefore, in order to forecast bus short-term load more accurately, this paper proposes a bus load forecasting model based on the fusion of maximum information coefficient (MIC), convolution neural network (CNN) and short-term memory network (LSTM). Firstly, MIC is used to analyze the correlation between multiple loads and between loads and weather factors to determine the model input. Secondly, build the CNN-LSTM network model, use the CNN network to extract features, construct feature vectors and input them into the LSTM network to complete short-term bus load forecasting. Finally, a case study is carried out with the data of electricity, cooling and heating loads of Tempe campus of Arizona State University in the United States. According to the experimental results, the accuracy of the model reaches 91.55%, which has better prediction effect than other models.

articleTitle: Generation of Digital Reconstruction Radiation Image and Display System Design
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Digitally reconstructed radiography (DRR) plays an important role in the treatment planning system (TPS) and many medical imaging applications such as 2D / 3D image registration. DRR generation technology is one of the core technologies of TPS. In this paper, the DRR image is generated by ray projection method based on volume rendering, and the display interface is designed to visualize the results. The medical image data set is resampled by reading the file header information of the medical image data set and the simulated light source projection distance, data set image spacing and pixel size are calculated by establishing the relevant coordinate transformation function and interpolation function. Finally, the DRR image results are displayed on the interface designed by the QT framework. The similarity is measured between the DRR image generated by ray casting method and the DRR image obtained by clinical TPS. The average of root mean square error(RMSE) is 0.25,and the peak signal-to-noise ratio(PSNR) is greater than 30 decibels and the structural similarity image measurement(SSIM) is positive. The results can provide the core technology for the subsequent DRR image display system and 2D / 3D registration. As well, the display interface can normally display the three orthographic views and DRR results of CT sequence images. It can be seen that the DRR image generated by the algorithm used in this paper has the same quality as the DRR image in clinical application, which proves the effectiveness of the algorithm and the good imaging effect.

articleTitle: An Improved Res-UperNet Method for Retinal Feature Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low detection accuracy and high influence by image quality of existing semantic segmentation algorithms in retinal feature segmentation, this paper proposes an improved Res-UperNet method for retinal feature segmentation (RURFS). In this paper, under the framework of the UperNet network model, an Resnet backbone network structure is introduced to effectively stack the number of neural network layers and thus improve the information extraction ability of the network; the number of network layers of the backbone network is increased to enable it to extract higher-level information; meanwhile, a data enhancement strategy of random rotation is used to enable the network to learn features in different directions. The experimental results show that the average intersection degree (mIou) of RURFS is improved by about 0.7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> compared with the original model on CHASE _ DBl dataset, and for different retinal features, the network can segment the features better at different luminance, and the improved network has better robustness to complete the segmentation of retinal features with strong segmentation capability.

articleTitle: Research on Lightning Disaster Prevention System Based on Computer Big Data Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, the structure characteristics of discharge tube and varistor of lightning protector in smart grid and the principle and advantages and disadvantages of discharge tube lightning protection are briefly discussed. According to the lightning protection function and working state characteristics of the low voltage arm of DC divider, the corresponding transfer function is set up. Secondly, the lightning protection simulation module of discharge tube and varistor based on EMTP software platform is established. On this basis, the whole simulation model of the secondary partial voltage circuit is derived. The working experiment circuit is set up in the electromagnetic compatibility laboratory of the working unit. After adjustment and improvement, the best lightning protection mode of smart grid is obtained. The lightning overvoltage model of ±500kV DC side of smart grid was built in PSCAD/EMTDC for simulation analysis. Simulation results verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: On-Line Monitoring System of Welding Quality Based on Machine Vision and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, an online monitoring system of welding quality based on machine vision and machine learning was proposed. A high-speed CCD camera was used to monitor the tail end of the molten pool, and the remove small objects algorithm and contour compensation based on convex hull algorithm were utilized to achieve high-precision collection of features such as the width and length of the tail of the molten pool. This effectively solved the technical challenges caused by welding splashes and plasma arc, which could interfere with visual acquisition. Combined with neural network algorithms, a welding quality model was established and validated to accurately identify defects such as welding undercut, welding deviations, and unstable welding processes, with a defect recognition rate of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\geq 94\%$</tex>.

articleTitle: A Circuit for Amplifying and Denoising ECG Signal
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Human signal is one of the important ways for various organs and tissues of the human body to interact. Therefore, detecting human signals can help people understand the current condition of the human body. In hospitals, ECG examination is one of the most common detection methods, it can help doctors determine the condition of the patient's heart. However, because the ECG signal has the characteristics of small amplitude and large noise, it is difficult to read the information carried by the signal. Based on the above discussion, this paper designs a signal processing circuit, which can amplify the circuit signal and remove the power supply noise at the same time. More importantly, its structure is simple and the power consumption is low. The simulation results show that the differential mode gain of the circuit reaches 38dB, the common mode gain reaches minus 41dB, and the power consumption is 18uW. The signal is not significantly distorted after amplification by this circuit. The circuit designed in this paper has a certain reference significance for the treatment of small human signals such as ECG signals in medical detection.

articleTitle: Analysis of Impact of Renewable Generation on Reactive Voltage of Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the increasing installed capacity of renewable generation such as wind farms and photovoltaic power station, the penetration of renewable generation in the power grid is becoming higher and higher.
