The voltage fluctuation and power factor fluctuation caused by renewable generation pose challenges to the stable operation of power grid. So, in this paper, the influence of renewable generation grid-connected on voltage deviation and power factor of substations are studied. Firstly, the mechanism and measured data are preliminarily analyzed. Secondly, observe the change of voltage and power factor by changing the output power of renewable generation. Finally, this paper concludes that in the case of high penetration of renewable generation in the power grid, without reactive voltage control, it may cause voltage deviation exceeding the limit and power factor of main transformer reduction.

articleTitle: A Dilated Convolution Neural Network for Gear Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The identification of gear faults is crucial for maintaining the mechanical performance of equipment in practical industrial applications. In the study, a unique fault diagnosis model making use of dilated convolution neural networks is proposed for the classification of gear faults through the analysis of vibration signals generated by gear systems. The proposed model leverages dilated convolutions to expand the receptive field size without adding more parameters. The features extracted from each convolutional channel are concatenated and fed into a classification layer. The proposed approach is evaluated on a publicly available gear fault dataset and outperforms other methods currently available in terms of classification accuracy while reducing the number of parameters and computational complexity. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of the developed method in diagnosing gear faults and highlight its potential as a promising approach for practical industrial applications.

articleTitle: Research on Path Planning Based on NAO Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the great progress made in the study of robots, the path planning of robots in research has become an important problem. The goal is for NAO to walk smoothly and plan suitable routes to complete the tasks given to it by people. The ant colony algorithm and genetic algorithm were used, and the environment was constructed by the raster method, and the feasibility of the two methods was analyzed by simulation experiment using Matlab software and the optimal results were compared. The path planning experiment using the NAO bipedal robot first makes a simple arrangement of the surrounding environment where the robot is walking, and uses choregraphe software to connect to the NAO robot and control NAO to complete the return path planning experiment.

articleTitle: Composite Multifunctional Robot for Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Research on a composite robot that integrates multiple functions. Amphibious motion unit with waterways. Ability to dig and shovel to transport fertilizer and pick cash crops. In this paper, a threaded propulsion wheel is used to increase the flexibility and amphibious capability of the device. Simulation of a threaded propeller wheel using FLUENT simulation. Combined with the Reynolds Stress Model (RSM), numerical simulations of two-phase flow of Newtonian and non-Newtonian fluids were performed for the threaded propeller before and after optimization. After analysis, an agricultural robot suitable for small and complex environments was obtained.

articleTitle: Research on Crop Planting Problem Automatic Answering System Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This study aims to provide accurate and reliable diagnosis and treatment services for crop pests and diseases. A knowledge graph was constructed using a large amount of literature and expert knowledge related to crop pests and diseases. Based on this graph, an efficient and accurate automatic question-answering algorithm was developed, which was implemented in a user-friendly prototype system utilizing the Pyqt5 architecture. The system has good scalability and flexibility to meet the needs of different user groups. The results of this study provide important support for agricultural production and crop pest control by promoting timely diagnosis and treatment of crop pests and diseases, improving agricultural production efficiency and economic benefits. This study also provides useful inspiration for the application of knowledge graphs in other fields.

articleTitle: Research on Suppression of LED Nonlinearity
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The high peak-to-average power ratio of orthogonal frequency division multiplexing technique in visible optical communication systems increases the probability of nonlinear distortion of the transmit signal. In order to reduce the BER of the system, an improved nonlinear compensation technique of K-nearest neighbors (KNN) algorithm is proposed. The algorithm takes into account the transmission characteristics of the signal and reduces the impact of uneven distribution of constellation points on the classification efficiency by weighting the training set data based on the number of constellation points within the KNN. The simulation results show that the improved KNN algorithm can effectively solve the nonlinearity problem of visible light communication system and reduce the BER of the system compared with the traditional KNN algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Charge and Discharge Control System of New Type Lithium Battery for Electric Vehicle Based on Computer Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper proposes a new charging and discharging control system based on computer big data algorithm, which can control the rapid charging of lithium ion batteries in different environments. Then, based on the classical heat conduction theory and the law of conservation of energy, a prediction model for the internal electrode temperature of the battery was established with time, ambient temperature, and a single current as input parameters. Constant current charging and discharging test. Use MATLAB/Simulink software to verify the accuracy of the current conditions. The simulation results show that the accuracy of the proposed variable parameter correction model is improved by 80%, the average error of the output voltage is less than 0.02 V, and the maximum error is about 0.05 V. This verifies the effectiveness and accuracy of the computer variable parameter correction model control system.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Smart Grid Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper discusses the design and research of smart grid based on artificial intelligence technology, which realizes automatic control and optimization of power system by applying particle swarm optimization algorithm and multi-objective optimization theory, in order to improve the operation efficiency and stability of power grid. In view of the current grid distribution chaos, data error consumption and other problems. Using particle swarm optimization algorithm and multi-objective optimization theory to design and research smart grid principles and methods, particle swarm optimization algorithm can find the best solution in the search space, and through the multi-objective optimization theory to balance different target requirements, so as to achieve the automatic control of power system. Deep neural networks are trained and utilized with large amounts of data for prediction and classification purposes. By using a variety of means, such as reinforcement learning, we get a diagnosis scheme of intelligent power system, and build a relatively perfect intelligent power management software. The results show that the new smart grid design system is more economical and simple than the traditional grid distribution. Better solutions for saving electricity.

articleTitle: Real Time Command System for Power Network Scheduling Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Designing efficient and reasonable power grid dispatch methods and trading mechanisms is a key issue in achieving market-oriented reform of electricity and effective allocation of electricity resources. The current power grid dispatch models face significant challenges such as inaccurate predictions of renewable energy and load, limited information transparency and increased system security vulnerabilities. With its decentralized, transparent, credible, and traceable characteristics, blockchain technology is an emerging distributed database technology that is well-suited for the power grid. By providing a distributed, secure, and transparent information system for power dispatch and trading, it can complement the power grid. This article introduces blockchain technology into power grid operations, covering topics such as the current development status of power grid technology, the data structure, types, and operating principles of blockchain. On this basis, combined with the characteristics of microgrids, this article analyzes the compatibility between blockchain technology and grid scheduling. Secondly, this article constructs an energy blockchain network (EBN) architecture and proposes a multi time scale power grid scheduling method based on smart contracts, taking into account energy storage and user side response. By fully enhancing the utilization rate of renewable energy and bolstering information security for the power grid system, this method offers a comprehensive solution. Simulation experiments have confirmed the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed scheduling strategy.

articleTitle: Research on Face Expression Complementary Recognition Based on DCGAN and VGG-16
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Face expression is the key in face recognition, and after being occluded, the accuracy of the algorithm's judgment of expression will be reduced and cannot accurately convey the information. This thesis investigates face expression complementation and recognition by first artificially processing the dataset with dimming and occlusion, and then performing operations on the generator and discriminator of the Deep Convolutional Generative Adversarial Then, the generator and discriminator of Deep Convolutional Generative Adversarial Networks (DCGAN) algorithm are operated, including gradient zeroing, back propagation and parameter updating, to realize the face image complementation process. Based on this, the complemented dataset and the original data are classified and judged using the Visual Geometry Group (VGG-16) algorithm. Finally, it is concluded that the face after the complementation using DCGAN contains more emotional information and higher recognition accuracy than the pre-processing dataset, and the research method has good feedback and prospects for further research.

articleTitle: A Robust Log Parsing Algorithm—Practice of Logslaw in Heterogeneous Logs of Pacific Credit Card Center of Bank of Communications(PCCC)
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Log is a semi-structured text that records the important behavior of the system operation. Through log analysis, we can understand the system behavior, detect system anomaly, locate system fault and even find the root cause of the fault after a fault is found. Generally, log parsing is the first and crucial step of log analysis. In recent years, a great deal of work has been devoted to log parsing. However, most of the work is based on some strong assumptions. These works can achieve good results in some scenarios, but not in others (e.g., the business log of the bank). What's more, their parsing effect is highly dependent on tokenization. In short, these algorithms are weak in robustness, so our paper proposed a robust log parsing algorithm - LogSlaw. LogSlaw is an online log parsing algorithm clustering logs based on the improved Jaccard Similarity, which can perform log parsing on heterogeneous logs with a large amount of data. To improve the accuracy and efficiency of clustering, we proposed to utilize the pseudo log template and the length difference to early grouping and early abandonment. Our algorithm has high parsing efficiency and effectiveness. It can achieve more than four times the efficiency of existing algorithms and get the best results in most datasets. LogSlaw also has strong robustness. It can achieve good results with a very simple tokenization strategy no matter how complex the scene is. We conducted experiments on both the public datasets and the business log datasets from Pacific Credit Card Center of Bank of Communications (PCCC), and achieved SOTA results on both datasets.

articleTitle: Material Location and Stacking Detection Method Based on LIDAR and Camera Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of material stacking in outdoor scenes of large warehouses, where accurate detection and localization of materials cannot be achieved with camera-based methods alone, we propose an approach based on LIDAR and camera fusion for material detection and localization. The LIDAR is used to collect 3D point clouds at different locations, and the non-stackable material areas are manually animated by the camera, and the point clouds are mapped with the images through the coordinate system and the pre-calibrated internal and external parameters to accurately obtain the material spatial location information. The results show that material stacking and detection methods based on the fusion of LIDAR and cameras can locate and detect materials in real time, regardless of the problem of indiscriminate stacking.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Human Activity Recognition Algorithms: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Human activity recognition is essential for developing personalized healthcare, fitness tracking, and fall detection systems. This study focuses on developing an accurate deep learning-based algorithm for recognizing human activities using accelerometer and gyroscope data. The proposed model is based on a 1D-CNN-BiLSTM architecture and is trained on a public dataset. In this study, six different human actions-walking, walking upstairs, walking downstairs, sitting, standing, and laying-are identified to examine how well the proposed model performs compared to a baseline model and to assess how well the model recognizes these activities. According to the results, the suggested model performs better than the baseline model at identifying human activity and is more accurate overall. All six activities can be recognized by the suggested model with high accuracy, with walking, walking downstairs, and walking upwards having the best performance. The model's success is attributed to its ability to capture both spatial and temporal dependencies in the data, allowing it to effectively recognize human activities based on accelerometer and gyroscope data. The study's findings have significant implications for developing activity recognition systems, especially for real-time health monitoring, fall detection, and fitness tracking applications. The proposed model's high accuracy can improve the performance of such systems, leading to better outcomes for patients and individuals. The study's limitations are also discussed, including the relatively small size of the dataset and the lack of variability in the activities performed. This study provides evidence of the effectiveness of a deep learning-based algorithm for recognizing human activities using accelerometer and gyroscope data. It demonstrates the potential of such models for developing accurate and reliable activity recognition systems with important applications in healthcare and fitness tracking.

articleTitle: Intelligent Fault Location of New Distribution Automation Terminal Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: After a fault occurs in the distribution terminal, the diverse types of faults, rapid reclosing, and complex transient situations make real-time fault location in the distribution network challenging. Existing fault location methods are vulnerable to factors such as fault type, transition resistance, and branch lines. Traditional distribution terminal fault location methods are difficult to solve this problem, so there is an urgent need for an efficient distribution terminal fault location method. Based on the theory of graph convolutional neural networks, this paper proposes a new method for solving the problem of distribution terminal fault location. The distribution network is treated as non-Euclidean spatial graph data. After abstracting the distribution network as graph data, the feature information on the nodes and edges of the distribution network is jointly used as input to the graph convolutional neural network. At the same time, this paper compares the different types of feature data on the nodes and edges of the distribution network, and there can be more choices based on the degree of automation. For the two forms of data, nodes and edges in the distribution network, an input layer that merges edge features is designed on the node. Then, through the hidden layer, node features are passed to achieve feature abstraction from local to global. The output layer adopts the design of edge aggregation, which transforms the distribution network fault location problem into a graph edge classification problem. The method proposed in this paper achieves a detection accuracy of 98.2%.

articleTitle: Algorithm Library for Medium and Long Term Electricity Sales Prediction Based on Adaptive Neural Network Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous growth of China's electricity consumption scale, the impact of electricity consumption differences and uncertainty fluctuations in different industries on grid dispatching and safe operation continues to deepen. From the perspective of electricity sales, accurate prediction of electricity sales in different industries is one of the important means to solve the above problems. Therefore, this article proposes a medium and long-term prediction algorithm library that covers multiple industry categories and considers multiple time dimension characteristics. First, a deep neural network model is established to mine the characteristics of electricity sales under the annual, quarterly and monthly dimensions, fully considering the volatility and differences of electricity sales of different user groups. Then, a variety of medium and long-term prediction algorithm models based on temporal attention mechanism are established to achieve refined prediction of electricity sales based on different characteristics of change laws. Finally, an adaptive training mechanism is established for optimization model parameters, forming a refined model parameter automatic tuning strategy, achieving intelligent prediction model matching and accurate prediction of different characteristics of electricity sales. The proposed method has been verified to be able to achieve accurate prediction of electricity sales in multiple time dimensions and at multiple user scales.

articleTitle: Research on Pulmonary Tuberculosis Diagnosis Method Based on Dual Attention Module
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Tuberculosis is a chronic lung disease caused by bacterial infection. Tuberculosis kills millions of people every year. Mycobacterium tuberculosis is extremely resistant to dry, cold, and varying environments, and can survive for months in harsh environments. For underdeveloped areas with severe TB, computer-aided diagnosis can help medical institutions screen suspected patients due to the lack of imaging doctors and testing reagents. Convolutional neural networks can help doctors to make auxiliary diagnoses, but due to certain redundancies in the feature maps, conventional convolutional neural networks suffer from poor generalization, which will lead to low accuracy of the model in identifying TB. In this paper, a novel dual attention module (DAM) is introduced. The DAM combines the channel attention module and the spatial attention module in a sequential manner. By applying attention mechanisms in both dimensions, it effectively reduces redundant information in the feature map. Moreover, the DAM can be seamlessly integrated into the backbone network. The proposed approach is evaluated on a dataset consisting of 7000 chest X-ray images, achieving an impressive diagnostic accuracy of 96.72% for TB X-ray images. The proposed CSANet, which combines an attention mechanism with a deep residual network model, is able to extract effective lesion information from chest X-ray images to detect TB more reliably. Compared to traditional deep learning networks, the accuracy, precision, sensitivity, and F1 scores are considerably improved, which can help to screen regions with severe TB.

articleTitle: Application and Research of Prediction Model Based on Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, several machine learning prediction models based on the keratoconus dataset are developed and compared to arrive at the best algorithmic model. The algorithm can improve the accuracy of fitting, reduce the complexity of the fitting proces. In this paper, 80% of the data collected from the keratoconus dataset was used as the training set and 20% as the test set to build prediction models by five machine learning algorithms. Linear regression, SVR, decision tree, random forest and XGBoost, and four evaluation metrics, including mean square error MSE, root mean square error RMSE, mean absolute error MAE, and root mean square log error RMSLE, were used to evaluate the performance of the prediction values FK of the above algorithms and finally validate the effectiveness of the models. Compared with the other four algorithmic models, the XGBoost model has the best overall evaluation indexes and will be the most effective when applied.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Cascaded Trans-Z-Source Inverter in Wind- Photovoltaic Hybrid Power Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Due to the change of external environment, wind-photovoltaic hybrid generation system faces the problem of insufficient output voltage and unstable power output. Cascaded trans-z-source inverter is z-source inverter with improved impedance network structure. Compared with the traditional inverter, it can accommodate multiple voltage sources and boost the output of the inverter system while improving the circuit efficiency. Therefore, the cascaded trans-z-source Inverter is applied in the wind-photovoltaic hybrid generation scenario. The household wind-PV hybrid generation system and different working status of the system containing working mode change logic are designed in this paper. Open and closed loop control for cascaded trans-z-source network are also proposed. The simulation results have shown that the inverter system including cascaded trans-z-source network has stable voltage output and large output voltage range. The designed inverter system takes into account the characteristics and challenges of the distributed wind-PV hybrid power generation, and to some extent solves the problems of low energy utilization efficiency, grid connection difficulty and complex inverter system structure. This can contribute to improving regional renewable energy utilization and peak-load shifting of the power grid.

articleTitle: The Application of Kansei Engineering System for Vehicle Interior Color Design
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Product innovation design is a classic problem in industry. Traditionally in the manufacture of vehicle, the focus has always been maker-centric design. The next decade is likely to witness a considerate rise in human-center-design. Especially, previous studies in vehicle interior have not dealt with the meaning of color. This paper tries to build an expert system, which is named as Kansei engineering system with qualitative and quantitative measurements which is used for vehicle interior color design. The Kansei engineering system (KES) has two kinds of operation, called Kansei engineering extraction system and Kansei engineering evaluation system. The former applies optimization to output the suitable design, and the latter is used to do semantic prediction. However, the similar system has already been existed in different fields, but the KES in vehicle interior color research is still limited. In optimization step, this study utilized genetic algorithm-backpropagation neural network to do design selection which might replace supervisors' work. Evaluations were built by training BPNN, GA-BPNN, SVM and GA-SVM to prediction the image ranking. A case about vehicle interior was provided to complete the computation. Results showed that these methods could be inspired to designers facing huge workloads not only automatic color design but other product elements as well. It is evidently clear from the findings that artificial intelligence might replace designer to make decision in conceptual or other design processes.

articleTitle: Data Mining Study of Wordle Based on Multi-Model Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: As a game that spreads across the Internet and stimulates people to think and learn, data mining of Wordle's report counts and their distribution is particularly important. In this paper, an ARIMA model and a BP neural network model based on the WOA are developed to perform in-depth data mining on Wordle. For model I, this paper uses ARIMA model fitting to fit the trend of the total number of historical report results over time, and obtains the R2 of the model as 0.986. Based on this, this paper establishes a prediction model for the interval of the total number of reports, and gives the prediction interval of the total number of report results on March 1, 2023 as [21211], [21814]. For Model II, this paper defines word attributes as the following four indicators: for example, the commonness of the word, the number of occurrences of the same letter in the word. The Spearman correlation coefficient between the percentage of reported scores to the total reported scores in the Hard mode and the word attributes was calculated. Finally, in the Hard model, the percentage of reported scores out of the total reported scores was significantly correlated with how common the word was and whether it began with a vowel letter. For Model III, this paper constructed a BP Neural network model based on WOA, which, in this paper, uses word attributes as the input layer and the report distribution of words as the output layer. In the WOA, the optimal weights and thresholds of the BP neural network are obtained in this paper by continuous search and approximation. The final model has a Mean Absolute Error value of 0.38, both of which have good performance. At the same time, this paper predicts the results of “EERIE”, and the obtained distribution results are rounded to [1], [7], [20], [22], [21], [19], [10]. Through the above modelling and calculation, this paper mines Wordle's user data, which has some theoretical significance for the healthy development of Wordle.

articleTitle: COVID-19 Content Safety Detection Algorithm Based on Multimodal Robustness
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper conducts a content safety analysis based on a multimodal dataset of COVID-19-related social media samples. A joint model of multimodal images and long texts is employed to perform an in-depth analysis of sample content. Relevant text, images, and other materials related to the pandemic topics on social platforms are collected to create a multimodal dataset of social media discourse on the pandemic. Traditional machine learning algorithms are used for in-depth data processing and topic analysis of the multimodal dataset, studying the topics people are concerned about, the main methods and ways of inappropriate discourse. Based on these results, discourses that lead to social insecurity are categorized into several categories. With this categorization, the dataset is labeled, and a multimodal deep learning model is designed. The model is used to conduct deep learning on the generated multimodal dataset, extracting their respective features, conducting feature fusion, and classifying the samples in the dataset. The discourses are divided into two major categories and several subcategories. Based on this, we propose the COVID-19 Content Safety Detection Algorithm (CSDMC, Content security detection algorithm of COVID-19 epidemic based on multimodal strong robustness). When compared with other algorithms in the experimental comparison, it achieves a relatively high accuracy rate. The experiment proves that this algorithm can effectively extract multimodal features and achieve a higher accuracy rate.

articleTitle: Improved RM-YOLO Model Based on Transformer for Intelligent Monitoring Meters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Pointer meters are still used in large numbers in power engineering because of their reliability in complex electromagnetic environments, but the complex electromagnetic and machinery environment of substations causes huge problems for intelligent identification to identify the meter. In order to solve the current problem of automatic recognition of pointer meters in substations, this paper proposes an improved RM-YOLO model based on Transformer. By introducing the Transformer module in the backbone, it enhanced the model's ability to integrate shallow and deep feature information. The fusion of multi-scale feature enhances the dynamic adjustment accuracy of meter edge feature at different scales. To solve the increased data volume and reduced computational speed caused by the introduction of the Transformer, the RMNet module is then introduced to replace the RepVGG module, significantly reducing the complexity of the model, effectively improving its recognition speed and further enhancing its ability to mine deep data. The method has been validated to achieve an average target recognition accuracy of 94.7%, enabling effective and accurate identification of pointer meters by inspection robots.

articleTitle: Adaptive Robust UKF Algorithm and Its Application in MIMU/GPS Initial Alignment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In MIMU/GPS integrated alignment, the observation of GNSS signals under occlusion and interference contains a lot of gross errors, and the system dynamics model is inaccurate. Traditional adaptive filtering cannot correct model anomalies when gross errors exist in the observation. In this paper, robust factors and adaptive factors are introduced to make appropriate adjustments to the observation noise covariance matrix and state prediction covariance matrix in the Kalman filtering equation. First, the correct equivalent weight factor is constructed to suppress the problem of gross error in observation; Then the prediction residual method is used to construct the adaptive factor and correct the anomaly of the dynamic model in real time. The prediction residual method overcomes the limitation that the observation is less than the state quantity in the conventional robust estimation algorithm. Finally, the algorithm is verified with the measured data. The experimental results show that this method can effectively suppress and eliminate the influence of gross errors in observations and dynamic model anomalies, and then balance the trust of filter estimates on GNSS observations and dynamic models, which can improve the accuracy and reliability of alignment.

articleTitle: Construction and Empirical Research of Engineering Data Prediction Model Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: At present, it is very important to select the data prediction algorithm and model which can meet the demand of engineering construction project for the whole construction stage. By analyzing and studying the basic theory of BP neural network model, this paper finds that the model has the ability to deal with nonlinear network relations of multi-input and multi output factors in parallel, and trains and learns network relations through the back propagation algorithm of output layer, hidden layer and input layer data. At the same time, it is found that the processing ability of multi-input and multi output nonlinear network relationship is exactly consistent with the multi-factor nonlinear mapping relationship of engineering data. Finally, taking bridge engineering data as an example, BP neural network toolbox in matlab software is used to train and learn the collected sample data with excitation function, training function, learning function and performance function, and then the simulation data of network model is compared with the actual sample data, as well as the error analysis of the new sample data. The prediction function of the generated BP neural network model on engineering data is proved, and then the prediction method of engineering data can be used for reference.

articleTitle: Integrated Learning-Based Feature Extraction and Regression Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Integrated learning refers to the method of statistically deriving new results from predictions made by some weak regressors, which can greatly improve the appropriateness and reasonableness of predictions and fits. In this paper, integrated learning algorithms are applied to the study of industrial wastewater impact factors for the first time. Here, the already mature random forest regression method based on Bagging method for integration of decision tree regressors for feature extraction and AdaBoost integration method for model fitting are mainly applied.

articleTitle: Vulnerability Detection System Based on Taint Range Propagation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: As the Internet environment becomes increasingly complex, network security gradually has more and more impact on people's real life. The research on static vulnerability detection is of great significance to the security of software systems. To solve the problems of imperfect technical support for basic analysis and high false alarm rate in the current mainstream static vulnerability detection methods, we design a vulnerability detection method based on taint value range propagation analysis, combining data flow analysis and abstract interpretation to achieve cross-functional variable value range analysis, and combining the identification and analysis of data security checks to achieve an automated vulnerability detection system prototype—RVDetecor, with good performance and detection, and applicable to real-world scenarios. In its analysis of the Linux kernel source code, RVDetecor verified 15 fixed issues.

articleTitle: Voice-Face Cross-Modal Association Learning Based on Deep Residual Shrinkage Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Establishing associations between voices and faces has grown in popularity in recent years, but current voice-face cross-modal association methods face challenges such as limited feature extraction capability and insufficient semantic associations. To address the aforementioned issues, we propose a voice-face cross-modal association learning method based on a deep residual shrinkage network. First, a deep residual shrinkage block is added to the dual-stream residual network to improve network training efficiency and acquire more discriminative embedded features. Then the multi-similarity loss function is used in metric learning to tap into the connections between voice and face modalities and enhance the network's robustness and generalization ability. In voice-face cross-modal verification, cross-modal matching, and cross-modal retrieval tasks, experimental findings indicate that our method improves accuracy by about 2% over existing baseline methods.

articleTitle: Research on the Protection of Architectural Heritage Based on SBAS and LSTM Technologies
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The protection of heritage buildings is of great historical significance. Land subsidence is related to the safety and stability of heritage buildings. Ground monitoring and prediction are the key steps for early warning and timely remediation of heritage buildings. In this paper, remote sensing technology is used to monitor the ground heritage buildings, and neural network LSTM is proposed to predict. Firstly, the SBAS-InSAR technology was used to monitor the land subsidence in the study area in the time series from September 2020 to December 2021. The results show that the maximum settlement rate in the study area reached - 65 mm/yr, the maximum uplift rate reached more than 50 mm/yr, and the maximum cumulative settlement reached - 70 mm. The correlation between the predicted results of the LSTM prediction network constructed in this paper and the actual results reached 0.92, indicating that the LSTM network has accurate prediction performance. Therefore, LSTM and SBAS technology can be used to assist decision-making, early warning and hazard mitigation in the protection of architectural heritage.

articleTitle: Research on Cooperative Control Strategy of Microgrid Distributed Generators Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In recent years, distributed power generation has received widespread attention due to its advantages such as low power generation cost, environmental friendliness, and high efficiency. A large number of distributed generators (DGs) are connected to the microgrid through power electronic converters, which affects the safety and stability of the system. Improving the system control strategy and the reliability and economy of the microgrid have become the key. Aiming at the problems of unbalanced power distribution and frequency fluctuation in traditional droop control, this paper combines microgrid decentralized control and blockchain technology, designs two control strategies based on a consistent iterative algorithm and Practical Byzantine Fault Tolerance (PBFT) respectively. Experimental results show that both control strategies can effectively coordinate DGs in the microgrid, ensure balanced power distribution, stable frequency, and optimal system operating costs; at the same time, the antitampering, traceability, and decentralization of blockchain technology can improve the fault tolerance, security, and scalability of the system.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Braille Layout Detection Model Based on Semantic Assistance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper proposes a hierarchical Braille layout detection model based on semantic assistance, BLayoutNet. As research on Braille layout analysis is relatively scarce and there is a lack of relevant datasets, this paper proposes a Braille layout detection dataset to support research in this field. Finally, experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model achieves stable and accurate detection of Braille layout. It is hoped that this model can serve as a strong baseline for Braille layout analysis tasks and promote the development of this field.

articleTitle: Short-Term Bus Load Forecasting Model Based on KICEEMDAN and IWOA Optimized Bidirectional Long- and Short-Term Memory Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the deepening of the construction of new power systems, bus load prediction of power systems plays an increasingly important role in the safe, stable, and economic operation of power systems, and accurate bus load prediction is an essential foundation for sound management of power grid dispatch and realization of energy consumption. In order to further improve the bus load prediction accuracy, this paper proposes a short-term bus load prediction method based on KICEEMDAN-IWOA-BiLSTM. Firstly, the ICEEMDAN method decomposes the original data to obtain multiple components with high smoothness. Then the decomposed components are clustered into fewer cluster classes using K-means++, and then the input feature set is obtained by feature filtering for each cluster class load. Based on the input feature set, IWOA is used to find the optimal hyperparameters for the BiLSTM of each cluster class load, then the BiLSTM is used to predict each cluster class load separately, and finally, the final results are obtained by superimposing the predicted values. The specific example shows that the prediction accuracy of the proposed method exceeds that of most of the comparison models compared with various single benchmark and combined models, and the prediction accuracy is well balanced with the prediction efficiency.

articleTitle: Research Hotspots and Trends of Maritime Emergencies in China -A Bibliometric Analysis Based on CiteSpace
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper aims to identify the hotspots and trends in the study of maritime emergencies. A total of 2,531 articles and journals with relevant topics of maritime emergency published on national knowledge infrastructure (CNKI) between 2002 and 2021 were selected as data for analysis. By analyzing the science mapping generated by CiteSpace, we explored some hidden relationships concerning authors, institutions, and keywords. The results indicate that the scope of research on maritime emergencies has almost reached saturation, but the depth of research is digging. Although a few small author-cooperation groups have been revealed on the map, no core group formed yet. The leading subjects of maritime emergencies are ships and offshore platforms. The common types of accidents are collision, ship-grounding, fire, and oil-spilling. The research foci may gradually shift from relief to monitoring and prevention. Artificial intelligence technology can impact the domain of maritime emergencies. Numerical simulation is an important technological means for scholars.

articleTitle: A New Key Negotiation Mechanism Based on Digital Certificate
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper analyzes the shortcomings of the traditional mechanism of cryptographic key negotiation between gateway and terminal, and proposes a new key negotiation mechanism based on digital certificate. This method presets the root certificate and authenticates the encryption key and decryption key of the protection key in the gateway and terminal in advance. It utilizes root certificates to verify the validity of terminal and gateway certificates, confirming the legitimacy of certificates and effectively preventing the possibility of counterfeit certificates. The dispersion technology is used to disperse the preset key first, and then the distributed sub-key is used to encrypt the random number, preventing the security of the whole system from being threatened after the master key is cracked. Finally, an effective combination of asymmetric algorithms and symmetric algorithms is used for session key negotiation and confirmation between the gateway and the terminal. Thus, after mutual authentication between the gateway and the terminal, the session key is obtained.

articleTitle: Road Identification Algorithm Based on Tire Acceleration Signal Under Multi-Vehicle Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, an intelligent tire algorithm based on back propagation neural network was proposed to identify the type of road peak adhesion coefficient. In the drum test, eight different vehicle conditions were taken into account for each of three simulated road conditions. Tire pressure of 900 or 1000 kPa, speed of 30 or 40 km/h, and load of 500 or 1000 kg were the parameters for the vehicle conditions. The corresponding tire x-acceleration signal was obtained using the tire acceleration sensor. Then, the original signal data was denoised using wavelet transform. The signal data was grouped by tire rotation period and the anomalous data was eliminated using the isolated forest algorithm. Following that, wavelet transform was used once more to extract the time domain and frequency domain characteristics from each batch of data, producing 45-dimensional feature parameters. Principal components analysis was applied to reduce the dimension of feature parameters to obtain 8-dimensional principal components. Finally, to identify the type of road peak adhesion coefficient, the normalized principal components and vehicle condition parameters (tire pressure, speed, load) were used as input to build a four-layer back propagation neural network, while the adam algorithm was used to optimize the learning rate. 10-fold cross validation was used to examine the model effect. The prediction results show that the model has a high identification accuracy for three types of road, with an average accuracy of 99.53%. The prediction accuracy of the models developed in 10-fold cross-validation fluctuates between ±0.2%. Under different vehicle conditions, the proposed road identification perception algorithm establishes the direct correlation between tire x-axis acceleration and road adhesion coefficient. With its high dependability and real-time capabilities, this algorithm has a wide range of possible applications in the areas of automated driving and intelligent tires.

articleTitle: A Design Method of Service-Oriented Software Architecture Description Language Supporting Performance Modeling
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In order to support the modeling and analysis of the performance of service-oriented software in the architecture design phase, this paper proposes a design method of service-oriented software architecture description language supporting performance modeling. Based on the mature architecture description language xADL and the operation characteristics of service-oriented software, this method proposes a design concept that can extend the structure and behavior of ADL, define the elements, parameters and their relationship of architecture performance modeling, and realize the accurate performance modeling of service-oriented software architecture.

articleTitle: Innovative Research on Improving Efficiency of LHU Algorithm in Autonomous System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Autonomous system refers to a computer system that can operate independently, control itself and make decisions by itself. It does not rely on the support of external systems or software, and can complete various tasks and operations autonomously. Autonomous systems are often highly intelligent and adaptive in that they can acquire environmental information through sensors, analyze and process that information to make appropriate responses, and perform tasks without human intervention. Autonomous systems have a wide range of applications in artificial intelligence, autonomous systems, automated control and other fields, which can improve production efficiency, reduce costs, improve safety and reliability. However, most of the existing methods of autonomous systems are based on traditional machine learning or reinforcement learning. This paper proposes an algorithm based on deep reinforcement learning to improve the learning efficiency of autonomous systems - LHU algorithm. The simulation dialogue experience is obtained from the interaction between autonomous systems and trainable user models. A posterior-session experience is the synthesis of successful session data by the posterior-module by acting on those failed session fragments and user goals. The dialogue experiences obtained from the user model and the posterior module provide more dialogue examples and positive feedback on dialogue strategy learning respectively. Finally, the reliability of the model is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Novel Hybrid Model Coupling WOA with BiLSTM Neural Networks and Attention Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Time series forecasting is a technique for predicting values or trends at future time points using historical data. In deep learning, the forecasting model built with a recurrent neural network (RNN) as the main body is a typical representative of time series forecasting techniques, but it is challenging to effectively extract potential high-dimensional features in historical series and significant information when the time series is too long. The WOA optimization algorithm and the Attention mechanism are the foundations for the bidirectional long-term and short-term neural network (BiLSTM neural network) time series prediction method proposed in this research. This technique creates a BiLSTM architecture made up of embedding and LSTM layers using historical time series data as input. The WOA parameters are used to perform decoding and network training. Time series features that reflect the complex dynamic changes in the load are also extracted. The internal dynamic change rules of the modelling learning features are then introduced, and the Attention mechanism is given to BiLSTM with various hidden states by mapping weighted and learning parameter matrices. weight, lessen the loss of past data, and increase the influence of crucial data before concluding the prediction. This study uses an actual calculation example from the public actual weather data set offered by Feijiang ai studio. When compared to BP neural network, LSTM neural network, BiLSTM neural network, and BiLSTM-Attention neural network, this method's prediction accuracy is 98.71%. The outcomes demonstrate the greater prediction accuracy of the suggested strategy.

articleTitle: Transient Temperature Prediction of Three-Phase Gas Insulated Busbar Contacts Based on CNN-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In the temperature detection of a three-phase Community Gas Insulated Bus Bar (GIB), the spatial distribution relationship between the measuring point of the housing temperature and the internal three-phase contact is not clear, and the time lag between the housing temperature and the internal contact temperature is strong. This paper constructs CNN based on convolutional neural network (CNN) and long short-term neural network (LSTM) structures. Prediction of the transient temperature of the internal contact by CNN-LSTM. First, the physical simulation experiment of the temperature rise of the three-phase common body GIB shell was carried out, and the temperature data of the three-phase common body GIB shell and contacts under different test currents were obtained; then, the convolutional neural network was used to extract the time of each temperature measurement point Features; After that, the long and short-term memory neural network is used to capture the spatial features between different measuring points; finally, the transient temperature prediction value of the GIB internal contact of the three-phase common body is output through the fully connected layer (FC). The results show that the multi-step prediction accuracy of the CNN- LSTM model on the test set can reach more than 94%, which is better than prediction algorithms such as MLP, LSTM, and CNN. The model can be provided as a new method and reference for GIB overheat monitoring.

articleTitle: Application Research Based on PCA-GA-BP Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Back propagation(BP) neural network has strong nonlinear mapping ability and can handle nonlinear classification and prediction problems well, but BP neural network converges slowly and easily falls into local minima, which affects the prediction accuracy. In order to improve the prediction accuracy, this paper took BP neural network as the research object, reduced the dimensionality of the data by Principal Component Analysis(PCA), and optimized the BP neural network using Genetic Algorithm(GA), in which, the roulette selection method is used to select the individuals with better adaptability when performing the selection operation, so as to establish a PCA-GA-BP neural network prediction model and compare with a single BP neural network model. The experimental results has shown that the accuracy of the optimized PCA-GA-BP neural network model has been improved by 9.8066<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, which has provided a constructive basis for the application and improvement of BP neural networks.

articleTitle: Glaucoma Diagnosis and Prediction Based on Multi-Scale Feature Coding
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Digital health has attracted a lot of attention as a result of the development of artificial intelligence (AI), big data, and fifth-generation (5G) telecommunications networks. AI, the Internet of Things (IoT), e-health, telemedicine, and big data analysis and application are all overlapping subfields of digital health. The World Health Organization (WHO) has a wealth of innovative opportunities in the field of digital medicine, and earlier this year issued a series of guidelines advising on how to leverage technology to provide evidence-based treatments for patients in practical situations. In order to promote the combination of artificial intelligence technology and practical application industry, especially clinical medicine, this paper conducts a series of studies on the diagnosis and prediction of glaucoma through deep convolutional neural network. The final results have certain clinical application value. Using AlexNet and LeNet two full convolutional neural network models, the Batch Normalization layer is added to the original model for normalization processing to speed up the convergence speed of the training model. The obtained glaucoma fundus retinal images are trained and compared. At the data set level, the original data is enhanced and expanded, and the model effects before and after expansion are compared again. The final experimental results show that the LeNet model has a better processing effect on simple images. The correct rate of the training set is 98 %, and the correct rate of the verification set is close to 100 %.

articleTitle: Traffic Prediction for New York City Based on Graph Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The real-time speed of each roadway segment in a network is essential in many urban traffic environments, from transportation route planning in freight transportation to congestion avoidance in advanced traveler information systems. Therefore, accurate real-time average road speed prediction is of utmost importance. Vehicle speeds and travel times can vary considerably in urban environments due to traffic congestion caused by accidents or adverse weather conditions. At another level, one can also predict the future of each road segment by the speed variation of the surrounding road segments and the impact of the surrounding road segments on that road segment. This paper presents a project to predict the real-time average speed of selected road segments in New York City using graph neural networks. It focuses on predicting road segment speeds using Movement data from Uber vehicles and road network data collected over a considerable period as input. In this paper, different machine learning and data mining methods are applied, and computational results are reported on actual data to demonstrate the accuracy of the obtained predictions and the model's superiority.

articleTitle: Road Surface Damage Detection Based on Knowledge Distillation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: As an important public infrastructure, road contributes to economic development and growth, brings significant social benefits. However, due to a variety of factors, the road surfaces will wear and deteriorate over time. When there is a slight crack in the pavement, most will deteriorate rapidly if not repaired promptly, which can greatly affect the life of the road. Therefore, developing a road surface damage detection algorithm is an urgent demand. We use the knowledge distillation technology to solve this problem. First, the similarity-preserving knowledge distillation was improved by adding a mask block to make the model transmit only the key feature information of the local region. Secondly, by making the boundary box of the teacher output and ground truth do non-maximum suppression, the image area of the distillation in the output layer is restricted, and the transmission of background information by the teacher is reduced. the performance of the student is improved by 1.2% in mAP@0.5 on average and 2.2% in mAP@0.5:0.95 on average compared with the state-of-the-art method.

articleTitle: Weekly Electricity Forecasting Method Based on Double-Layer lightGBM-GRU-IBES Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper presents a power forecasting method based on the two-layer lightGBM-GRU-IBES algorithm, aiming to ensure stable power grid development and control power costs. The proposed method comprises the following steps: First, the processed feature data is fed into the first layer of the lightGBM model to perform feature importance analysis, filtering features with high correlation. Next, the selected features are input into the second layer, which includes both the lightGBM model and the GRU model, for training and prediction. Finally, the GRU model's predictions are weighted and corrected to enhance the lightGBM model's predictions, producing the final power forecasting results. To further enhance prediction accuracy, the improved BES algorithm is used to optimize the model's hyperparameters. The method's performance is evaluated using real electricity data from Yunnan Province through an example analysis. The results demonstrate that the proposed model outperforms traditional classic models in terms of accuracy and fitting, achieving high-quality electricity forecasting. This approach holds promise for accurate and effective power consumption prediction, benefiting power grid stability and cost control.

articleTitle: Traffic Target Detection and Recognition System Based on Improved YOLOv5 and DeepSORT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Traffic target detection and recognition is an important aspect in the field of intelligent transportation, which directly affects road safety. To address the problem of diverse traffic target categories and the high accuracy and real-time requirements of target detection, this paper proposes an improved YOLOv5 algorithm, using MoblieNetV3 as a lightweight feature extraction network instead of the original CSPDarknet53, which includes the introduction of SE attention mechanism, replacing the activation function withh-swish, while using the BiFPN structure to replace the original FPN+PAN structure to enhance multi-scale feature fusion, thus realizing the optimization of the YOLOv5 algorithm in terms of accuracy, speed and lightweight. Experimental results show that the improved YOLOv5 algorithm effectively improves mAP by 6% in the recognition of the traffic sign dataset TT100K, with detection speed up to 60 f/s and model size of only 11.4 MB; the improved YOLOv5 algorithm combined with DeepSORT algorithm can complete the recognition and tracking of dynamic traffic targets. It has achieved a 30.4% MOTA in a self-made pedestrian and vehicle dataset, while the number of identity transformations is reduced. By integrating the two algorithms in a dual-threaded way, a smart traffic system can be ultimately built to achieve traffic target detection and recognition selectively based on actual scene requirements.

articleTitle: Optimization of BP Neural Network Based on Improved Dung Beetle Algorithm for PV Array Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the rapid growth of the scale and quantity of photovoltaic (PV) power station construction, more and more PV arrays are facing operational and maintenance challenges. In recent years, many artificial intelligence algorithms have been successfully applied to fault diagnosis of PV arrays. In response to the problem of falling into local minima in the backpropagation (BP) neural network algorithm, this paper proposes a fault diagnosis method based on an improved dung beetle algorithm optimized BP neural network (LIDBO-BP). This method initializes the population by logistic chaotic mapping, and adaptively adjusts the reproduction and foraging boundaries of dung beetles by introducing optimization state information. The improved dung beetle algorithm is applied to optimize the initial weights and thresholds of the BP neural network to establish a fault diagnosis model. The results of simulation and experiments show that optimizing BP neural network through the improved dung beetle algorithm can effectively improve the accuracy of PV array fault diagnosis, and show practicality in online fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Composition Analysis and Identification of Ancient Glass Products Based on Spectral Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the continuous development of cultural relics and archaeological techniques in China, the composition analysis and identification of ancient glass products have gradually become the focus of discussion. In this paper, we use principal component analysis to analyze the classification pattern of two types of glass, and analyze the main factors that affect the classification of high potassium glass and lead-barium glass, respectively. The chemical composition of each class was analyzed by subclass analysis using spectral cluster analysis, and lead-barium glass could be divided into four subclasses, and high-potassium glass could be divided into three subclasses. And the reasonableness and sensitivity of the algorithm were tested by calculating the composite correlation coefficient and class averaging method, and the reasonableness of the algorithm was obtained to be stronger and less sensitive. Then, based on the previous paper, we added weathering and non-weathering as classification conditions, and used principal component analysis to classify the unknown category of glass artifacts into two categories: high-potassium glass and lead-barium glass, and then further classified them according to the subcategory classification method in the previous paper. The sensitivity and rationality of this classification algorithm were finally tested by the class averaging method.

articleTitle: Path Planning of Aerospace Simulator Based on Improved Wolf Pack Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In order to deal with the complex environmental factors in microgravity test system, an improved wolf swarm algorithm (IWPA) was proposed and applied to the path planning of space simulator in micro gravity environment. Different from the traditional wolf colony algorithm, this paper uses Tent mapping to initialize the population; Introduce adaptive weight coefficient; And improve the fierce wolf's attack strategy; The wolves are updated in the iteration process by introducing the wolves' updating scale factor and reverse learning strategy. Considering the dynamic characteristics of the simulator, the position points obtained from the algorithm are used as control points, and the curve is fitted by B-spline, and the traffic cost of the fitted curve is used as the evaluation standard of the path. The performance of IWPA and WPA is compared by several benchmark functions, and the results show that IWPA is better than WPA. Finally, the algorithm is applied to the path planning of the simulator in the microgravity environment model. The experimental results show that IWPA has better path planning performance than WPA.

articleTitle: Research on Wildlife Management Based on Three-Parameter Discrete Grey Prediction (TDGM) Model and Algorithm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Masai Mara National Reserve (MMNR) is created to protect wild animals and plants and other natural resources, but the lack of appropriate policy and management strategies has led to an increase in conflict between people and animals. This article has done a detailed study of wildlife management methods through the TDGM model. First of all, the data of 9 indicators of Marseille Malaysla from 1971–2000 is described, and an improved gray absolute related model to analyze the correlation between indicator data is established. Then, the regression analysis method is used to establish the functional relationship between animals interaction with people. The sensitivity of the function model is analyzed, finding the appropriate strategy direction and making suggestions. Next, use the group decision-making model to score and sort the strategy effect, and select the optimal strategy to form the optimal solution. Finally, build a TDGM model to compare the changes before and after the implementation of the optimal strategy, and test its stability.

articleTitle: Research on High-Speed Gait Planning and Control of Quadruped Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In order to improve the high-speed adaptive performance of quadruped robot in complex terrain, a high-speed motion planning and control method for quadruped robot is studied. The model predictive control method is adopted and the whole-body dynamics control strategy is integrated, two kinds of swing trajectories are planned and designed, and high-speed stable control of the robot under two kinds of gaits are achieved. Finally, the feasibility of the method is verified by experiments and the power consumption is compared for different high-speed gaits.

articleTitle: Research on k-Means Algorithm Based on Differential Privacy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the rapid rise in the scope and frequency of use, the shortcomings of clustering algorithms in unsupervised learning in terms of privacy protection are gradually exposed. In order to prevent the privacy leakage problem in the process of data mining, this paper investigates the privacy budget allocation scheme of k-means algorithm based on differential privacy, proposes an optimization scheme of privacy budget allocation based on arithmetic technique, designs experiments to prove its effectiveness, and completes a demonstration system of k-means clustering algorithm optimization based on differential privacy.

Author Keywords: k-means algorithm based on differential privacy

articleTitle: Automatic Monitoring Area Delineation Method Based on Multi-Source Data Fusion and Self-Calibration
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: For large warehouses in the automatic division of different monitoring areas there is a masking problem, based only on a single camera device on the work area division cannot accurately divide the monitoring area, even if the use of LIDAR and camera data fusion method to divide the area, due to the need for calibration between the two-sensor data, there is a lot of human involvement. In this paper, we propose a method to automatically segment the surveillance area based on multi-source data fusion and self-calibration, fuse multiple data through image self-calibration and point cloud data self-calibration, and share data transmission among multiple devices via networking. The proposed method can achieve accurate monitoring area partitioning in different scenarios, with strong accuracy in data fusion and self-calibration. The proposed method has strong applications in the field of real-world surveillance, where it can improve the efficiency and accuracy of surveillance systems and reduce manual intervention.

articleTitle: Research on the Characteristics of Wordle Mini-Game Based on GA-BP Neural Network and K-Means Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: First, an ARIMA-based prediction model for the number of reported outcomes at future dates was developed. After processing the collected data, the smoothness of the number of reported outcomes was verified, and an intrinsic trend analysis of the data was performed to demonstrate the validity of the ARIMA model for predicting the number of reported outcomes at future dates, and the parameters of ARIMA were fitted using historical data to determine the final prediction model as ARIMA. secondly, one prediction model based on the GA-BP neural network algorithm was developed for the relevant percentages of future dates. At the same time, the GA algorithm was introduced for optimization to obtain the optimal initialization of the BP neural network. We use the frequency of letter occurrences together with the date as the input word feature and the correlation percentage as the output, and the prediction results are within the valid interval. Third, the word difficulty classification model and word scoring model were built based on the improved k-means clustering algorithm and PCA, respectively. To improve the drawback that the k- value in k-means algorithm cannot be determined, were introduced CH value, DB value. as indicators to evaluate the k- value, and combined the entropy weight method with Topsis to get the optimal number of clusters as 3 and the clustering index as the correlation percentage, and then applied the k-means algorithm to classify the words. We used the word difficulty ratio to determine the difficulty coefficient of each category, and also combined the score interval of each category obtained by PCA. Fourth, we found that the Wordle trivia game has the characteristic of viral spread in blocks, and more and more players choose the difficult mode as time goes by.

articleTitle: Real-Time Energy Consumption Analysis in Load-Cycling Processes of Coal-Fired Power Unit
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In order to eliminate the fluctuating impact of renewable energy on the power grid, coal-fired power units undertake the increasing peak-shaving tasks, but the energy consumption of coal-fired units in transient process is difficult to evaluate. Based on the calculation method of the energy consumption on the steady state operating condition and the operating characteristics during transient process, from the two parts of the boiler and steam turbine, considering the boiler heat storage in the transient process and the influence of the deviations in turbine steam thermodynamic parameters, with some simplifications to meet engineering application requirements, finally a more general energy consumption analysis model is established. With the model the real-time energy consumption calculation of coal-fired units can be carried out under the whole operating condition. The energy consumption analysis model is applied to a 660MW ultra-supercritical unit, and the calculated energy consumption results are consistent with the measured coal consumption trend. Furthermore, the energy consumption characteristics of the model are compared with that of the simulation model. The data of the two models agree well, and the difference between the calculated values of the standard coal consumption rate is less than 1%, which proves the reliability of the energy consumption analysis model.

articleTitle: A Basketball Player Technical Analysis Framework Based on Decision Tree Optimized Recursive Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this study, we unveil a novel and groundbreaking methodology that utilizes a Recursive Neural Network (RNN) optimized with a Decision Tree for the analysis of basketball player performance. This approach is transformative in its integration of these two powerful models to yield more accurate predictions and more insightful analysis. The focus of our study is the ratio of two-point to three-point shots, which we identify as a pivotal determinant of a player's skill level and strategic approach to the game. This metric offers a quantifiable measure of a player's shooting efficiency and decision-making capabilities on the court, and its accurate prediction is of vital significance to player development and game strategy formulation. To this end, we present a model that employs a Decision Tree optimized RNN to predict these shooting ratios with unprecedented accuracy. This model leverages the robust decision-making capabilities of Decision Trees and the temporal pattern recognition abilities of RNNs, thereby providing a potent tool for the detailed analysis of basketball techniques. The use of an optimized RNN not only boosts the predictive accuracy of the model but also enhances its ability to generalize and adapt to new data. A detailed comparison between the Decision Tree, RNN, and Decision Tree optimized RNN models forms a significant portion of our study. Our findings indicate that the Decision Tree optimized RNN model significantly outperforms the other two models across all evaluation metrics. This not only validates the effectiveness of our proposed model but also reinforces its potential as a powerful tool for technical analysis in the realm of basketball. In conclusion, this paper provides a comprehensive exploration of a cutting-edge technique for basketball player performance analysis, offering a fresh perspective on player skill assessment and game strategy optimization.

articleTitle: A Decomposition-Based Dynamic Reference Vector Adaptive Evolution Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Many predefined and improperly adjusted reference vectors in decomposition-based algorithms are invalid on irregular Pareto fronts (PFs). A dynamic reference vector adjustment based on a decomposition-based multi-objective evolutionary algorithm (DDMOEA) is proposed in this paper to address this problem. The algorithm separates the multi-objective problem into several sub-problems and sorts them according to dominance and diversity. A dynamic reference vector adjustment strategy is applied to guide the search area and obtain a set of optimal solutions that reflect PFs. By dynamically adjusting the reference vector, useless or overly close reference vectors can be deleted, and new reference vectors reflecting PFs can be generated, which is more conducive to the search process of the population. The proposed DDMOEA can improve the partitioning of sub-spaces and the performance of many objective problems with irregular PFs while considering computational complexity. In addition, in many objective optimization problems, the neighborhood adaptive strategy used in the algorithm reduces selection pressure while ensuring diversity. Experimental results prove that this algorithm can overcome multi-objective optimization problems with various categories of PFs compared to several of the most relevant algorithms.

articleTitle: Table of Contents
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)

articleTitle: A Five-segment Space Vector Pulse Width Modulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, the space vector pulse width modulation (SVPWM) is analyzed theoretically. By comparing the five-stage SVPWM and the seven-stage SVPWM, an improved five-stage SVPWM is proposed. The simulation in Matlab / Simulink shows the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Vehicle Target Detection in Day-Night Mode Based on YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the development of computer technology, autonomous vehicle technology has been rapidly updated. Robust and efficient vehicle detection on the road is the key task of autonomous vehicle environment perception. At this stage, many scholars have done a lot of research on daytime pattern detection using machine learning and deep learning technology. However, there is still a lack of vehicle detection in night mode.
