The main work of this paper is to create a new data set, and use different models (n, s, m, l, x) of a single-stage target detection algorithm YOLOv5 to verify the effectiveness of detecting vehicles on the road in day and night mode. Three evaluation parameters are used to evaluate the efficiency of the model: recall, precision and mAP. The goal of this paper is to find an efficient model to improve the accuracy of day-night vehicle detection, and provide vehicle condition detection results. This can provide an effective visual perception for the auto drive system.

articleTitle: Research on Wordle Game Based on Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Wordle is the most popular crossword game in the world today, attracting the attention of more and more Internet users. In this paper, the data files generated from the results of Wordle game are studied. In this paper, we first performed Pearson correlation analysis on the number of word attributes and difficulty patterns obtained after data processing, and obtained correlations between various attributes of words and the number of words in difficulty patterns, except for a weak correlation with the ratio of scores of letter usage frequency, but no significant correlation with other attributes. Then, we used a gray dynamic neural network model, combining gray theory with traditional neural networks, to select appropriate word attributes and train the model, which achieved a prediction accuracy of 90.25%. The original data was substituted into the model for testing, and a confidence level of 80.21% was calculated. The most significant uncertainty affecting the model was the inherent impression of the word in people's minds.

articleTitle: Research on Load Forecasting of Power Systems Based on GA-BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low accuracy of short-term load forecasting in power system, this study combines genetic algorithm GA and BP neural network to establish a short-term forecasting model for power system load forecasting. Firstly, the weights and thresholds of BP neural network are optimized using genetic algorithm GA to get the optimal solution of BP neural network prediction model. Then the validity of the prediction model is verified by examples. The results show that the improved model can effectively reduce the measurement error of the BP neural network model and improve the prediction accuracy, which provides a reference and reference for the development of short-term load forecasting in China's power system.

articleTitle: A Heatmap Regression Approach for Right Ventricle Anatomical Landmarks Localization on Echocardiography
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In the process of quantitative cardiac analysis based on echocardiography, the localization of right ventricle anatomical landmarks is a critical step. However, manual labeling of these landmarks by professional physicians is a costly, time-consuming, and labor-intensive process that is also prone to both inter-observer and intra-observer variations. Therefore, we propose n heatmap regression approach to automatically locate right ventricle anatomical landmarks on echocardiography. Firstly, we propose an improved U-Net model, which has a stronger ability to extract features and exploit relationships between the coordinates of landmarks. Secondly, we analyze the limitations of L2 loss in our task. Building on this analysis, we propose a new loss function, Weighted Smooth L1 loss, which not only balances foreground and background pixels but also makes the model more robust to noise. Experiments show that the proposed improved U-Net and Weighted Smooth L1 loss can effectively enhance the landmark localization effect of the model.

articleTitle: Research and Design of YOLOv5-Based Industrial Defective Product Inspection System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Industrial defective product detection is an important quality control tool, which is of great significance to ensure the safety and reliability of products. In this paper, we propose a design of an automatic industrial defective product monitoring system based on YOLOv5 model and FPGA hardware platform for industrial defective product detection task. This paper first introduces the principles and loss functions related to the YOLOv5 model, and then elaborates the overall system architecture design, including hardware selection, hardware platform construction, optimization, quantization, mapping and verification steps of the YOLOv5 model. The system designed in this paper integrates deep learning and FPGA development techniques to configure and map the ZCU102 FPGA embedded platform so that it can load and execute the YOLOv5 model, and communicate and interact with external devices to realize an end-to-end industrial defective product detection system.

articleTitle: Research on AI-Assisted Optimization System for Supply Chain of Computer Intelligent Electronic Trading Market
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Based on computer intelligence, this paper introduces the linear programming model and its generalized inverse optimization model which can solve the optimization allocation of supply chain resources oriented to the market. A supply chain resource optimal allocation support system with model construction and solution as its core module is designed. The optimal volume order quantity and option purchase quantity of distributor in traditional supply chain are deduced. The fast modeling and solving module of linear programming inverse optimization model and expert decision support module are built in the system to realize the fast optimal allocation of supply chain resources facing the market. Finally, a simple example is given to verify the effectiveness of the model and its algorithm.

articleTitle: Intelligent Identification of Modulation Patterns Based on the GA-BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Traditional modulation pattern recognition is based on extensive manual experience and sophisticated signal processing equipment, which leads to complex and costly steps. The algorithm in this paper uses the GA-BP neural network to classify and identify eight modulated signals such as GPSK, PAM4, CPFSK, FM, and DSB. The algorithm in this paper extracts the instantaneous parameters of the signal, the higher-order cumulants, and uses a wavelet packet energy spectrum analysis-based method for feature extraction of the signal. The technique optimizes the initial weights and thresholds of the BP neural network and constructs a neural network classifier with higher performance. When the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) is 20 dB, the average modulation recognition accuracy of this algorithm is higher than 98%.

articleTitle: Modification and Application of ALPI Model Based on Image Gray Value Analysis and K-Means
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In this paper, different regions of the collected data samples are grayed out by the image gray value analysis method to obtain the average gray value, and the evaluation levels obtained from the ALPI model classification of different regions are modified by the AGV and K-means algorithms. The relevant data are also collected for validation, and the results show that the accuracy of the classification of ALPI model after modification is improved from 81.4% to 89.3%, in order to provide some reference significance for the field of ALPI model measurement.

articleTitle: Optical-ISAR Image Translation via Denoising Diffusion Implicit Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Sufficient training data play a crucial role in deep-learning techniques, however, available training samples are not always accessible for specific targets, such as satellites. Producing synthetic data through generative model is a major solution for the lack of training data. In this paper, we propose a Denoising Diffusion Implicit Model (DDIM) to generate the Inverse Synthetic Aperture Radar (ISAR) satellite images from the synthesized optical counterparts. Efficient and abbreviated feature extraction method is proposed in optical-ISAR image translation. A domain-cross generative model is then established with respect to the generative task and feature learning modules obtained from the translation model. Extensive experiments validate the feasibility and performance of the proposed approach, which outperforms the existing generative models such as CycleGAN in terms of inception score and structural similarity index.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer 3D Image Vision Technology in Digital Media Art
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper uses a new visualization method. The goal is to improve the results of 3D image reconstruction. Firstly, the hardware architecture of the system is improved. The clock of the system is extended. The combination of CY25400 micro controller and CDCVF2510 micro controller greatly speeds up the detection speed. Then the key technologies such as image parsing module, image preprocessing module and 3D visualization module are studied. The visualization elements are fed back to the 3D image to realize virtual reconstruction. Finally, the conventional 3D imaging technology is used to complete the simulation and comparison test in the same scene. Experiments show that this method can obtain high 3D image reconstruction effect. The system can clearly show the edge area of the image, and can meet the requirements of users.

articleTitle: Research on Wind Speed Prediction Modeling Based on Single Variable Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In the related research of traditional wind speed prediction models, experts and scholars at home and abroad have proposed many models and methods, and these models and methods generally have certain problems. Therefore, there is no good method to determine the delay. When establishing wind speed models, they often ignore the impact of the delay on the model, which will lead to their models only having high accuracy for wind speed prediction results in certain specific environments, Not universally applicable. Based on the above situation, this paper proposes a new method to use the attention mechanism to make the model self-learning search delay.

articleTitle: Design of a Three-Coil-Based Wireless Charging System for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Wireless power transmission (WPT), also known as wireless charging technology, brings convenience to people's lives, particularly in the new energy vehicle industry, where the advantages of wireless charging over wired charging are more evident. However, traditional single-to-single WPT modes present various challenges, including high voltage and current stresses, substantial power loss, and excessive heat generation. These issues primarily stem from the significant power demands of electric vehicles. To address this issue, this text proposes a single-transmitter triple-receiver WPT system, where three receiving coils are connected in series and collectively deliver power to a load. This configuration enhances the output power while reducing the voltage and current stress, thereby improving system efficiency. Furthermore, this approach eliminates the need for an additional DC/DC circuit for voltage boosting, resulting in a simple and reliable circuit design. The main work involves modelling the system and performing parameter characteristic analysis. After selecting appropriate parameter values, circuit simulations are conducted using the Simulink platform. Based on the simulation results, the system exhibits the following parameters: an input voltage of 200V, an output voltage of 385V, all three currents are within 20A, resulting in a power output of 7382 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$W$</tex>, and an efficiency of 81%.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Communication Data Transmission Security System Based on Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper designs a new overall architecture of computer vision-based protection and monitoring system. The consistency between the design and DI&C-ISG-04 is analyzed. Three copy storage architecture is used to realize data security storage. In terms of secure transmission, Open VPN technology is used to establish secure network transmission channel. Digital certificate authentication is adopted to realize the data interaction between Intranet and extranet. In terms of network security, network security devices are deployed in accordance with the requirements of equal protection Level 3 to protect against external and internal network attacks. The test results show that data CAN be transmitted reliably through CAN data bus in fuse electronic safety system. This method can overcome the disadvantages of point-to-point communication system effectively, not only has higher information transmission rate, transmission capacity and adaptability, but also improves the utilization rate of resources.

articleTitle: An Improved Particle Swarm Algorithm for UAV Path Planning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Optimizing UAV flight paths is a critical challenge for modern unmanned aircraft systems. Conventional manual methods are inefficient and error-prone. To address this, we propose an improved 3D path planning algorithm using particle swarm optimization. Our method employs a multi-objective evolutionary genetic algorithm to determine optimal waypoints while considering terrain obstacles, distances, and performance constraints. An adaptive linear coefficient of variation with constant acceleration and maximum velocity enhances optimization. We use a multi-objective genetic algorithm to tackle nonlinear planning, optimizing convergence by replacing undesirable particles. For complex environments, we combine genetic and particle swarm algorithms with simulated annealing for global optimization. Experimental results show outstanding performance, surpassing other algorithms in accuracy and stability. Our approach promises significant advancements in UAV path planning, aiding UAV technology development and operation.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Segmentation Leveraging Optimized U-net Models
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Segmenting a brain tumor is a difficult project in the field of computer vision. It is of great importance in depicting the morphology of the tumor and hence assists clinicians to develop treatment plans. Machine learning, specifically deep learning techniques, has shown promising potential in image segmentation. By learning from large-scale datasets, the model could achieve useful information for identifying healthy and tumorous tissues. One of the most effective models is U-net. Since U-net is first proposed in 2015, it has been validated in multiple fields, especially for medical image processing. The core challenge of applying it to brain tumor segmentation is the complexity of the semantics it possesses. To seek the optimal model for the task, extensive ablation studies are conducted for searching the optimal hyperparameter combinations, measured by dice loss, IOU, and dice coefficient. Several modifications are implemented on the original built of U-net, including applying U-net++ and adding the attention module.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Integrated Optical Waveguide in Optical Interconnection on Chips
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the reduction of integrated circuit feature size, increase of signal frequency and density of layout and wiring, problems caused by electrical interconnection, such as limited bandwidth, clock skew, signal distortion and increased interference, have become bottlenecks in the realization of ultra-high speed circuits. Because light travels at the speed of light and is an electromagnetic wave of high frequency, it does not depend on the movement of particles and can travel at very high speeds. It does not depend on the motion of particles, thus avoiding the influence of parasitic parameters. So optical transmission is a good alternative to electrical transmission. Optical interconnection based on optical transmission is composed of light source, interconnection channel and optical receiver by transmitting optical signals. With the rapid development of photoelectric integration, more and more people are devoted to the research of optical waveguide in optical interconnection on chips. Integrated silicon-based optical waveguide is a very important part in silicon-based optical integrated circuit. Because silicon based optical waveguide is an important part of photoelectric integrated circuit, it is necessary to study its material, structure and the way of constructing related components, so as to obtain low-loss optical waveguide components. In this paper, two materials, SOI and SiO2, are selected to analyze the ridge and rectangular waveguides in detail, and the Y-branch power splitter and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1\times 4$</tex> power splitter are designed with them, and the related properties are compared and discussed. The basic characteristics of these waveguides are analyzed theoretically and by simulation. Some instructive results are given for photoelectric integration in optical interconnection on chips.

articleTitle: ResAttUNetPlus: An Attention Network Architecture for Polyp Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Intestinal polyps are a prevalent colorectal condition, and early detection and precise identification of lesion areas are crucial to prevent polyp malignancy and enhance treatment outcomes. Colonoscopy is commonly utilized for examining intestinal polyps. In this research, we combine deep learning frameworks from the field of artificial intelligence, specifically computer vision, to perform image segmentation. To develop a more accurate intestinal polyp segmentation model, we propose ResAttUNetPlus, a deep learning network that builds upon ResUNet++ by incorporating improvements in the attention mechanism. The ResAttUNetPlus model comprises three main components: the Encoding layer, Bridge layer, and Decoding layer. Our findings demonstrate that ResAttUNetPlus exhibits a highly effective segmentation performance. When tested on the publicly available dataset Kvasir-SEG using the same hardware facility, the ResAttUNetPlus model achieves more than a one percent improvement in accuracy and mIoU coefficient compared to the ResUNet++ model. This proposed method provides gastroenterologists and patients with a more accurate and efficient technique for image segmentation of intestinal polyps.

articleTitle: Verilog OJ: Research and Implementation of a Verilog HDL Online Judge System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Although online judge systems are widely used in programming-related courses, hardware-related courses rarely use online judge systems to judge the correctness of the digital circuit design. Instead, they use FPGA hardware to validate the digital circuit design, which requires a huge amount of hardware. We have proposed a new judge system to build an online judge for hardware system where students can submit their code and test the submitted code. It provides a convenient way to check the code and makes it easier to learn digital circuit design.

articleTitle: Research on Urban Photoelectric Sensing Environment Sensor Based on Big Data Technology of Computer Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper designs and implements the perception layer, network layer and application layer in the framework of environmental monitoring system. To minimize the bit error rate of free space optical communication (FSO) system under the limitation of multi-mode Gaussian background optical noise field and the energy efficiency of the received optical signal, an adaptive photoelectric array signal processing algorithm for intensity modulation/direct detection (IM/DD) is proposed. Design and implement sensor data acquisition circuit, main control processor and peripheral circuit, system communication interface circuit in environmental monitoring system hardware. The data storage part mainly realizes the storage and processing of data, which involves cloud platform technology. The server platform realizes the final webpage display and large screen display, and the key technologies are communication technology. The analysis and simulation results show that the system can greatly reduce the computational complexity while the performance loss is almost negligible.

articleTitle: Research on Blockchain-Based Data Sharing and Access Control Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: To address the issues of privacy protection and user access control in electronic health record (EHR) sharing process, this research proposes a blockchain-based secure EHR sharing and access control model to improve the security of EHR and enhance the management of user access rights. This model is built on Hyperledger Fabric (abbreviated as Fabric) to obtain performance optimization and scalable applications. Using edge computing nodes to store large amounts of medical data and several access control policies, the ciphertext policy attribute-based encryption mechanism (CP-ABE) provides flexible and stable encryption protection for the data in the model; the eXtensible access control markup language (XACML) provides fine-grained access control for the model. We also introduce Ether Universe, a hybrid cross-chain technology that combines a sidechain model and a notary mechanism, into the model to facilitate information interaction among independent blockchains. Finally, we show through extensive experimental tests that the model has good operational stability and high data processing performance, and can provide reasonable record and permission control during user access to EHR data.

articleTitle: Research on Structural Optimization Design of Railway Power Supply Transformer Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the increasing standardization of railway power supply transformers, the voltage level has been extended from 110kV to 330kV, and Vv, Vx and other ways are generally used for connection groups. However, the specific parameters of the power supply transformer will change due to different areas of use, different line loads, and different modes and lines of transportation. However, there are still some problems in the power frequency traction transformer in the traditional electric traction system, which restrict the further improvement of railway performance. Therefore, this paper further optimizes and designs the structure of railway power supply transformer based on GA(genetic algorithm), and through simulation experiments, it is proved that the input voltage of resonant voltage-stabilized power transformer is ahead of the output voltage by an angle under rated resistive load, and the amplitude of output voltage at this time is smaller than that under no load. However, the input voltage of the regulated power transformer comes from two power supply arms. Because of the particularity of the traction load, the input voltage itself contains a large number of odd harmonics, which may lead to the increase of odd harmonics content of the output voltage and fail to meet the power supply requirements. Therefore, the optimal filtering measures are adopted by GA, so that the harmonic distortion rate of the final output waveform is within the allowable range.

articleTitle: Research on Modeling and Control Strategy of Plug in HEV Hybrid Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: To solve the problem of batteries not being able to charge or discharge under high current conditions, the advantages of high specific energy of batteries and high specific power of supercapacitors are combined to form a composite power supply that works together to reduce the constraints of a single battery power supply. Analyze the characteristics of batteries, supercapacitors, and DC/DC converters, establish models for each component of the composite power supply, and determine the model of the composite power supply based on component characteristics and vehicle usage characteristics. Aiming at the control objectives and operating modes of plug-in hybrid power, an optimal interval fuzzy control strategy for the engine is developed to leverage the advantages of composite power sources and ensure that the engine operates within an ideal range. The analysis is verified through Matlab/Simulink simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Carbon Emission Calculation Model of Electromagnetic Vibration Noise Reduction Equipment in Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The research area of this article is the magnetic vibration noise reduction of equipment in the power system. By establishing a mathematical model to analyze carbon emissions and calculating the model, the main purpose is to analyze the effectiveness of various primary equipment electromagnetic vibration noise reduction and related technical measures. This article takes the main electromagnetic vibration noise source power transformer in the substation as an example, establishes an active noise reduction hardware system, and then writes a main control algorithm program, Modular implementation of various unit functions. Then the indirect boundary element method is used to calculate the acoustic characteristics of the bus bridge. The comparison between the final calculation results and experimental data indicates the effectiveness of the simulation model and calculation method. Improve the structure based on simulation results. Experimental verification shows that it has good noise reduction effect

articleTitle: Wind Speed Prediction with Deep Learning Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Wind energy has broad application space in daily life, but he wind data in a very short time is random, nonlinear and intermittent. Aiming to settle the existing problems in wind forecasting, this project combines variational mode decomposition (VMD) with Grey Wolf Optimization algorithm(GWO) and bidirectional long-term and short-term memory network (BiLSTM) to build a new model VMD-GWO-BiLSTM. Firstly, using the variational model method, the existing wind data is decomposed into multiple sub-models to reduce the complexity and non-stationary degree. On this basis, the initial learning rate, the number of nodes in the hidden layer and the regularization coefficient of the model were optimized by the generalized weighted least squares method. Then, for each successive segment, the sub-model components of each segment are input into the BiLSTM neural network, and the forecast value of each mode component is accumulated to obtain the final forecast result. Comparing VMD-GWO-BiLSTM with VMD-BiLSTM, GWO-BiLSTM, IPSO-BiLSTM and BiLSTM model, it is found that the prediction effect of VMD-GWO-BiLSTM model is better. The relative root mean square error of the forecast evaluation index is 0.5268, the maximum mean square error is 3.3458%, and the relative unit root area is 0.98719.

Author Keywords: Bi-directional Long Short-Term Memory neural Networks

articleTitle: An Approach Based on Multi-Entropy and Artificial Intelligence for Communication Modulation Signal Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the increasingly complex electromagnetic influence in the modern communication environment and the explosive growth of communication business data, the modulation recognition system needs to constantly learn new modulation categories and signal characteristics in the process of data increment, and gradually acquire stronger modulation recognition capability. This paper proposes a communication modulation signal recognition method based on multi-entropy and artificial intelligence technology. Firstly, the power entropy, singular spectral entropy, sample entropy, fuzzy entropy, and permutation entropy of the signal are calculated, and a composite entropy feature calculation method based on entropy weight method is proposed to further study the feature extraction of the signal. Finally, it is found that when using neural network for learning, without feature extraction, the recognition accuracy rate is only 70.7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, while using the feature extraction method proposed in this paper, the accuracy rate can reach 89.5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, and the recognition speed is significantly improved. In addition, the feature extraction method proposed in this paper can improve all kinds of modulation recognition based on artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: Tongue Features Detection Based on YOLOX and Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Tongue diagnosis is a kind of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) diagnosis, which is one of the key elements of “Inspection Diagnosis of TCM”. According to TCM, the tongue is closely related to the internal organs, and when the body suffers from various diseases, it will affect the endocrine function, blood composition, nerve conduction, and digestive function. Therefore, the tongue diagnosis can effectively identify whether a patient is suffering from a disease or not, and provide a medical basis for TCM diagnosis. In this paper, we propose a fusion model based on the YOLOX model and attention mechanism, which can effectively identify three pathological features of the tongue image of kidney disease: Teeth-printed tongue, Wrinkled tongue, and Greasy-fur tongue. The experimental results showed that the overall recognition of the 3 features by this fusion model was significantly improved. The overall mAP value was 91.95%, including 0.85 for the Teeth-printed tongue, 0.96 for the Wrinkled tongue, and 0.95 for the Greasy-fur tongue. Therefore, the fusion model based on the YOLOX model and attention mechanism proposed in this paper can assist physicians in quickly identifying whether a patient has kidney disease by the three types of kidney disease tongue features, which have a certain significance for the prevention and treatment of kidney disease.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of Magnetic Coupling Mechanism for Electric Vehicles with Enhanced Anti-offset Ability
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In the practical application of EV wireless charging, there is always an objective deviation between the transmitting and receiving coils of the system, and the deviation has randomness and uncertainty. Therefore, when designing the coupling mechanism, it is necessary to consider maintaining a large coupling coefficient even at large offset positions. It is proposed that the transmitter coil adopts the structure of inner and outer coaxial double coils, analyzes the magnetic field distribution and the variation of mutual inductance and coupling coefficient when offset by finite element simulation, and analyzes the influence of multiple parameters on the anti-offset ability by using the Control variates. On this basis, the design and optimization process of the coupling mechanism is proposed.

articleTitle: Application Research of Digital Film Music Post-test System under the Background of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper firstly studies the digital audio technology of film and television and then, according to the functional model of the software design. Each function model in the software is explained in detail. Especially, the difficulty of the key parts of the software is analyzed, and the concrete implementation scheme of the software is given. According to the rules of film music beat perceived by human ears and the observation of time-frequency characteristics of film music signal. A method to determine the lowest sample rate for accurate bpm detection of film music in a certain bpm range is obtained. The theory and algorithm of the beat signal are obtained by analyzing the beat signal. This paper presents an effective method of film beat extraction which is suitable for digital disc player and other devices. Finally, the system is tested and analyzed. This paper verifies the feasibility of the system.

articleTitle: Video Anomaly Detection Based on Spatial Awareness and Attention Fusion Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Anomaly detection in video is one of the challenging problems in the field of computer vision. To address the problem of insufficient prediction capability due to inadequate extraction of spatial features of object appearance in video anomaly detection methods based on predicting future frames, this paper proposes a video anomaly detection method based on spatial perception and attention fusion. The method uses spatially-aware coding network to extract the appearance spatial feature information of objects in video frames, while modeling the global dependencies of deep spatial coding by a non-local module. Then the attention fusion module is used to establish the interaction between the spatial coding and the temporal coding extracted by the traditional coding network to enhance the discriminative representation of the network for video frames. Experimental analysis shows that the method in this paper is able to achieve 84.2% and 95.7% of frame-level AUC in the public benchmark datasets UCSD Ped1 and Ped2, respectively, with good detection performance for video anomalous behavior.

articleTitle: Prediction of Scrabble Game Results Based on Gradient Boosting Decision Tree and time Series Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: An exciting puzzle game, wordle, is offered in the New York Times, in which players need to guess a five-letter word in no more than. To explain the daily number of reported result, this article established ARIMA time series model and obtained the smoothness test, model determination and fixed-order correlation data. After that, this article predicted the number of reported results on March 1, 2023, with the prediction interval [10268.457, 10644.897]. Meanwhile, this article selected four-word attributes and judged their relationship and the difficulty mode score by the Pearson correlation. Finally, this article built a GBDT model based on four-word attributes to predict the distribution of the reported results.

articleTitle: Comparison Among Double-Stream CNN and Local Feature Fusion of CNN in the Facial Expression Recognition Field
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In recent years, with the development of deep learning, facial expression recognition has become a hot research direction. In order to improve the accuracy of facial expression recognition, this paper focuses on comparing two improved algorithms based on convolution neural network (CNN), namely, double-stream CNN and CNN local fusion feature facial expression recognition. The dual-stream CNN algorithm uses a variety of advanced technologies for preprocessing and feature extraction; Local feature fusion of CNN is to perform complex processing on local features and finally optimize feature fusion weights. In this paper, the accuracy of face recognition of the two algorithms on CK+ and JAFFE data sets is 98.81% and 96.05%; 94.56%, and 97.08%, respectively. The recognition rate of these two algorithms shows that the optimization effect is very good. By comparing the similarities and differences of the two algorithms, it provides ideas and directions for further improving the accuracy and algorithm.

articleTitle: A Case of Computer Image Processing Depth Learning Algorithm Based on YOLOv4 Improved Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Computer image recognition algorithm is the key to unsafe behavior recognition, and it is also the content that must be mastered to learn computer image processing. In order to solve the problem of detecting unsafe behaviors in high voltage areas and intrusion of people in hazardous areas, a detection method of unsafe behaviors in high voltage areas based on the double-layer YOLOv4 algorithm is proposed. The results demonstrate that the average accuracy (mAP) of this model can reach 85.73% in the task of unsafe behavior detection in high-voltage area, and the speed can reach 94ms/piece. It can be seen that this method can accurately detect intrusion into dangerous areas and unsafe behaviors of operators in real time, and can guarantee the safety of power grids and personnel.

articleTitle: Telemetry Data Compression Algorithm Based on Balanced Cyclic Neural Network and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of telemetry and telecontrol technology, the amount of information for acquiring telemetry data is increasing, which requires a large amount of storage space when storing, a large bandwidth when transmitting, and data processing as fast as possible. Therefore, data compression technology is needed to solve this problem. The redundancy of telemetry data is also very large. Statistics show that the redundancy of data transmitted in the standard telemetry system reaches more than 90%. In order to reduce the signal space and relieve the pressure of data processing, it is necessary and important to use data compression technology in telemetry system. Considering the space performance and time performance of the lossless compression algorithm, several commonly used lossless compression algorithms are compared for telemetry noise data. The compression space performance of each algorithm still needs to be improved. Considering that the measured engineering data is distributed in a typical balanced way, we studied the anomaly detection problem of time series data with inter class balance, and proposed an anomaly detection problem based on recurrent neural network (RNN). Finally, the overall test of the developed data acquisition and compression system is carried out. The test results show that the system has completed the real-time acquisition and compression of six channels of rapidly varying parameters, and the compression ratio is more than 1.8:1. All indicators meet the design requirements.

articleTitle: A Gradient Boosting Based Classification Technique for Assisted Prediction Algorithm Research
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Classification is a significant data mining technique which offers a wide range of applications to classify the manifold types of data existing in almost every industry of our lives such as predictors, the system of weather forecasting, and business intelligence etc. Both supervised learning and unsupervised learning can be used in this technology, and supervised data mining technology has higher accuracy and performance. As a result, in sensitive applications, monitored data extraction technology is used for forecasting and classification.This paper proposes an auxiliary prediction model based on machine learning through a series of sample feature data. The auxiliary prediction approach makes use of more detailed data, which both increases the accuracy of automatic diagnosis and lowers diagnosis error. The suggested auxiliary diagnosis prediction model will also assist in handling various types of data, which can enhance efficiency and save some time to some level. This study used 918 pieces of relevant data from the UCI machine learning knowledge base. This paper used Decision Tree, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting and Artificial Neural Network algorithm for data sets that were analyzed, and found Gradient Boosting in the data set has better performance, whose accuracy rate has reached 86.67%. The results show that Gradient-boosting-based classification technique can be effectively applied in assisting prediction research.

articleTitle: Research on Cloud Data Storage Security Privacy Protection System under Digital Campus
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper proposes a digital campus cloud data storage security and privacy protection strategy under the Internet of Things environment. Campus users first apply for the attribute key from the trust center and then outsource the encrypted private data to the cloud server. The authorized user generates keyword traps through attribute keys. Only when the attributes of the authorized user meet the specified access control tree, the authorized user is allowed to search the cloud encrypted data through this trap door. A homomorphic encryption algorithm based on ECC is proposed based on the advantages of high security performance and low computational complexity. The algorithm is applied to cloud storage ciphertext processing and cloud computing data aggregation privacy protection. The results show that the scheme cannot only ensure the security of data storage but also protect the identity privacy of campus users.

articleTitle: Research on Trajectory Optimization System of Thrust Orbit Transfer Based on Computer Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: A Gaussian pseudo-spectral method is used to solve an optimal orbital transition problem with a certain force. Firstly, based on the banal perturbation model of the quasi-equinox trajectory element, the objective is to minimize the energy, take the acceleration of a three-part finite thrust engine as the target, and take the acceleration of a three-part finite thrust engine as the target. The multiphase optimization problem is studied by Gaussian pseudospectra method. A new multi-NLP problem based on Gaussian pseudo-spectrum method is proposed and converted into a continuous NLP problem. By comparing with classical homotropy method, the efficiency of the proposed algorithm is proved.

articleTitle: An ELM Evaluation Model for Fighter Air Combat Effectiveness Against Gross Errors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: A new air combat effectiveness evaluation model based on improved Extreme Learning Machine (ELM) is proposed to address the characteristics of two modern air combat modes: beyond visual range and close range. Firstly, an ELM based on M-estimation is introduced to resist the interference of gross errors in the sample data on ELM. Then, evaluate the combat effectiveness of fighter jets through the established model. Simulation shows that compared to ELM, the ELM method based on M estimation can achieve good accuracy after only 20 iterations and has strong resistance to gross errors, thus verifying its feasibility and effectiveness.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Evaluation and Early Warning Method of Market Status Based on Metabolic Grey Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Due to the rapid change of the external environment, the market status of the product exhibits high uncertainty, which brings difficulties to the operation decision of enterprises. In order to understand accurately the changing trend of product market status, and considering that the closest time series is more influential in predicting the future, we propose an early warning model of market status based on the metabolic gray prediction algorithm. In view of the factors affecting the market status of different products, in order to effectively eliminate the interference of non-objective factors, the corresponding indicators' weights are calculated by an entropy method. By predicting, calculating and standardized processing of the indicator data collected in real time, the prediction and early warning of the product market status is then realized, and the marketing strategy can be implemented accurately and effectively. The practical application results show that the proposed intelligent evaluation and early warning model is effective and reliable. The method proposed in this research can provide a valuable reference for real-time monitoring of the market status of general consumer goods.

articleTitle: CT Image Recognition of COVID-19 Based on Improved Resnet Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In order to detect COVID-19 positive cases more quickly, in this paper, a deep learning model is used and a CNN network is designed for model training. In addition, some classical networks such as Resnet, VGG and some lightweight networks are tried to train the model and analyze their advantages and disadvantages. Finally, a Resnet network is designed. The Fire module is introduced to reduce the network depth and parameter quantity and make the network pay attention to the global information. The performance of the model on the three loss functions of CrossEntropyLoss, FocalLoss and Poly1FocalLoss is compared, and the optimal loss function is CrossEntropyLoss. The network model has achieved good results in both the training set and the verification set. The accuracy in the training set is 95%, the average accuracy in the verification set is about 80%, and the accuracy in the test set is nearly 75%. Because the model can be trained under the CPU, compared with the 84% accuracy of the original author's DenseNet test set, the precision has slightly decreased, and the recall rate has increased by 4 percentage points. However, in comparison, the speed and accuracy of the improved model have been improved under the Resnet 34 model.

articleTitle: Research on Earthquake Early Warning System Based on Seismic Wave Depth Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Earthquakes have a very devastating impact on human life, and scholars have been working to discover methods and equipment that can provide early warning of earthquakes. This study found that by converting the data recorded by seismometers into corresponding audio signals to detect earthquakes, better perception can be obtained, and speech recognition techniques such as MEL frequency cepstrum coefficients (MFCC) can be used to extract features from audio signals. The collected data features will be used for offline training by the established Convolutional neural network (CNN) and Short-term memory (LSTM) networks. Using this modeling method, the waveform can be directly used as input data, and the occurrence and level of earthquakes can be used as output. It is a very suitable real-time earthquake monitoring model. Therefore, it can be well used as an earthquake early warning system. Our research results prove that temporal networks have the best generalization ability. Our models also shows that when the p-wave reaches two seconds, the Earthquake warning system will sound a warning.

articleTitle: Design of College English Modular Teaching Management System Based on .NET Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In recent years, with the further deepening of the reform of English education in universities, “student-centeredness” has become the main form advocated by major institutions. The modular education management approach of English language focuses on examining students' daily performance, emphasizing the cultivation of their application ability, thereby improving their learning efficiency and quality. This article provides a detailed introduction to the .NET framework and analyzes the development requirements of the English process-oriented teaching management system. It proposes the main functions and database design of the modular teaching management system based on .NET technology, and explains the implementation effects of some modules. The aim is to provide important references and guidance for the development of similar management systems.

Author Keywords: The English process-oriented teaching management system

articleTitle: Simulation System of College Physical Education Based on Support Vector Machine Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Teaching simulation system can not only assist traditional teaching and training methods, but also stimulate athletes' interest in learning and training, and improve their ability to recognize the main role. Therefore, physical education needs the help of high technology to meet its own needs. Based on this, it is an urgent and necessary work to build a physical education simulation system. In this paper, a simulation system of college physical education based on SVM(support vector machine) algorithm is designed. This physical education simulation system can finally realize the effects of real-time control, all-angle switching and multi-angle display of teaching contents in physical education through kinect equipment. And it can be displayed from all directions and angles according to the three-dimensional model. In this paper, a new idea based on hierarchical classification is used. According to the motion description, the motion is separated in advance, and then the SVM-based method is used for training. It is transmitted frame by frame in the way of retraining, which provides more and more complete historical information for reference for moving target tracking. The experimental results show that the algorithm has strong robustness in some video image sequences with drastic target changes. The recognition rate of human body movements in sitting position is higher, and the physical education simulation system designed in this paper can improve the quality of physical education.

articleTitle: Railway Project Application of a Time Series Data Analysis and Prediction Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of the Internet of Things, monitoring devices have been increasingly used in the railway construction process. In order to ensure construction safety, real-time data monitoring, anomaly detection, and trend prediction are required during project implementation. Therefore, it is very important for analyzing and predicting the time series data generated by various sensors. This paper uses a combined autoregressive moving average (ARIMA) and long short-term memory (LSTM) model to analyze and predict monitoring data with linear and non-linear components during the railway construction process. Finally, it can predict the data trend and possible abnormalities in the next period of time and provide some reference for the project work.

articleTitle: Generating Imperceptible Adversarial Patch Based on Vulnerable Targeted Attack
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The vulnerability and sensitivity of deep neural networks to adversarial examples have attracted researchers' attention towards the security application of deep model. Current methods mainly focus on the aggressiveness and size of the patches, while ignoring the imperceptibility and concealment of the patches. In this paper, we propose a two-step attack algorithm to generate imperceptible adversarial patches. Specifically, the first step of our algorithm is to obtain the vulnerable target category that is most likely to be misclassified; and the second step is to perform targeted attack using the vulnerable target coming from the first step. The proposed algorithm is very robust and can be generalized to other untarget attack approaches, such as Shadow attack and IFGSM. Extensive experiments on widely used classifiers demonstrate the availability and efficiency of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Base Station Siting Based on K-Means Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the rapid development and popularity of 5G in recent years, securing its transmission efficiency and speed is of great importance to the development of various industries and people's daily life. Under the condition of circular coverage, the station sites are planned and the distance constraint is satisfied. Under the condition of cost control, we find the optimal solution with service volume greater than 90%. First, we screen out a portion of data under the constraint that the distance between new base stations and existing base stations is greater than 10. We consider the dynamic planning method for optimizing the decision result. Then the model is constructed as a 0–1 planning problem according to the two cases of selection and non-selection, with selection as 1 and non-selection as 0. Then the simulated annealing algorithm is used to take into account the global situation and run with high efficiency. The final optimal result of the model is 91.09% of the coverage service volume. In order to better solve the problem of weak coverage, we try to adopt the system of regionalization management, based on the principle of clustering any two weak coverage points with Euclidean distance not more than 20 are considered as one class using suitable clusters to form a weak coverage area. So that the total time complexity is as low as possible. We used the K-means method and used the Gap function to get the most suitable k value, and finally we chose to divide it into 18 clusters. Then the DBI index is used as an index to evaluate the merit of the clustering algorithm, and then the time complexity is obtained by the related algorithm, which is graded to obtain different levels of complexity.

articleTitle: Research on Power Image Enhancement Algorithm Based on Image Recognition Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: UAV line inspection greatly improves the efficiency of transmission line inspection. If the digital image collected by computer is processed, the efficiency can be further improved, and image enhancement processing is an important process of computer image processing Combined with the characteristics of power line digital gray image, two different gray image enhancement algorithms using random mathematical model and fuzzy mathematical model are discussed, and the application effects of these algorithms are compared This paper analyzes the shortcomings of the existing image enhancement algorithms in the application of power line gray image, presents an improved image enhancement algorithm based on fuzzy mathematical model, and uses an example to verify its better applicability.

articleTitle: Construction of Electrical Automation Control System for Mechanical and Electrical Equipment Based on AI Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the continuous innovation and development of artificial intelligence(AI) technology, it is widely used in electrical automation engineering, and the construction of electrical automation control system has become very important. As we all know, large and heavy mechanical and electrical equipment has the disadvantages of huge volume, expensive price, complicated design and operation, and harsh production environment. It is very difficult to carry such equipment at will, and it is not allowed to run and operate these equipment at will, which also requires high professional quality of designers. With the help of the highly interactive and realistic three-dimensional virtual space environment provided by this system, the seamless link between classroom theoretical study and factory field practice can be realized. Using this system, we have successfully developed the simulation training system of automobile driving, the simulation simulation of spring sorter, the simulation training system of laparoscopic surgery, the simulation program of vise clamp and rolling clamp. Therefore, it is necessary to combine AI technology to realize the reasonable construction of the system. This paper studies the development of computer and AI technology, and puts forward the application of AI technology in the field of mine electrical automation control, expounds the design idea of the system, and provides reference for research and practice.

articleTitle: A Study on the Prediction of the Number of Correct Word Guesses by Optimized LSTM Based on Whale Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Wordle is currently a daily puzzle offered by the New York Times and is becoming increasingly popular. In this paper, we use machine learning algorithms to first classify word difficulty in Wordle into regular and difficult modes by clustering models. Then the percentage of the number of times a player guesses a word in Wordle is predicted by building a Whale Optimization Algorithm (WOA) to improve the Long Short Term Memory Neural Network (LSTM) model. Firstly, word attributes and user features are extracted and feature difference value weighting function is constructed; then, using word attributes-user features as input, LSTM model is established to forget and filter data through input gates, forgetting gates, output gates and memory nodes; by introducing WOA for parameter intelligent optimization solution, the accuracy and efficiency of LSTM model are improved. Seven WOA-LSTM neural network models were established to predict the percentage of the number of times a player guessed the right word for each future date, and the prediction model was determined to have high confidence through the range of various types of errors in the training set and test set. Finally, the uncertainty of the LSTM neural network model was illustrated through the data itself, the model, and the prediction.

articleTitle: Voltage Stabilization Control Method of Variable Speed Onboard Power Supply Based on Dual Outer Loop Control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: To solve the problem of high dynamic fluctuation and low efficiency of the output voltage of the variable speed onboard torque extraction power supply, this paper proposes a voltage regulator control method based on load variation with dual outer loop adaptive switching. Under variable rotational speed conditions, the system stabilizes the terminal voltage by controlling the excitation current of the generator and then uses a rectifier-inverter to achieve frequency and voltage-stabilized AC power. The system uses a dual closed-loop control method consisting of an excitation current inner loop and a voltage outer loop. This paper uses the AC voltage and DC voltage outer loop switching control strategy when the load changes. With load detection and dimension swapping as the switching rule, this paper constructs a model and calculates the onboard power supply, and sets PI parameters to achieve smooth voltage control. The feasibility of the control method has been verified through full-load switching and variable speed experiments. This control method can stabilize the voltage transient fluctuation within 10% at full load switching.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Network Security in Cloud Computer Intelligent System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper proposes a new firewall model to solve the problem of computer network security threats. Firstly, this paper gives the division of function modules and the working algorithm of firewall model system. Then the design and implementation of command dynamic configuration tree are introduced in detail. Finally, the performance of the algorithm used in the system is analyzed. Experimental study shows that this method is cost-effective. It's easy to implement. The system has the advantages of robustness, security and manageability.

articleTitle: Research on Hexagonal Network Characteristics Based on Complex Network Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Based on complex network theory, this paper constructs the topology diagram of hexagonal transit track network with 294 nodes. The adjacency matrix was drawn according to the topology structure diagram. The static robustness index of the network was obtained by using MATLAB. And the changes of the dynamic robustness index of the network were collected by using MATLAB to simulate random attacks. When 30% to 40% percent of the nodes are attacked, the network is almost completely paralyzed.

articleTitle: Research on Percentage Prediction of Wordle Results Based on Weighted CLR-XGBoost
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: For the guessing game with word text as the object, the contestants limit the percentage of the number of attempts in the process of solving the problem, and some decision-making suggestions can be fed back to the game developer. This paper proposes a wordle result percentage prediction and evaluation model based on weighted CLR-XGBoost.firstly, weighted CLR was used to transform the component data to eliminate the effect of multicollinearity in the percentage of trials. Then, based on the weighted CLR transformation data, the XGBoost report result prediction distribution model is established to determine the relevant percentage distribution on March 1, 2023. Next, based on the feature extraction of the uncertainty factors of the model based on EERIE words, it can be considered that Linsear Write Formula and Flesch Reading Ease formula have an impact on the model. Finally, the paper explored the credibility of the model and found that the R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> of the training set and the test set exceeded 0.97, and the fitting effect of the model was significant.

articleTitle: A Fusion Framework for Student Performance Prediction Using Deep Learning and Blockchain Technologies
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper presents an innovative fusion framework that integrates deep learning and blockchain technologies for student performance prediction. To validate the effectiveness of this framework, we designed and conducted a series of experiments. The results show that our fusion framework significantly outperforms the methods using deep learning or blockchain alone in terms of prediction performance. Specifically, our method achieved the best results in four evaluation metrics: Mean Squared Error (MSE), Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE), Mean Absolute Error (MAE), and R-Squared. These results confirm the effectiveness of deep learning in extracting useful features from learning records. Meanwhile, the use of blockchain ensures the security and integrity of data, further enhancing the accuracy of prediction. This study provides a new perspective on student performance prediction using deep learning and blockchain, demonstrating the potential of deep learning and blockchain in the field of educational technology.

articleTitle: Design of Shrub Willow Grid Sand Barrier Inserting Device Based on Fischertechnik
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Shrub willow grid sand barrier can effectively prevent wind and fix sand. At present, the plant of shrub willow grid sand barrier is mainly completed by manual, which has the shortage of high labor intensity, high labor cost and low efficiency. In this paper, an automatic inserting device for shrub willow grid sand barrier is designed, which consists of shrub willow storage and feeding module, longitudinal sand barrier inserting module, horizontal sand barrier inserting module and motion control module. A four-bar linkage is innovatively designed to realize the automatic transmission of shrub willow rods one by one. Longitudinal row inserting module and horizontal row inserting module cleverly utilize and assemble the mechanical components such as pinion and rack, feed screw nut and air pump cylinder, achieving the inverted- T inserting mode with longitudinal row inserting first and horizontal row inserting next. The motion control module accurately controls the running speed and sequence of each mechanism, realizing the automation of the whole process of sand barrier planting from material storage and feeding, preparation to insertion. The device has wide application perspective in the field of wind prevention and sand control.

articleTitle: Genetic Algorithm Based Emergency Material Delivery Path Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The delivery mode of “delivery vehicle + UAV” is becoming more and more popular in the rescue and relief of major emergencies, optimising the delivery path and shortening the delivery time, which is an important guarantee for people's lives and property. This paper uses the K-means clustering algorithm to analyse the distribution locations and uses the central point of each class as the best location for the material distribution centre, finally finding location 9 and location 15 as the best distribution centre. Then, using genetic algorithm to optimise the distribution path of “delivery vehicle + UAV” for each material delivery centre, using UAV off-site take-off and landing mode, the delivery time of 30 affected locations was shortened to 10.33 hours, which greatly improved the delivery time.

articleTitle: Power System Short-Term Load Forecasting Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: by preprocessing the original load data series, the processing ability of gray prediction to the fluctuating load data series is enhanced, and the selection of the initial conditions, it can make the fitting curve more accord with the law of things developing in the future, and it can improve the precision of the model and meet the demand of short-term load forecasting. The improved model is compared with the general GM (L,1) model by case analysis.

articleTitle: The Design of a Domestically Produced Core Board Towards the Application of Service-Oriented Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of science and technology, and with the help of the development of science and technology, various tools to improve the quality of human life are also rapidly updated. Intelligent robot products are a kind of complex hardware system based on the integration of environmental awareness, motion control, voice interaction, machine vision, the Internet of Things and other technologies. Now products has entered many fields of human life and production, providing many intelligent services based on scientific and technological development for people to a certain extent. This paper develops the core board of service robot based on domestic independent chips, which can provide an overall solution based on the core board for service robot research and development manufacturers. The core board for service robot applications is applicable to service robots, interactive advertising machines, interactive digital signage, intelligent self-service terminals, intelligent retail terminals, industrial control hosts and many other application fields.

articleTitle: Visualization Analysis and XGBoost-Based Prediction of COVID-19 Mortality
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: For the best predictive results of novel coronavirus infection and COVID-19 mortality, this research bases on the XGBoost machine learning algorithm. Through the research of data on related diseases, it not only helps to prevent the infection of COVID-19 effectively, but also gives advice to specific patients who need treatment without delay. The existing machine learning model uses the logistic regression algorithm to train the uneven data but gets an unsatisfying precision. This research improves the result by combining undersampling with XGBoost, with random forest, logistic regression, decision tree, and other models as comparisons. The prediction of COVID-19 mortality has the same accuracy of 91% before and after using the undersampling method, however, the AUC rises about 13% and finally reaches 92%• This research is available for the prediction of prevalence rate and death rate of COVID-19 in people who have basic diseases.

articleTitle: Dynamic Object Detection and Segmentation Based on Mask R-CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In real situations, problems such as false detection or omission can occur in dynamic scene object detection, so this document aims to solve this problem. This paper proposes a new dynamic object detection and segmentation method based on improvements to the Mask R-CNN algorithm. First, the Mask-R-CNN algorithm is improved to introduce temporal information to improve model robustness through temporal context fusion. The network structure is then optimized, and multi-layered pyramid feature fusion and hierarchical prediction mechanisms are used to improve model accuracy and speed. Experimental results show that the proposed method performs better in dynamic object detection and segmentation tasks.

articleTitle: Research on Cloud Edge Collaborative Application Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Cloud edge collaboration refers to the complementary collaboration between cloud computing and edge computing. The proposed edge computing model provides a new solution to the shortcomings of the centralized model of cloud computing, and is the product of adapting to the needs of technological development. With the rapid development of edge computing, cloud edge collaboration technology is also widely used in various industries. This article mainly analyzes the application scenarios of cloud edge collaboration in the field of energy big data.

articleTitle: Construction of Image Processing Model Based on Computer Vision Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: As an important part of the mobile robot platform to perceive the external environment, the computer transmits the collected real-time images to the processing unit. After the image information is analyzed and processed, different functions are realized according to the actual needs. Image processing technology is a widely used technology type derived from the continuous development of computer technology. Using it in fruit detection and grading can improve the efficiency of fruit detection and grading, optimize the standard of fruit detection and grading, achieve the purpose of controlling the cost of manual detection and grading, and ensure the profit of fruit industry. We know that the human brain is the most effective biological intelligence system known, and the ability of human visual system to recognize, process and process images far exceeds any existing computer and information processing system. This paper implements image processing technology based on computer vision algorithm, so as to express the actual coordinates of objects in 3D space through 3D voxels, and can also correct the distorted images caused by projection. Compared with traditional BP neural network, image processing technology based on computer vision algorithm has more advantages and higher accuracy.

articleTitle: Generative Adversarial Network and Score-Based Generative Model Comparison
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Generative models are a category of machine learning models that can generate new data by studying the underlying distribution of an existing dataset. Deep generative models are a specific type of generative model that use deep neural networks to capture intricate patterns in the probability distribution of the dataset. These models have the potential to generate highly realistic and diverse data. However, when the quantity of available data is limited, as is frequently the case in real-world applications, generating new data with deep generative models can be a challenging task. To address this issue, various techniques have been suggested to train deep generative models, such as using Variational Autoencoder (VAE) and Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs). While these techniques have shown potential in improving deep generative models' performance, their effectiveness varies depending on various factors, including the size and nature of the dataset. Therefore, further research is necessary to develop more effective and reliable techniques to train deep generative models for various practical applications. Score-based generative models are a class of generative models that estimate the score function and use it to generate samples through the Langevin dynamics algorithm. This article focuses on comparing GANs and score-based generative models based on the CIFAR-10 dataset. The article discovered the complementary aspect of GANs and Score-Based Generative Models and suggested improvements in training both models. The results allows for a more stable and more flexible training process, the combination training has shown promising results in generating high-quality and diverse samples in various applications.

articleTitle: Design of Automatic Monitoring System for Subway Tunnel Based on Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The stability of the subway structure plays an important role in ensuring the safe passage of the subway, and it is difficult in both the construction process and the subsequent operation stage of the subway tunnel. In order to ensure the safety and durability of subway engineering structures in long-term service, it is necessary to research, develop and apply the structural intelligent health monitoring system, and monitor the safety status during its service in real time in order to avoid major accidents. Taking the automatic monitoring and deformation prediction of tunnel engineering as the research object, this paper puts forward an automatic monitoring algorithm of subway tunnel based on deep convolution neural network (CNN), which preprocesses the automatic monitoring data and analyzes the deformation prediction in the process of crossing the tunnel. The results show that this algorithm is more accurate for the feature recognition of subway tunnel monitoring information, which is 25.88% higher than the traditional algorithm. Constructors can use this model to guide the design and construction of underpass process, which provides guarantee for the smooth construction of subway and the safe operation of high-speed rail, and also provides reference for the optimization of similar projects in the design stage, refined construction management in the construction stage and safety guarantee in the operation stage in the future.

articleTitle: 5G Base Station Deployment Based on Improved Hierarchical Co-Evolutionary Immunization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the development of mobile communication technology and the complexity of communication networks, the coverage area of base stations decreases and the demand becomes larger. In this paper, a corresponding planning model is established and an intelligent optimization algorithm is used to solve the problem. Firstly, the data are cleaned and denoised, and the data that do not meet the requirements are eliminated by calculating the Euclidean distance between the existing network base stations and the weak coverage points. Then the K-means algorithm is used to cluster the samples according to the coverage of the base stations. Then a planning model is established and solved using a hierarchical coevolutionary immune algorithm to finally calculate the number of base stations that need to be built. When the coverage of the base station changes from the center of a circle to an angle-limited sector. A functional analysis is performed for the coverage of the base stations.
