Using linear interpolation, the relationship between the coverage radius and the angle of the base station direction is obtained. The planning model is established by taking the sector coverage angle in the main direction as a constraint. The maximum coverage of a single base station that can be obtained at an angle of 120° is obtained, and it is found that the coverage decreases under the actual condition compared with the previous one.

articleTitle: An Improved A* Algorithm for AGV Path Planning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: AGV (Automated Guided Vehicle) has been widely used in various industries due to its flexibility and convenience. However, the path planning problem for AGVs has been a hot research topic, as it presents many challenges and opportunities for improvement. This paper proposes modifications to the traditional <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{A}^{*}$</tex> algorithm used in AGV path planning, which is known to have issues such as path roughness and slow planning speed. The proposed solution uses a dynamic weighting factor to adjust the evaluation function for path optimization and an 8-neighborhood search strategy to increase search speed. Experimental results confirm the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm, which demonstrates significant advantages in terms of path planning speed and smoothness.

articleTitle: Simple Siamese Transformer Hawkes Process
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Hawkes process based on the transformer can effectively learn the self/mutual excitation relationship of different events in the asynchronous event sequence. Due to its unique self-attention mechanism, it can learn arbitrary distance dependencies in a data series. However, the transformer pays few attention about structural bias to the event sequence, so the hidden representation may not be as accurate when training some data sets. We propose a Simple Siamese Transformer Hawkes Process (SSTHP) model. We copy the traditional network structure, where the two networks share parameters, then use a negative cosine similarity function to minimize the output loss of the two networks to optimize the hidden representation. This structure can naturally introduce inductive bias. Compared with other neural network point process models, the SSTHP model performs better on several datasets. Our results comprehensively demonstrate that introducing the idea of contrast learning into Hawkes point process learning can improve the model's ability to fit the dataset, so as to improve the prediction effect of the model.

articleTitle: Research on Human-Computer Interaction System of Intelligent Connected Vehicle Based on Computer AI Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper proposes a real-time publishing system of vehicle-mounted human-computer interaction information data based on AI driving behavior recognition. Firstly, the network topology structure of the system is analyzed and designed. The V2X terminal, human-computer interaction terminal and information service platform are then constructed through WIFI network and mobile cellular network. Then the functional code and business display interface time-sharing processing, improve the reuse and maintainability of the program. The system realizes the vehicle position display, collision warning, fatigue detection, traffic light display, intervehicle short message, emergency message and other application functions. The experimental results show that the system is easy to operate and has good human-computer interaction experience. The system can reduce the psychological burden of drivers, improve driving safety and low response delay.

articleTitle: A Time Series Regression Model Based on Distance Covariance Weighted Bagging Framework and Functional Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: For the regression prediction problem of time series data, we propose a method based on functional principal component analysis and distance covariance weighted Bagging framework. The proposed method overcomes the problems of high dimension and noise of time series data, and preserves the function characteristics of time series. Since the underlying model structure between the principal component basis coefficient variable and the response variable is unknown, we use the Bagging framework, which is with the model-free basis model, to capture the potential model, considering that the importance of each basis model is unknown, we propose a method based on distance covariance weighting to correct the Bagging framework to improve the prediction accuracy.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Automatic Parking System Performance Testing Based on Indoor Positioning System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The automatic parking system can help the driver to better perform the parking operation and reduce the psychological pressure when parking. To improve the accuracy of the automatic parking system, improve the success rate of the automatic parking system in different parking space typ technology, aes, and evaluate and analyze the performance of the automatic parking system, this paper proposes a performance testing method based on the indoor positioning system, to complete the automation test of various evaluation indicators of automatic parking performance. And based on the proposed test method, a vehicle equipped with an automatic parking system was selected to conduct a real vehicle test in a typical parking space scenario, which verifies the accuracy, efficiency, and convenience of the test method, and provides the development and verification of the automatic parking system technical support.

articleTitle: Experimental Course Management System Based on Web
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This article introduces an experimental timetable filling and management system developed for experimental teaching, including the main functions and filling content. It uses user-defined Java class objects to complete operations such as querying, adding, deleting, modifying, and closing the background database of the system. Administrator users can add, modify, delete, and download experimental courses on the management page by calling background applications. When creating or modifying an experimental curriculum, the database has the function of checking input information and judging conflicts, preventing conflicting course items from being entered. Obtain statistical information of experimental courses through the sum function and group by clause in database queries.

articleTitle: Performance Study of Large-Scale GPS Trajectory Query Method and Compression Method Based on Spark Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Buses and taxis in cities generate a large amount of GPS trajectory data every day. How to query and manage these large-scale trajectory data is a challenging problem. Based on the RDD component of Spark, a big data computing engine, we design and implement a distributed 3D R-Tree to accelerate trajectory query through global index and local index. The experimental results show that the three queries have the shortest latency under the condition of spatial-temporal grid partition, and the latency of trajectory point query, substring query and region query are 2.33s, 3.33s and 6.88s, respectively. In addition, the massive GPS trajectory data generated by these vehicles bring heavy storage cost pressure to the transportation big data platform. The compression processing of GPS trajectory data is imminent. In this paper, the big data computing engine Spark was used. A set of classical trajectory compression algorithms are implemented in parallel. Finally, the method is verified on a very large-scale real data set. Experimental results on compressed datasets show that the proposed method performs well. It only takes 438 seconds to compress 117.5GB GPS trajectory data of 31000 vehicles for one month on a 14-node Spark cluster.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Airborne Embedded Training System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper focuses on the principle and structure of embedded training system. The system is composed of embedded simulation system and wireless data transmission, which can provide appropriate threat scenarios or provide relevant information generated before (during) combat. The simulation information of sensors, weapons and electronic countermeasures generated in the embedded simulation system is used to replace the real information, which is crosslinked with the avionics system to realize the pilots' tactical training and countermeasures under virtual conditions. The system introduces the function and hardware composition of the embedded simulation system, the main function and working mode of the wireless data transmission link, and the function and composition of the ground mission support system. The system can support basic test flight measurement and control data exchange, flight safety and training data exchange, and provide support for the platform to carry out basic flight training verification, joint embedded training and simulation training application.

articleTitle: ML-DPR: A Meta-Learning-Based Model for Domain-Adaptive Dense Passage Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Dense Passage Retrieval (DPR) models have demonstrated substantial advances in retrieving relevant passages from large document collections. These models employ encoders to generate vector representations of documents and queries. However, DPR models tend to produce low-quality sentence representations when applied across domains. Collecting domain-specific data and training specialized models for each domain is expensive and time-consuming. In this paper, we propose a meta-learning model which acquires knowledge from each domain-specific dataset (meta-task) and can generalize across domains, including finance, education, and others. We further apply knowledge distillation to transfer the knowledge from an interaction-based BERT model to a representation-based BERT model, improving performance. Experiments on five domains from the DPR dataset demonstrate that our method achieves the state-of-the-art performance.

articleTitle: Parameter Identification of Resonant System Based on Step Response Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: A lot of 3practical systems, such as mechanical system, vehicle shockproof system, the seismic system of the building etc, can be simplized as a resonance system, which usually involves multiple components. There are still some unknown parameters in the practical application of the resonance system, and there are also some external disturbances. The coordination between each component cannot be completely idealized. Hence, in this paper, an experimental platform of resonant system was designed and bulit, and the system identification method based on the step response method is presented for the system. By analyzing the mechanical mechanism of the resonance system, the mechanism model of the system is built using the Lagrange method. Then the step input signal suitable for the resonance system test is designed, the corresponding experimental data is collected, and the model parameters are identified by the step response nonlinear fitting method. Finally, the step response based on the identified transfer function was compared with the actual experimental data, and the validity of the identification was verified. The results shows that the step response method has a better identification fitting degree than the transfer function method, and the model has a higher identification accuracy. The presented identification method in this paper provides a theoretical basis for improving the performance and design efficiency of the controller.

articleTitle: Research on Collision Compatibility of Vehicle Frontend Structures
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In order to evaluate the vehicle's attack performance, an evaluation method based on FWRB test is proposed. The load of vehicle front end collision is collected through load cell wall. The vehicle load is decomposed into four intervals in the vertical and horizontal directions. Weighted normalization is carried out according to the standard and negative deviations of the load. The repeatability of the evaluation method is verified. Based on the FWRB crash tests of twenty vehicles, the test results show that: 80% of the frontend structure of the vehicle meets the requirements of collision load. However, in the horizontal direction, the function of lateral transmission of energy needs to be strengthened.

articleTitle: Research on Remote Farm Management System Based on Computer Internet of Things Data Set Information Photoelectric Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Firstly, the interference characteristics of photodetector for optical communication are analyzed. The interference characteristics of photodetector are analyzed and simulated by means of bit interference and clock extraction interference. According to the design index of the Angle measuring system required by the satellite-borne laser communication terminal, the code disk, the indicator grating and the extraction method of photoelectric signal of the photoelectric Angle encoder are designed and selected respectively. An experimental system is set up in the laboratory and the photoelectric detector interference is tested experimentally. The results show that the effect of jamming the photodetector is related to the frequency and power of the interference source.

articleTitle: Wordle Result Prediction Based on XGBoost
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In the wordle text guessing game, in view of the fact that it becomes more difficult for players to use the “difficult mode” to find suitable results in a limited trial process, this paper proposes a prediction model for the number of Wordle results based on XGBoost. Firstly, the paper uses the Bootstrap method to extract the sample data 1000 times after, based on the 7 sets of word attributes quantified by the traditional formula, and builds the XGBoost regression learning model to predict the number of reported outcomes. According to the prediction interval with a significance level of 95% as the boundary of the predicted value, the paper concludes that the range of the number of results reported on March 1, 2023, is [15692,29237]. Then, the XGBoost regression learning prediction model was used to extract the word attributes in “Hard Mode”, and the coefficients of the Automated Readability Index were found to be 86.7%, which showed that the influence of the word attrib-utes on the model was significant. Finally, after a comparative analysis of the impact percentages in the “Hard Mode” respectively, it was found that the proportion of players trying to solve puzzles 3–5 times exceeded 80% of the total.

articleTitle: Self-Powered Rotary Speed Sensor for Bearing Monitoring Based on Triboelectric Nanogenerator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Triboelectric sensors with grating structure have been proved to monitor bearing speed, but most of these sensors have low level of integration and cannot be applied to real working conditions. In this paper, the finite element simulation model of electrostatic induction is established, the influence of grating number and gap ratio on the electrical performance of the sensor is investigated. On this basis, a triboelectric speed sensor made of copper and PI film is designed. The results show that the higher the grating number, the lower the open circuit voltage at the same gap ratio; when the gap ratio increases, the open circuit voltage decreases first and then increases. In addition, the grating structure triboelectric sensor, signal processing circuit and wireless module are integrated to form a highly integrated wireless telemetry system for bearing speed monitoring. On the premise of not changing the bearing structure, the speed of the bearing system is monitored in-situ wirelessly. The triboelectric speed sensor reported in this paper provides a new idea for online monitoring and integration of intelligent bearings.

articleTitle: Research on Multimodal Image Fusion Method Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Accurate assessment of medical image quality is of paramount importance as it forms the cornerstone of diagnoses, where even minor discrepancies can lead to misdiagnoses. To achieve this, two key aspects, realism, and comprehensibility, are employed to evaluate the quality of medical images. Factors such as image richness, clarity, and saliency are analyzed to precisely reflect the image's reliability. However, due to variations in data originating from different hospitals, medical professionals, and equipment, internal structures may exhibit significant differences. To address this issue, this study proposes a multimodal data-based medical image fusion model that captures the correlation and complementary information between heterogeneous data. By combining the regional Laplacian pyramid (LLP) with convolutional neural networks, the convolutional network is enhanced. The source images are decomposed using LLP, and an improved deep convolutional neural network generates an optimal weight map to guide the fusion process, resulting in a fused image. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves favorable fusion effects in both subjective visual assessments and objective evaluation metrics.

articleTitle: Research on a Linear Regression-Based Model for Stock Movement Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: With the rapid growth of the economy, more and more people are speculating in stocks, and usually, stock information can only be viewed on dedicated websites. However, the rapid update of stock data and the limited ability of stockholders to access it through manual access have led to losses in the sector due to information asymmetry in the process of stock speculation. This paper addresses the above problems by studying the implementation of a linear regression-based stock trend analysis model, which classifies stocks into two categories, high quality and poor quality, according to the efficiency of their returns, and uses Python crawler technology and linear regression analysis to improve the accuracy of stock predictions. It allows users to select suitable stocks for purchase based on the aggregation of information, and helps buyers to analyse stock information to a certain extent, select stocks with high yield and avoid investment losses caused by information asymmetry.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a PID Control Based Intelligent Infrared Regulated Handling Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The Mega 2560 is designed as the core control chip for the logistics and transport process, combining intelligent infrared control with custom functions and using incremental PID control technology to achieve a continuous and stable state of the trolley during travel, using the PID Tuner in MATLAB to PID Tuner in MATLAB is used to parameterize the three parameters. Finally, the K210 vision module is used with the vertical robot arm to identify the information of the courier, and the experimental comparison and Simdroid simulation analysis confirm that the vehicle can greatly improve the function of intelligent logistics handling.

articleTitle: Test and Prediction of Peak Resistance Torque During the Startup of Integrated Transmission in Low-Temperature Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The low-temperature starting performance of tracked armored vehicles is related to their overall adaptability. This paper takes a certain of integrated transmission as the research object. Low-temperature starting test bench is used a to test the starting resistance moment of the integrated transmission at −45 °C, −30 °C, −20 °C, 0 °C, and 20 °C. The experimental research finds that the low temperature has a great impact on the starting resistance torque of the integrated transmission. Compared with 20 °C, the starting peak resistance torque at −45 °C increases sharply to more than 17 times. It is found that the starting peak resistance torque obeys the exponential growth law with the decrease of oil temperature. At the same time, the study also finds that the optimized GOM(1,1) can well describe the variation of the starting peak resistance moment of the integrated transmission under low temperature conditions.

articleTitle: Data Transformation for the Optimal Projection Direction of Mesh Surface
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In the 5-axis NC machining, the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$3+2$</tex> axis machining is one of the most commonly used methods, which requires the two rotation axes are fixed with the direction of the most projected area. The parameter surface model can directly obtain the overall external vector of the surface model as the direction to fix the two rotation axes and transform the model data to achieve the 3-axis linkage machining according to this direction. However, the mesh surface only provides the information of all the facets in the model data, there is not direct data for driving two rotation axes orientations, and there is a lack of corresponding method to convert model data for the 3-axis machining. This paper proposes a data transformation method to generate the optimal projection direction for the mesh surface and realize the data transformation for the 3-axis machining in this direction. Through the computer programming, a simple system is developed and this proposed method is verified. The experimental results prove that the calculated optimal projection direction and the transformed model data can provide effective basic data for the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$3+2$</tex> axis mesh surface machining.

articleTitle: Emotional Analysis of Short Text Based on Multiscale Improved CNN Model Under Tenorflow
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Short text emotion analysis has always been a key area of concern for mastering hot public opinion and understanding public evaluation. However, due to the complex factors involved in emotion analysis such as polysemy, irony, word sequence dependency, the accuracy of some existing short text emotion analysis methods still has room for improvement. Based on this, this paper proposes a short text sentiment analysis method based on multi-scale improved CNN model under Tensorflow. This method builds multi-scale convolution layer on the basis of the original convolution layer to help the model mine more potential function information, and at the same time imposes a lightweight constraint on the network to reduce the probability of over-fitting. Finally, attention mechanism is introduced to give different weights to features according to their importance, and text emotion analysis is carried out. The experimental results show that the average loss value of the improved CNN model is reduced by 38.7%, and the average accuracy is improved by 21.6%.

articleTitle: Local Mean k-Nearest Neighbor Classifier with Gaussian-Kernel Distance Function
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: KNN is a simple but efficient machine learning classification algorithm that has an irreplaceable place in industry. In this paper, we propose a kernel-based local mean k-nearest neighbor classifier algorithm (KLMKNN) that not only considers the k nearest samples from each class of the samples to be classified, but also introduces a kernel mapping approach to compute data points in a high-dimensional space as a way to extract better location information. To verify the feasibility and efficiency of our proposed algorithm, we compared it with related algorithms on several datasets, and the results showed that the accuracy of our proposed algorithm is 0.7538 in all datasets, which is an improvement compared to KNN (0.7249), KKNN (0.7215) and LMKNN (0.7445), which is a good proof that our proposed algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: Research on Passive UAV Localization Model Based on Topology-Monte Carlo Coupling Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Aiming at maintaining formation and electromagnetic silence as far as possible (as few transmitting signal drones and signal transmitting times as far as possible), based on graph theory, this paper takes less transmitting signal drones and fewer transmitting signals as decision objectives, adopts iterative and ergographic solving methods, establishes three UAV positioning models, and carries out UAV positioning. In order to avoid the equation without solution caused by symmetry, Therefore, the scheme of adjacent drones is adopted. By deviating the Angle information received by the UAV, the current position can be determined by the positioning model, and finally the positioning model of the passive receiving UAV is determined.

articleTitle: Research on Two-Stage Differential Operational Amplifier Based on MOS Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Nowadays, -3dB bandwidth and phase margin is the standard for the stability of a circuit. In order to improve the -3dB bandwidth and the phase margin of ordinary amplifier circuit, a two-stage fully differential amplifier circuit is designed based on MOSFET technology, using a differential amplifier as the first stage circuit and a common source amplifier as the second stage. Simulation results show that when working at 1.8 V supply voltage and 0.5 uA reference current, its gain can overtake 80dB and its -3dB bandwidth is more than 2kHz at the same time. Also, its total current consumption is only 4.3 uA, meaning that the power consumption of the whole circuit is low. As for the phase margin of the two-stage differential amplifier circuit, only using Miller compensation cannot get proper phase margin, meaning that it is seriously unstable for the circuit when working. After adding load resistor, phase margin improves greatly while -3dB bandwidth is affected. This research will be helpful for further method to improve the stability of the circuit.

articleTitle: A Detection Algorithm Based on Improved Faster R-CNN for Spacecraft Components
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Due to the increasing need of science and technology, more and more spacecraft are in space. Once the spacecraft reaches its useful life, it will become floating junk in space. Active space debris removal technology is an effective method to solve space garbage. With the rapid iteration of deep learning methods, target detection technology in the field of computer vision has made a breakthrough. In this paper, a Faster R-CNN model based on RegNet as the main trunk network is proposed, which can reduce the loss of key information caused by R-CNN sampling and effectively improve the target detection effect. We will collect the photos of space spacecraft as training sets and verification sets sent to the network for iterative training. The test results of the data set in this paper show that: With RegNet as the main backbone network, the Faster R-CNN model has better test results than other target detection algorithms under the same parameters. Compared with other backbone networks added to Faster R-CNN, the mAP value is improved by at least 9.6%. Compared with other advanced target detection algorithms, mAP value increased by at least 26.3%. When processing low Earth orbit target identification tasks, the Faster R-CNN model based on RegNet as the main trunk network has a strong recognition ability for the image targets whose color is similar to the background color, relatively fuzzy and small scale.

articleTitle: AI Detection for Anode Copper Plate Surface Defect
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: How to quickly and accurately detect the surface defects of objects has always been the focus of computer vision research. In this paper, a defect detection based on AI method for anode copper plate is proposed. Firstly, the physical appearance image data set of anode copper plate is built by ourselves and its physical size parameters are modeled. Secondly, the YOLOv5 target detection network is used to train the image data. Finally, AI detection of surface cracks and other defects of anode copper plate is completed by image segmentation algorithm and comparison with standard template library. The experimental results show that the method presented in this paper has a good detection and recognition effect on the anode copper plate cracks and other defects, which can not only effectively improve the detection accuracy and speed, but also greatly reduce human resources.

articleTitle: Research on 3D Art Design System Based on Computer Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The hardware system framework is constructed on the basis of analyzing the characteristics of environmental 3D art design. Then the system designs the collector, controller, processor and data interface. Combine the controller and arithmetic unit into a central processing unit. It handles recording environment design data. The software part designs the server port and client port. The server port transforms the two-dimensional image information into three-dimensional virtual reality data by using the transformation matrix. The client port uses C language to convert the matrix transformation results into codes and input them into the computer. The management model of the large terrain environment database is adopted to realize the management of the database in the environment. In the process of 3D virtual reproduction of the environment, the 3D scene of the environment is shaped by Vega driver software. Experimental results show that the environment reproduced by the proposed method is more realistic and intuitive. The system can realize interactive operation.

articleTitle: Predictive Analysis of Wordle Games Based on BP Neural Networks and K-Means Clusters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: Wordle is a popular daily puzzle game currently offered by The New York Times in of which players can guess words and receive feedback on each guess. Wordle games are currently growing in popularity, but research into Wordle games is still very limited and there are many issues that need to be examined in depth.First,We need to build models for different word attributes and predict the distribution of the results reported for any one word, giving the predicted results for the word “EERIE” on March 1, 2023. Here we first processed the data to get the final outcome data, then we introduced a BP neural network prediction, we introduced a BP Neural Network prediction model and performed specific training, where the training accuracy reached over 98%, which is very accurate. We then filtered the features using XGBoost and we created a difficulty classification based on a K-means clustering analysis that divided the difficulty into two categories: difficult and easy, we then performed specific clustering and obtained the final clustering results for evaluation. Secondly, we created a linear discriminant analysis of classification accuracy and performed statistics for each word attribute, which turned out to be very consistent with our previous analysis. The more common the word is in life, the lower the difficulty. The more the word repeated letters, the higher the difficulty. Finally, we introduced the EERIE words into the clustering model and found them to be of medium difficulty and got better results.

articleTitle: Maintenance of Distribution Network Based on Improved Flock Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In order to reduce the maintenance cost of distribution network and improve the maintenance efficiency, a distribution network maintenance method based on improved flock algorithm is proposed. A distribution network maintenance model including maintenance cost, power supply loss and fault loss is established. The model aims at minimizing cost and includes constraints of each device. Then, a flock optimization algorithm based on differential evolution is proposed, which improves the convergence speed and searching precision. The improved flock algorithm is used to solve the maintenance model of distribution network. The simulation results verify the applicability of the proposed model in distribution network maintenance.

articleTitle: Research on Flight Control System of Computer Vision Folding Common Axis Reverse Propeller UAV
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: A pose feedback control method based on reverse sliding mode was designed. The dynamic modeling is carried out. A method of position, attitude and positioning control for foldable coaxial twin-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle based on reverse sliding mode is proposed. The dynamic modeling and aerodynamic modeling of cylindrical coaxial unmanned helicopter are carried out. A method to solve the nonlinear control problem of the system is proposed by using the sliding mode theory. MATLAB was used to simulate it. Experimental results show that this method can improve the stability of aircraft.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Intelligent Parking Management System Based on OpenCV and B/S Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: This paper designs and implements an intelligent parking management system based on OpenCV and B/S architecture. The system utilizes computer vision and network technology to realize the functions of license plate recognition, parking space detection and fee management, which improves the operation efficiency and service quality of parking lots and promotes the development of urban transportation. This paper first introduces the functional architecture and role assignment of the system, then describes the OpenCV-based license plate recognition method, the features and operation process of B/S architecture, the selection and use of the front and back-end development framework, and finally describes in detail the design and implementation of the front and back-end communication process. The focus of this paper is on the adoption of the contour detection method to locate license plate areas, the use of the Django REST framework to create the interface, and the use of the Vue.js framework and element-ui component library to create the user interaction interface to achieve a cross-platform, easy-to-maintain and efficient web application. The research results of this paper have theoretical significance and practical value for solving urban parking problems, improving parking management and promoting the development of intelligent transportation field.

articleTitle: Establishment of Wireless Propagation Model of Tower Crane Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: For the construction of the wireless propagation model in the smart tower crane, this paper uses the Pearson correlation. The maximum information coefficient, random forest model and CatBoost model quantify the relationship between 35 features and received power, and these feature data are trained in the built machine learning model, and finally the wireless signal coverage in the new environment can be better predicted. Propagation model of the strength of a wireless network. The model provides technical support for establishing an accurate wireless network, reduces network construction costs, and improves construction efficiency.

articleTitle: Super-Resolution Reconstruction of Remote Sensing Images Based on Improved Residual Dense Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: An improved residual dense network (IRDN)-based remote sensing images super-resolution reconstruction technique is suggested in order to address the issues with single feature extraction and equalization of feature processing in the current remote sensing images super-resolution reconstruction algorithm. By strengthening the structure of the original residual dense model, adding a branch to extract more varied and rich features, and establishing the channel and position relationship of features by Coordinate Attention (CA), the algorithm enhances the performance of the model's feature extraction and representation. The strategy can effectively increase the reconstruction performance while significantly lowering the number of model parameters, according to experiments using the publicly accessible remote sensing datasets UC MERCED and NWPU-RESISC45. On the UC MERCED dataset with a scale factor of 4, the objective performance evaluation indexes of peak signal to noise ratio and structure similarity achieve 29.3126dB and 0.7987, respectively, and good visual effects are obtained. It offers a solid foundation for the future remote sensing images' additional analysis and processing.

articleTitle: Screw Tightening Device Based on improved PID Control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: In order to ensure the loosening and tightening of the screws of power equipment and ancillary facilities under the state of electrification, a remote screw loosening and tightening device based on the improved PID algorithm of neural network is designed, which is mainly composed of a mechanical locking structure and a control machine. The mechanical fastening structure is fixed on the insulating rod. Under the condition that the equipment is not powered off, the device can be operated remotely to complete the loosening and tightening of the screws. In order to make the mechanical structure rotate stably and fasten without shaking, A PID algorithm for dynamic parameter adjustment with stronger adaptability and little increase in calculation is proposed. After practical testing and use under various working conditions, the screw tightening device can not only adjust the direction accurately and align the screw holes efficiently when the equipment is charged, but also has a smooth and stable tightening process.

articleTitle: Dust Mass Concentration Detection Using Multi-angle Light Scattering Humidity Correction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: To reduce detection error, a real-time humidity correction dust mass concentration detection technology is proposed. Analyze Mie scattering theory. Propose multi angle light scattering theory, and establish a mathematical model for real-time humidity correction dust mass concentration detection. Develop a multi-angle light scattering dust mass concentration detection unit. analyze the characteristics of moisture absorption and growth of coal dust particles based on the test preparation and test system, experimentally study the relationship between environmental humidity, dust particle size, and scattered light flux, establish a humidity correction factor algorithm, and propose a multi-angle light scattering humidity correction dust mass concentration detection technology; Finally, the humidity correction factor algorithm was written into the multi-angle light scattering dust mass concentration detection unit for comparative test verification. The test found that the detection error of the multi-angle light scattering dust mass concentration detection unit with humidity correction was <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\leq 10.6 \%$</tex>, which was 3.3% smaller than the error without humidity correction.

articleTitle: Research on Position Following System of Driven Joint Motor Based on Fuzzy PI Feedforward Control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing and Computer Applications (ICIPCA)
abstract: The traditional PID three-closed-loop control system has the problems of phase lag and amplitude deviation when applied to the driven joint motor system, which cannot achieve accurate position tracking. Aiming at this problem, this paper firstly introduces the mathematical model of the driven joint motor system, and secondly proposes a fuzzy PI feedforward control strategy. The fuzzy PI controller is used to replace the proportional controller of the original position loop, and the feedforward control is added to the speed loop and the current loop to achieve accurate position tracking. Finally, the simulation model of the control strategy is established in Matlab/Simulink and the physical platform is built to verify the feasibility of the strategy. The simulation results and experimental results can prove that the fuzzy PI feedforward control system is more accurate in the tracking of position signals than the traditional PID three-closed-loop control, which could meet the needs of the position tracking system of the driven joint motor.
